(2) Bulk wipe `cuisine:seen:<chatId>:*` on every TMA mount via `SCAN MATCH` + pipelined `DEL` in `startSession` so multi-week sessions self-heal. sections.heading: Decisions (append-only addition)
sections.body:
| # | Decision | Date | Version | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| D-127 | Cuisine TMA `pages` history persists FULL criteria snapshot (criteriaState + freeText + locationAnchor + searchCenter), not just venues | 14-05 '26 | v0.60.154 | Codex review on PR #395: the prior pages payload restored the venue list but not the chips / loading-hint trigger / copy-all heading / next 🔍 target, so back-walks described a different search than they showed. Deep-clone the criteria state (`JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snap))`) so back-walks don't share-reference. |
| D-128 | `cuisine:seen:<chatId>:*` per-criteria seen-sets get bulk-wiped on every TMA mount (in addition to the explicit ↺ Start over per-criteria reset) | 14-05 '26 | v0.60.155 | Multi-week sessions drift into "every criteria returns zero new venues" because the per-criteria SET has no TTL. Wiping on mount lets the user self-heal by re-opening the TMA without needing to remember the ↺ button. Trade-off: a long-running session that backgrounds and re-foregrounds will see the same first ~60 venues again; acceptable per operator (the alternative — TTL — would surprise users mid-session). |
| D-129 | Places v1 `review.text.text` unwrap is a single shared helper applied at 5 sites, not a per-site fix | 14-05 '26 | v0.60.156 | The bug recurred at v0.60.154 + v0.60.155 because per-site guards (`typeof === 'string'`) didn't catch a string that IS valid (`"[object Object]"`). Centralising the unwrap in `reviewText(r)` and applying it at every read site (`r.text` was used 5 times across two handlers) removes the per-site discipline burden. Defines the helper at outer scope so the Michelin handler + `extractDishes` share it. |
| D-130 | Zero-results auto-retry fires AT MOST ONCE per criteria signature; the CTA panel covers the second-zero case | 14-05 '26 | v0.60.157 | Operator's "Plan for 95%" option D: don't infinite-loop, but don't leave the user with a silent empty state either. The single auto-retry handles the dominant cause (seen-set over-filter). The CTA covers the residual "criteria genuinely match nothing" case with an obvious action (auto-expand criteria builder + explicit retry button). Per-criteria scope means changing any criteria field re-arms the budget, which is the right semantic for "I've adjusted my search". |
| D-131 | Zero-results CTA panel mirrors the exhausted-note panel styling (rounded `bg-tg-card` + `text-tg-hint` italic + pill-shaped accent button), not a modal / toast | 14-05 '26 | v0.60.157 | The exhausted-note pattern is already established as the "terminal state for this search" idiom in the TMA. Re-using the visual treatment keeps the user's mental model coherent (this is the same family of "end of the line — here's your one-tap way out"). A modal would over-emphasize what's still a recoverable state; a toast would auto-dismiss before the user has time to read the criteria builder. |

| 5 | Time anchor = `user_stated_device_required_due_to_runtime_constraint`. | Sandbox blocks live sovereign fetch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 6 | Vibe summary lazy on `/lunch`, 7-day cache. | Cheaper at low traffic. | 29-04 '26 |
| 7 | Gemini model overridable via `GEMINI_MODEL`. | Safe default + one-line escape hatch. | 29-04 '26 |

| 9 | **Reuse `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` for the TWA frontend.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Reuse existing key — insecure"). Mitigation: HTTP-Referrer restriction in Cloud Console (Open #4). | 29-04 '26 |

| 11 | **Ship `/eat` chat fallback alongside TWA.** Drop `/lunch` entirely. | Per Human Lead choice ("Yes, keep /eat as fallback"). | 29-04 '26 |
| 12 | **Accept Zero-Server Mandate transient breach for 30-min hashed location cache.** Mitigation: SHA-256 hashed chat ID, 30-min TTL, no append/history. | Per Human Lead choice ("Cache in Redis 30 min"). One-line rollback documented. | 29-04 '26 |
| 13 | **Pass `google_place_id` + `google_place_type` to `bot.sendVenue`** and build TWA InfoWindow links from `place_id` rather than `googleMapsUri`. | Telegram's coords-only fallback URL was opening Google Maps at raw lat/lng instead of the Place page. | 14 | **TWA InfoWindow "Open in Maps" uses Google's documented Search-action URL Schema** `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` and `tg.openLink()` for external dispatch. | iPadOS Universal Links with both Google Maps + Apple Maps installed routed v0.4.1's `?q=place_id:` pattern to Apple Maps, which doesn't recognise `place_id` and degraded to coords. | 15 | **iOS deep-link probe + install fallback for "Open in Google Maps".** Try `comgooglemaps://` URL scheme; if `visibilitychange` doesn't fire within 1500 ms the app is not installed → prompt user via `tg.showConfirm` to install from App Store or fall back to documented HTTPS URL. | Per Human Lead requirement "Google map must be installed, detect if not." | 16 | **AdvancedMarkerElement with HTML pins** showing venue name visibly + `gestureHandling: 'greedy'` + inline keyboard under each Sanctuary read with **📍 Open Map** (web_app, single-pin focus via `?placeId`) and **🚗 Directions** (Google Directions URL Schema). | Per Human Lead "Yes, all 3" approval of the strategy doc trio. Solves "anonymous pin" UX, two-finger gesture frustration, and the missing per-pick navigation affordance in one minor bump. | 30-04 '26 |
| 17 | **Quality filter — drop venues with `businessStatus !== 'OPERATIONAL'` or `currentOpeningHours.openNow === false`.** Applied in both `vibe.js fetchPlaces` (cached listings) and `vibe-suggest.js validateWithPlaces` (per-pick validation). | Per Human Lead's §103.12 "Safety Filter" instruction. Prevents permanently-closed and currently-closed venues from surfacing in `/eat` once Places API is reachable again. | 30-04 '26 |
| 18 | **Tranche A of `02_Expand.MD`:** brand rename Gia4lunch → soleat (Gia persona kept as in-message voice); new `/drink` and `/groceries`; Topic Gatekeeper for free-text via Gemini structured-JSON + 60 s SHA-256 cache; walking radius 300 m; last-30-day review filter in `vibe-summary.js`. | Per Human Lead "yes Tranche A" + (2) yes for the G4 gate on the additional Gemini call. Ships the unblocked subset of `instruction/02_Expand.MD`; Tranche B (Vault, /BusArrivalv2, MRT-stop expansion) deferred pending data inputs. | 30-04 '26 |
| 19 | **Three-path location entry on `/eat /drink /groceries` + radius 200 m.** Tap 📍 to share, or **type a place name** (geocoded via Places `searchText`), or ⛔ Raffles Place default. Free-text handler consumes pending sanctuary flow before Gatekeeper. | Per Human Lead instruction: "Funciton, include share current, default to Raffles, or enter" + revised wording "s

| 5 | Time anchor = `user_stated_device_required_due_to_runtime_constraint`. | Sandbox blocks live sovereign fetch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 6 | Vibe summary lazy on `/lunch`, 7-day cache. | Cheaper at low traffic. | 29-04 '26 |
| 7 | Gemini model overridable via `GEMINI_MODEL`. | Safe default + one-line escape hatch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 8 | **Pure-Gemini-then-Places validation for `/eat`.** Gemini suggests names; Places validates within 200 m. | Avoids hallucination while preserving Gemini taste. Per Human Lead choice. | 29-04 '26 |
| 9 | **Reuse `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` for the TWA frontend.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Reuse existing key — insecure"). Mitigation: HTTP-Referrer restriction in Cloud Console (Open #4). | 29-04 '26 |
| 10 | **Bot registers menu button on boot via `setChatMenuButton({type:'web_app'})`.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Bot registers it on boot"). Auto-updates when domain changes. | 29-04 '26 |
| 11 | **Ship `/eat` chat fallback alongside TWA.** Drop `/lunch` entirely. | Per Human Lead choice ("Yes, keep /eat as fallback"). | 29-04 '26 |
| 12 | **Accept Zero-Server Mandate transient breach for 30-min hashed location cache.** Mitigation: SHA-256 hashed chat ID, 30-min TTL, no append/history. | Per Human Lead choice ("Cache in Redis 30 min"). One-line rollback documented. | 29-04 '26 |
| 13 | **Pass `google_place_id` + `google_place_type` to `bot.sendVenue`** and build TWA InfoWindow links from `place_id` rather than `googleMapsUri`. | Telegram's coords-only fallback URL was opening Google Maps at raw lat/lng instead of the Place page. | 14 | **TWA InfoWindow "Open in Maps" uses Google's documented Search-action URL Schema** `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` and `tg.openLink()` for external dispatch. | iPadOS Universal Links with both Google Maps + Apple Maps installed routed v0.4.1's `?q=place_id:` pattern to Apple Maps, which doesn't recognise `place_id` and degraded to coords. | 15 | **iOS deep-link probe + install fallback for "Open in Google Maps".** Try `comgooglemaps://` URL scheme; if `visibilitychange` doesn't fire within 1500 ms the app is not installed → prompt user via `tg.showConfirm` to install from App Store or fall back to documented HTTPS URL. | Per Human Lead requirement "Google map must be installed, detect if not." Universal Links can still route HTTPS to Apple Maps; URL scheme bypasses that and reaches Google Maps app deterministically when installed. | 29-04 '26 |
| 16 | **AdvancedMarkerElement with HTML pins** showing venue name visibly + `gestureHandling: 'greedy'` + inline keyboard under each Sanctuary read with **📍 Open Map** (web_app, single-pin focus via `?placeId`) and **🚗 Directions** (Google Directions URL Schema). | Per Human Lead "Yes, all 3" approval of the strategy doc trio. Solves "anonymous pin" UX, two-finger gesture frustration, and the missing per-pick navigation affordance in one minor bump. | 30-04 '26 |
| 17 | **Quality filter — drop venues with `businessStatus !== 'OPERATIONAL'` or `currentOpeningHours.openNow === false`.** Applied in both `vibe.js fetchPlaces` (cached listings) and `vibe-suggest.js validateWithPlaces` (per-pick validation). | Per Human Lead's §103.12 "Safety Filter" instruction. Prevents permanently-closed and currently-closed venues from surfacing in `/eat` once Places API is reachable again. | 30-04 '26 |
| 18 | **Tranche A of `02_Expand.MD`:** brand rename Gia4lunch → soleat (Gia persona kept as in-message voice); new `/drink` and `/groceries`; Topic Gatekeeper for free-text via Gemini structured-JSON + 60 s SHA-256 cache; walking radius 300 m; last-30-day review filter in `vibe-summary.js`. | Per Human Lead "yes Tranche A" + (2) yes for the G4 gate on the additional Gemini call. Ships the unblocked subset of `instruction/02_Expand.MD`; Tranche B (Vault, /BusArrivalv2, MRT-stop expansion) deferred pending data inputs. | 30-04 '26 |
| 19 | **Three-path location entry on `/eat /drink /groceries` + radius 200 m.** Tap 📍 to share, or **type a place name** (geocoded via Places `searchText`), or ⛔ Raffles Place default. Free-text handler consumes pending sanctuary flow before Gatekeeper. | Per Human Lead instruction: "Funciton, include share current, default to Raffles, or enter" + revised wording "s

| 6 | Vibe summary lazy on `/lunch`, 7-day cache. | Cheaper at low traffic. | 29-04 '26 |
| 7 | Gemini model overridable via `GEMINI_MODEL`. | Safe default + one-line escape hatch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 8 | **Pure-Gemini-then-Places validation for `/eat`.** Gemini suggests names; Places validates within 200 m. | Avoids hallucination while preserving Gemini taste. Per Human Lead choice. | 29-04 '26 |

| 11 | **Ship `/eat` chat fallback alongside TWA.** Drop `/lunch` entirely. | Per Human Lead choice ("Yes, keep /eat as fallback"). | 29-04 '26 |
| 12 | **Accept Zero-Server Mandate transient breach for 30-min hashed location cache.** Mitigation: SHA-256 hashed chat ID, 30-min TTL, no append/history. | Per Human Lead choice ("Cache in Redis 30 min"). One-line rollback documented. | 29-04 '26 |
| 13 | **Pass `google_place_id` + `google_place_type` to `bot.sendVenue`** and build TWA InfoWindow links from `place_id` rather than `googleMapsUri`. | Telegram's coords-only fallback URL was opening Google Maps at raw lat/lng instead of the Place page. | 14 | **TWA InfoWindow "Open in Maps" uses Google's documented Search-action URL Schema** `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` and `tg.openLink()` for external dispatch. | iPadOS Universal Links with both Google Maps + Apple Maps installed routed v0.4.1's `?q=place_id:` pattern to Apple Maps, which doesn't recognise `place_id` and degraded to coords. | 15 | **iOS deep-link probe + install fallback for "Open in Google Maps".** Try `comgooglemaps://` URL scheme; if `visibilitychange` doesn't fire within 1500 ms the app is not installed → prompt user via `tg.showConfirm` to install from App Store or fall back to documented HTTPS URL. | Per Human Lead requirement "Google map must be installed, detect if not." | 16 | **AdvancedMarkerElement with HTML pins** showing venue name visibly + `gestureHandling: 'greedy'` + inline keyboard under each Sanctuary read with **📍 Open Map** (web_app, single-pin focus via `?placeId`) and **🚗 Directions** (Google Directions URL Schema). | Per Human Lead "Yes, all 3" approval of the strategy doc trio. | 17 | **Quality filter — drop venues with `businessStatus !== 'OPERATIONAL'` or `currentOpeningHours.openNow === false`.** Applied in both `vibe.js fetchPlaces` (cached listings) and `vibe-suggest.js validateWithPlaces` (per-pick validation). | Per Human Lead's §103.12 "Safety Filter" instruction. Prevents permanently-closed and currently-closed venues from surfacing in `/eat` once Places API is reachable again. | 30-04 '26 |

Ships the unblocked subset of `instruction/02_Expand.MD`; Tranche B (Vault, /BusArrivalv2, MRT-stop expansion) deferred pending data inputs. | 30-04 '26 |
| 19 | **Three-path location entry on `/eat /drink /groceries` + radius 200 m.** Tap 📍 to share, or **type a place name** (geocoded via Places `searchText`), or ⛔ Raffles Place default. Free-text handler consumes pending sanctuary flow before Gatekeeper. | Per Human Lead instruction: "Funciton, include share current, default to Raffles, or enter" + revised wording "s

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | LTA `LTA_ACCOUNT_KEY` is optional in Phase 1. | Lets Telegram + Redis verification proceed without DataMall registration. | 29-04 '26 |
| 2 | Switch from RSS to Google Places for venue discovery. | RSS returned lifestyle articles. | 29-04 '26 |
| 3 | Switch from long-polling to webhooks. | Recurring 409 Conflict. | 29-04 '26 |
| 4 | gia4lunch §6.3 rules subset = R002, R003, R004, R005 (extended), R010. | Project A lineage rules don't apply to Node/Telegram/Railway. | 29-04 '26 |
| 5 | Time anchor = `user_stated_device_required_due_to_runtime_constraint`. | Sandbox blocks live sovereign fetch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 6 | Vibe summary lazy on `/lunch`, 7-day cache. | Cheaper at low traffic. | 29-04 '26 |
| 7 | Gemini model overridable via `GEMINI_MODEL`. | Safe default + one-line escape hatch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 8 | **Pure-Gemini-then-Places validation for `/eat`.** Gemini suggests names; Places validates within 200 m. | Avoids hallucination while preserving Gemini taste. Per Human Lead choice. | 29-04 '26 |
| 9 | **Reuse `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` for the TWA frontend.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Reuse existing key — insecure"). Mitigation: HTTP-Referrer restriction in Cloud Console (Open #4). | 29-04 '26 |
| 10 | **Bot registers menu button on boot via `setChatMenuButton({type:'web_app'})`.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Bot registers it on boot"). Auto-updates when domain changes. | 29-04 '26 |
| 11 | **Ship `/eat` chat fallback alongside TWA.** Drop `/lunch` entirely. | Per Human Lead choice ("Yes, keep /eat as fallback"). | 29-04 '26 |
| 12 | **Accept Zero-Server Mandate transient breach for 30-min hashed location cache.** Mitigation: SHA-256 hashed chat ID, 30-min TTL, no append/history. | Per Human Lead choice ("Cache in Redis 30 min"). One-line rollback documented. | 29-04 '26 |
| 13 | **Pass `google_place_id` + `google_place_type` to `bot.sendVenue`** and build TWA InfoWindow links from `place_id` rather than `googleMapsUri`. | Telegram's coords-only fallback URL was opening Google Maps at raw lat/lng instead of the Place page. | 14 | **TWA InfoWindow "Open in Maps" uses Google's documented Search-action URL Schema** `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` and `tg.openLink()` for external dispatch. | iPadOS Universal Links with both Google Maps + Apple Maps installed routed v0.4.1's `?q=place_id:` pattern to Apple Maps, which doesn't recognise `place_id` and degraded to coords. Documented schema with `query=<name>` keeps the name visible regardless of which Maps app handles the link. | 29-04 '26 |
| 15 | **iOS deep-link probe + install fallback for "Open in Google Maps".** Try `comgooglemaps://` URL scheme; if `visibilitychange` doesn't fire within 1500 ms the app is not installed → prompt user via `tg.showConfirm` to install from App Store or fall back to documented HTTPS URL. | Per Human Lead requirement "Google map must be installed, detect if not." Universal Links can still route HTTPS to Apple Maps; URL scheme bypasses that and reaches Google Maps app deterministically when installed. | 29-04 '26 |
| 16 | **AdvancedMarkerElement with HTML pins** showing venue name visibly + `gestureHandling: 'greedy'` + inline keyboard under each Sanctuary read with **📍 Open Map** (web_app, single-pin focus via `?placeId`) and **🚗 Directions** (Google Directions URL Schema). | Per Human Lead "Yes, all 3" approval of the strategy doc trio. Solves "anonymous pin" UX, two-finger gesture frustration, and the missing per-pick navigation affordance in one minor bump. | 30-04 '26 |
| 17 | **Quality filter — drop venues with `businessStatus !== 'OPERATIONAL'` or `currentOpeningHours.openNow === false`.** Applied in both `vibe.js fetchPlaces` (cached listings) and `vibe-suggest.js validateWithPlaces` (per-pick validation). | Per Human Lead's §103.12 "Safety Filter" instruction. Prevents permanently-closed and currently-closed venues from surfacing in `/eat` once Places API is reachable again. | 30-04 '26 |
| 18 | **Tranche A of `02_Expand.MD`:** brand rename Gia4lunch → soleat (Gia persona kept as in-message voice); new `/drink` and `/groceries`; Topic Gatekeeper for free-text via Gemini structured-JSON + 60 s SHA-256 cache; walking radius 300 m; last-30-day review filter in `vibe-summary.js`. | Per Human Lead "yes Tranche A" + (2) yes for the G4 gate on the additional Gemini call. Ships the unblocked subset of `instruction/02_Expand.MD`; Tranche B (Vault, /BusArrivalv2, MRT-stop expansion) deferred pending data inputs. | 30-04 '26 |
| 19 | **Three-path location entry on `/eat /drink /groceries` + radius 200 m.** Tap 📍 to share, or **type a place name** (geocoded via Places `searchText`), or ⛔ Raffles Place default. Free-text handler consumes pending sanctuary flow before Gatekeeper. | Per Human Lead instruction: "Funciton, include share current, default to Raffles, or enter" + revised wording "s

| 1 | LTA `LTA_ACCOUNT_KEY` is optional in Phase 1. | Lets Telegram + Redis verification proceed without DataMall registration. | 29-04 '26 |
| 2 | Switch from RSS to Google Places for venue discovery. | RSS returned lifestyle articles. | 29-04 '26 |
| 3 | Switch from long-polling to webhooks. | Recurring 409 Conflict. | 29-04 '26 |
| 4 | gia4lunch §6.3 rules subset = R002, R003, R004, R005 (extended), R010. | Project A lineage rules don't apply to Node/Telegram/Railway. | 29-04 '26 |
| 5 | Time anchor = `user_stated_device_required_due_to_runtime_constraint`. | Sandbox blocks live sovereign fetch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 6 | Vibe summary lazy on `/lunch`, 7-day cache. | Cheaper at low traffic. | 29-04 '26 |
| 7 | Gemini model overridable via `GEMINI_MODEL`. | Safe default + one-line escape hatch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 8 | **Pure-Gemini-then-Places validation for `/eat`.** Gemini suggests names; Places validates within 200 m. | Avoids hallucination while preserving Gemini taste. Per Human Lead choice. | 29-04 '26 |
| 9 | **Reuse `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` for the TWA frontend.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Reuse existing key — insecure"). Mitigation: HTTP-Referrer restriction in Cloud Console (Open #4). | 29-04 '26 |
| 10 | **Bot registers menu button on boot via `setChatMenuButton({type:'web_app'})`.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Bot registers it on boot"). Auto-updates when domain changes. | 29-04 '26 |
| 11 | **Ship `/eat` chat fallback alongside TWA.** Drop `/lunch` entirely. | Per Human Lead choice ("Yes, keep /eat as fallback"). | 29-04 '26 |
| 12 | **Accept Zero-Server Mandate transient breach for 30-min hashed location cache.** Mitigation: SHA-256 hashed chat ID, 30-min TTL, no append/history. | Per Human Lead choice ("Cache in Redis 30 min"). One-line rollback documented. | 29-04 '26 |
| 13 | **Pass `google_place_id` + `google_place_type` to `bot.sendVenue`** and build TWA InfoWindow links from `place_id` rather than `googleMapsUri`. | Telegram's coords-only fallback URL was opening Google Maps at raw lat/lng instead of the Place page. Reported by Human Lead with example URL. | 29-04 '26 |
| 14 | **TWA InfoWindow "Open in Maps" uses Google's documented Search-action URL Schema** `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` and `tg.openLink()` for external dispatch. | iPadOS Universal Links with both Google Maps + Apple Maps installed routed v0.4.1's `?q=place_id:` pattern to Apple Maps, which doesn't recognise `place_id` and degraded to coords. Documented schema with `query=<name>` keeps the name visible regardless of which Maps app handles the link. | 29-04 '26 |
| 15 | **iOS deep-link probe + install fallback for "Open in Google Maps".** Try `comgooglemaps://` URL scheme; if `visibilitychange` doesn't fire within 1500 ms the app is not installed → prompt user via `tg.showConfirm` to install from App Store or fall back to documented HTTPS URL. | Per Human Lead requirement "Google map must be installed, detect if not." Universal Links can still route HTTPS to Apple Maps; URL scheme bypasses that and reaches Google Maps app deterministically when installed. | 29-04 '26 |
| 16 | **AdvancedMarkerElement with HTML pins** showing venue name visibly + `gestureHandling: 'greedy'` + inline keyboard under each Sanctuary read with **📍 Open Map** (web_app, single-pin focus via `?placeId`) and **🚗 Directions** (Google Directions URL Schema). | Per Human Lead "Yes, all 3" approval of the strategy doc trio. Solves "anonymous pin" UX, two-finger gesture frustration, and the missing per-pick navigation affordance in one minor bump. | 30-04 '26 |
| 17 | **Quality filter — drop venues with `businessStatus !== 'OPERATIONAL'` or `currentOpeningHours.openNow === false`.** Applied in both `vibe.js fetchPlaces` (cached listings) and `vibe-suggest.js validateWithPlaces` (per-pick validation). | Per Human Lead's §103.12 "Safety Filter" instruction. Prevents permanently-closed and currently-closed venues from surfacing in `/eat` once Places API is reachable again. | 30-04 '26 |
| 18 | **Tranche A of `02_Expand.MD`:** brand rename Gia4lunch → soleat (Gia persona kept as in-message voice); new `/drink` and `/groceries`; Topic Gatekeeper for free-text via Gemini structured-JSON + 60 s SHA-256 cache; walking radius 300 m; last-30-day review filter in `vibe-summary.js`. | Per Human Lead "yes Tranche A" + (2) yes for the G4 gate on the additional Gemini call. Ships the unblocked subset of `instruction/02_Expand.MD`; Tranche B (Vault, /BusArrivalv2, MRT-stop expansion) deferred pending data inputs. | 30-04 '26 |
| 19 | **Three-path location entry on `/eat /drink /groceries` + radius 200 m.** Tap 📍 to share, or **type a place name** (geocoded via Places `searchText`), or ⛔ Raffles Place default. Free-text handler consumes pending sanctuary flow before Gatekeeper. | Per Human Lead instruction: "Funciton, include share current, default to Raffles, or enter" + revised wording "s

sections.body:
| # | Item | Owner | Priority | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Bot is in seed-fallback mode showing static listings (LeVeL33, Monti, etc.) without business_status data. Until resolved, all picks are stale and the v0.5.1 quality filter is dormant. |
| 5 | If `gemini-3-flash` 404s, set `GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-1.5-flash` in Railway Variables. | Human Lead | medium | One-line fix; no code change. |
| 6 | Phase 4 — GrabID OAuth 2.0 PKCE for live quietness signal. | Claude Code | medium | Replaces Gemini-from-reviews with real merchant occupancy. |
| 7 | Phase 4 — DryRoute B1/B2 linkway routing. | Claude Code | low | Persona feature; rainy-day path. |
| 8 | Phase 4 — Personal Vault sync to Google Drive. | Claude Code | low | Zero-Server identity store. |
| 9 | Phase 4 — Telegram Cloud Storage Favorites (replaces 30-min Redis location cache for proper Zero-Server compliance). | Claude Code | medium | Closes the v0.4.0 Mandate breach. |
| 10 | Folder templates (`Builder.md`, `Persona.md`, etc.) not present in repo. | Human Lead | low | Per CLAUDE.md §3 step 3, Claude uses CLAUDE-FULL fallback when templates missing. |
| 11 | Register a Cloud Map ID and replace placeholder `'GIA_SANCTUARY'` in `public/app.js`. | Human Lead | low | AdvancedMarkerElement requires `mapId`. Currently uses a placeholder which produces a console-warning watermark but functions correctly. Cloud Console → Map Management → Create Map ID (vector) → paste the ID via env var or commit. |
| 12 | **Tranche B of `02_Expand.MD` — Redis Vault (200+ curated locations).** | Human Lead | medium | Spec §5 references "curated 200+ locations (CSV/KML)". Source file not provided. Paste the data or upload to repo (e.g. `data/vault.csv`) and Claude will write the import script + Redis loader + Vault-first lookup in `pickValidated`. |
| 13 | **Tranche B — `/BusArrivalv2`.** | Human Lead | medium | LTA endpoint takes a BusStopCode. Need a UX product call: (a) bot uses cached `/eat` location → reverse-lookup nearest stop, (b) user types stop code, or (c) inline keyboard from a list of "your usual stops". Pick one path. |
| 14 | **Tranche B — `getTransitContext()` and "1 MRT stop away" expansion.** | Human Lead | medium | Needs MRT station coordinates dataset. Either pull `/MRTStations` from LTA at boot and cache (~135 stations), or hardcode the CBD subset. Confirm preference. |

sections.heading: Deferred
sections.body:
| # | Item | Reason | Reactivate when |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Live "Popular Times" / quietness signal via Google Places. | Not exposed by official API; scraping violates ToS. **Partially mitigated by Gemini-from-reviews "Sanctuary read."** Full mitigation via GrabID per Open item 6. | Open #6 ships. |
| 2 | LTA bus arrival times (`/BusArrivalv2`). | Phase 1 limited to MRT alerts. | When `/status` evolves into a multi-mode CBD pulse. |
| 3 | RSS Vibe Sensor (SethLui, Honeycombers). | Filter quality inadequate. | Only if Google Places fails permanently. |
| 4 | Inline mode (`@gia4lunch_bot raffles`). | Not in immediate scope; Mini App now covers cross-chat sharing via deep links. | Demand observed. |
| 5 | Scheduled "11:45 AM Pulse" daily nudge. | Persona feature; deferred until user list grows. | User base reaches 5+. |

sections.heading: Decisions
sections.body:
| # | Decision | Rationale | Date |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | LTA `LTA_ACCOUNT_KEY` is optional in Phase 1. | Lets Telegram + Redis verification proceed without DataMall registration. | 29-04 '26 |
| 2 | Switch from RSS to Google Places for venue discovery. | RSS returned lifestyle articles. | 29-04 '26 |
| 3 | Switch from long-polling to webhooks. | Recurring 409 Conflict. | 29-04 '26 |
| 4 | gia4lunch §6.3 rules subset = R002, R003, R004, R005 (extended), R010. | Project A lineage rules don't apply to Node/Telegram/Railway. | 29-04 '26 |
| 5 | Time anchor = `user_stated_device_required_due_to_runtime_constraint`. | Sandbox blocks live sovereign fetch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 6 | Vibe summary lazy on `/lunch`, 7-day cache. | Cheaper at low traffic. | 29-04 '26 |
| 7 | Gemini model overridable via `GEMINI_MODEL`. | Safe default + one-line escape hatch. | 29-04 '26 |
| 8 | **Pure-Gemini-then-Places validation for `/eat`.** Gemini suggests names; Places validates within 200 m. | Avoids hallucination while preserving Gemini taste. Per Human Lead choice. | 29-04 '26 |
| 9 | **Reuse `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` for the TWA frontend.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Reuse existing key — insecure"). Mitigation: HTTP-Referrer restriction in Cloud Console (Open #4). | 29-04 '26 |
| 10 | **Bot registers menu button on boot via `setChatMenuButton({type:'web_app'})`.** | Per Human Lead choice ("Bot registers it on boot"). Auto-updates when domain changes. | 29-04 '26 |
| 11 | **Ship `/eat` chat fallback alongside TWA.** Drop `/lunch` entirely. | Per Human Lead choice ("Yes, keep /eat as fallback"). | 29-04 '26 |
| 12 | **Accept Zero-Server Mandate transient breach for 30-min hashed location cache.** Mitigation: SHA-256 hashed chat ID, 30-min TTL, no append/history. | Per Human Lead choice ("Cache in Redis 30 min"). One-line rollback documented. | 29-04 '26 |
| 13 | **Pass `google_place_id` + `google_place_type` to `bot.sendVenue`** and build TWA InfoWindow links from `place_id` rather than `googleMapsUri`. | Telegram's coords-only fallback URL was opening Google Maps at raw lat/lng instead of the Place page. Reported by Human Lead with example URL. | 29-04 '26 |
| 14 | **TWA InfoWindow "Open in Maps" uses Google's documented Search-action URL Schema** `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` and `tg.openLink()` for external dispatch. | iPadOS Universal Links with both Google Maps + Apple Maps installed routed v0.4.1's `?q=place_id:` pattern to Apple Maps, which doesn't recognise `place_id` and degraded to coords. Documented schema with `query=<name>` keeps the name visible regardless of which Maps app handles the link. | 29-04 '26 |
| 15 | **iOS deep-link probe + install fallback for "Open in Google Maps".** Try `comgooglemaps://` URL scheme; if `visibilitychange` doesn't fire within 1500 ms the app is not installed → prompt user via `tg.showConfirm` to install from App Store or fall back to documented HTTPS URL. | Per Human Lead requirement "Google map must be installed, detect if not." Universal Links can still route HTTPS to Apple Maps; URL scheme bypasses that and reaches Google Maps app deterministically when installed. | 29-04 '26 |
| 16 | **AdvancedMarkerElement with HTML pins** showing venue name visibly + `gestureHandling: 'greedy'` + inline keyboard under each Sanctuary read with **📍 Open Map** (web_app, single-pin focus via `?placeId`) and **🚗 Directions** (Google Directions URL Schema). | Per Human Lead "Yes, all 3" approval of the strategy doc trio. Solves "anonymous pin" UX, two-finger gesture frustration, and the missing per-pick navigation affordance in one minor bump. | 30-04 '26 |
| 17 | **Quality filter — drop venues with `businessStatus !== 'OPERATIONAL'` or `currentOpeningHours.openNow === false`.** Applied in both `vibe.js fetchPlaces` (cached listings) and `vibe-suggest.js validateWithPlaces` (per-pick validation). | Per Human Lead's §103.12 "Safety Filter" instruction. Prevents permanently-closed and currently-closed venues from surfacing in `/eat` once Places API is reachable again. | 30-04 '26 |
| 18 | **Tranche A of `02_Expand.MD`:** brand rename Gia4lunch → soleat (Gia persona kept as in-message voice); new `/drink` and `/groceries`; Topic Gatekeeper for free-text via Gemini structured-JSON + 60 s SHA-256 cache; walking radius 300 m; last-30-day review filter in `vibe-summary.js`. | Per Human Lead "yes Tranche A" + (2) yes for the G4 gate on the additional Gemini call. Ships the unblocked subset of `instruction/02_Expand.MD`; Tranche B (Vault, /BusArrivalv2, MRT-stop expansion) deferred pending data inputs. | 30-04 '26 |

sections.heading: §§1–N — reproduced by reference
sections.body:
> _(open `doc/Technical/technical-0_60_157-14_05_26-1400.md` for the full prior decision catalogue — stack (Node/Express/Redis), Telegram Bot API, Google Places (New) v1, Anthropic Claude SDK + web_search, Gemini SDK, LTA / NEA / data.gov.sg, Vite + Tailwind for the five TMAs, Railway deploy, the `requireInitData` (header-only) middleware, `verifyInitData()` HMAC-SHA-256 against `WebAppData` per Telegram spec, the v0.59.x rate-limit pattern (`tell-gia:rl:<chatId>:<hour>` INCR+EXPIRE), the v0.60.142 `usage-log.js` aggregate-usage layer, etc. All live unless explicitly Deprecated.)_

sections.heading: §N+1 — New decisions (v0.60.158 → v0.60.172)
sections.body:
### T-164.1 — JB-region geo-fence widening (post-filter regex)

`index.js` post-filter for the JB region toggle relaxed from `/johor bahru/i` (literal "Johor Bahru" substring; matched JB City addresses only) to `/\bjohor\b/i` (word-boundary; matches any Johor state district — Pontian, Desaru, Kulai, Iskandar Puteri, Muar, Mersing, Batu Pahat, Kota Tinggi). KL / Selangor / Pahang still excluded because their addresses don't contain "johor". Plus an `insideSG` bbox helper so JB region toggling without a location pick still falls back to the JB_CBD anchor (vs. picked Johor coords that should be honoured).

**Rationale**: operator chose to widen JB scope across the whole state, not just the immediate city.

### T-165.1 — SG/JB radius defaults rebalanced

`searchRadius` (warm-start) + `DEFAULT_RADIUS` (main search) at the two call sites in `index.js`:

| Region | v0.60.163 | v0.60.165 first-pass | v0.60.166 (final) |
|---|---|---|---|
| SG | 50 km | (unchanged) | **20 km** (near-me focus) |
| JB | 18 km | 30 km | **30 km** |
| Slider max | 100 km | 100 km | 100 km |

**Rationale**: SG is dense — 20 km from any pin covers ~half the island; cross-island reach via slider. JB needs 30 km to cover JB City + Iskandar Puteri + Pasir Gudang + Senai/Kulai edges; far-Johor via explicit LocationField pick (T-164.1).

### T-165.2 — `places.allowsDogs` field-mask addition (Google Places New API)

`pipeline.js DISCOVER_FIELD_MASK` extended with `places.allowsDogs`. Mapped to `venue.allowsDogs` in the candidate payload. Used by the petFriendly post-filter on `/api/cuisine/search`. Strict mode: `v.allowsDogs === true`. Text-query fallback when strict < 3: prepend "pet friendly" to the cuisine modifier list.

**Cost**: one extra boolean per Places SKU response. Per-call billing impact negligible (Places SKUs are per-request, not per-field).

### T-167.1 — `/api/cuisine/*` auth chokepoint

New middleware `requireInitDataFromBodyOrHeader` in `twa-auth.js`. Reads `X-Telegram-Init-Data` header OR `req.body.initData` (accommodates the v2 TMA's `postJson` body-stuffed pattern). Mounted as `app.use('/api/cuisine', …)` once, before all `/api/cuisine/*` route declarations. Constant-time HMAC compare (`crypto.timingSafeEqual`). Dev bypass via `SKIP_INIT_DATA_AUTH=true` env var (strict-string check on `"true"`). 401 with generic body + IP/UA log on reject. 17 new unit tests in `__tests__/twa-auth.test.js`.

The 19 pre-existing inline `verifyInitData(req.body?.initData, …)` calls are preserved as defense in depth (simplification deferred to DF-56).

**Rationale**: operator's top security-hardening priority. Single chokepoint replaces the per-handler-remembering pattern; new routes inherit the gate automatically.

### T-170.1 — LocationField → state-sync contract

After the v0.60.166 / v0.60.170 two-step fix, the LocationField `onSelect` callback's contract is:

```js
onSelect({ lat, lng, label }) {
  setLocationAnchor({ lat, lng, name: label || '' });   // anchor commit
  setSearchCenter({ lat, lng });                         // v0.60.170 — keeps map + runSearch fallback in sync
  if (label.trim()) saveUserLocation({ lat, lng });     // bot /location cache
  // NO runSearch call — user's explicit Search FAB tap fires it
}
```

`runSearchAt(...)` (the helper that BOTH sets the anchor AND fires the search) is reserved for the map's "Search this area" control where immediate fire is expected.

**Rationale**: separates "I picked a place" (commit-only) from "I want to search" (explicit FAB tap) per operator.

### T-171.1 — `/legal` + `/privacy` body i18n migration

`/legal` (v0.60.169) and `/privacy` (already i18n since v0.59.x) bodies live in `i18n.js legal.body` / `privacy.body` (EN + FR). Both bodies fully replaced in v0.60.171 / v0.60.172 with operator-supplied copy + freshly-translated FR. `{operator}` placeholder dropped in both (LinkedIn now inline in the legal takedown paragraph; `OPERATOR_LINKEDIN` env var is a silent no-op for both commands — DF-60 if dynamic swap is later wanted).

**Rationale**: localisation + content control unified under i18n keys.

### `usage-log.js` (v0.60.142 — PR #379)

Redis-only, fire-and-forget, never throws. Per-user entries are one-way `sha256` hashes (`hashChatId` from `location-cache.js` — same scheme as `loc:`/`proc:`), used **only** to de-dup the aggregate counts; nothing else attached.

Keys:
- `usage:users` SET (no TTL; `SCARD` = total users since tracking shipped).
- `usage:dau:<YMD>` / `usage:search:<YMD>` / `usage:searchmulti:<YMD>` SET, 90 d (daily-active / searchers / "frequent ≥ 2 searches that day").
- `usage:cuisine[:<YMD>]` / `usage:criteria[:<YMD>]` HASH (cuisine + criteria popularity; `src:<chat-freetext|cuisine-tma|s|eat|surprise|cuisine-tma-back|cuisine-tma-recycle>`, `filter:<name>`, `price:<n>`, `region:JB`, `freetext`).

Exports `recordUser(redis, chatId)`, `recordSearch(redis, chatId, { cuisines, filters, prices, region, freeText, src })`, `getStats(redis, { date, days })`. Wired at every search call-site (`/api/cuisine/search` 'cuisine-tma' · chat free-text 'chat-freetext' · `runSearchCommand` 's' · `runFlow` 'eat' · `runSurpriseCommand[+WithFreeText]` 'surprise'). `/forgetme` (`user-data.js removeUsageMembership`) SREMs the user's hash from `usage:users` + SCAN+SREM every `usage:dau:*` / `usage:search:*` / `usage:searchmulti:*`.

### `cuisine-session.js` (v0.60.146 — PR #385; `skipCap` opt v0.60.149 — PR #389)

Per-Cuisine-TMA-launch session clipboard in Redis. **Distinct** from `clip:<chatId>` (`clip-store.js` — `/clip` 100-entry recall) and from `cuisine:seen:<chatId>:<criteriaHash>` (`index.js` — long-lived per-criteria dedup). Reset on every TMA mount via `POST /api/cuisine/session/start`.

Keys:
- `cuisine:session-seen:<chatId>` SET, 30 min TTL, cap **80 placeIds**.
- `cuisine:session-pages:<chatId>` LIST (LPUSH at head; LPOP at head), 30 min TTL, cap 10 page JSON blobs.
- `cuisine:session-meta:<chatId>` HASH, 30 min TTL (`started_at`, `last_search_at`, `total_served`).

Exports `startSession`, `recordPage(redis, chatId, payload, opts?)` (opts.skipCap=true for Michelin — page placeIds NOT added to session-seen SET; still LPUSH'd onto the history list), `popPage`, `seenCount`, `getSeen`, `isExhausted`, `depth`.

### `pipeline.narrateMichelinVenues({ candidates, lang })` (v0.60.147 — PR #386; prompt guard v0.60.149 — PR #389)

Narrate-only LLM helper (no re-ranking — `handleMichelinSearch` already filters/sorts its curated list). Returns a placeId-keyed `{ vibe, signatureDish, dishes }` map (defensive: drops hallucinated placeIds; truncates dishes to 3; never throws — failure / `llm.isReady() === false` / parse-fail → empty map for graceful degradation). Prompt explicitly says *"add narration to EVERY one — DO NOT drop any"* + *"reference the Michelin recognition correctly (no hallucination)"*. v0.60.149 tightened: dish fields are NAMES ONLY (`stripDishVerbs` regex strips "Order the …" / "Try the …" / "Have the …" / "Get the …" verb prefixes the LLM occasionally adds despite the prompt rule). FR localisation keeps iconic SG dish names un-translated.

### `web/oversight/` TMA (v0.60.142 — PR #379)

Vite/React/Tailwind scaffolded from `web/transport/` (`base: '/app/oversight/'`, build → `public/oversight/`). Single-screen dashboard at `App.jsx`: fetches `/api/oversight/stats?days=7` (or `?date=`) with `X-Telegram-Init-Data`; 401/403 → "Not authorised" screen; renders StatCards (total users / today active / today frequent), control buttons (This week 7d / Last 14d / 30d / Today only / `<input type=date>`), and bar-list sections (By day, By day of week, Top cuisines, Top criteria/filters, Top free-text words, Recent free-text), plus a `🔚 close` button.

### `doc/VibeCodingRecord/` (v0.60.143 — PR #380; expanded v0.60.144–148)

Regenerable per-PR cross-section — **deliberately NOT one of the eight `doc/` AU templates and NOT under the AU-1 append-only Recipe**. Files: `VibeCodingRecord.md` (schema), `vibe-coding-record.md` (Markdown view), `records.tsv` (TSV source of truth + raw `Title`), `generate.mjs` (pure generator, no network), `data/prs.ndjson` + `data/pr-files.tsv` (committed snapshots). The hosted page at **`/doc/vibe-journal.html`** (self-contained, embeds the full dataset) ships an Insights panel (likely-rework, churn-by-area, churn-by-module, PRs-per-release, category mix, time-based, small / low-effort PRs, indecision-cue PRs, behavioural KPIs, hard-parts) + a "lessons to reduce rework" list + a queryable ledger with full-text search + dropdown filters + sortable columns + per-row GitHub links.

### `vibe-journal-html.js` route gate (v0.60.144 — PR #381)

`/doc` + `/doc/*` honour the **Railway service variable `VIBE_JOURNAL_KEY`**. When set: `?key=<value>` URL query (correct key drops a 30-day `httpOnly` cookie `vibe_key` scoped to `/doc`) OR `X-Vibe-Key: <value>` header; missing/wrong → 401 with a small "🔒 Vibe Journal — enter the access code" form. When unset: public (default-open convention).

> Per `doc/CLAUDE.md` §3 + AU-1: supersedes `technical-0_60_130-11_05_26-2330.md` by reference. All prior architecture stands; this entry adds the v0.60.131 → v0.60.141 components — principally the free-text guard + dessert-drink keyword layer + identity-free search-term log, the `cuisine-family.js` relevance map and the `handleSearchTurn`/`runCookingMethodFanOut` above/below split it powers, the `escapeHtmlForTelegram` / R.E.D-ordering / HTML-escape fixes, the `createWaitStatus` re-use + hardening, the `pipeline.discover` / `/api/cuisine/search` `restaurantType` + `recentReview` plumbing, and the `BackFab` `closeOnly` prop.

sections.heading: Free-text guard, dessert/drink steering, search-term log (v0.60.131)
sections.body:
### `freetext-classify.js` (new)

- `looksLikeQuestion(text)` → bool. True on: a trailing `?`; or a leading interrogative/auxiliary from a tight set (`does/do/did/is/are/can/could/will/would/what/which/who/why/how/should/has/have/may/might/…` — `where` excluded) AND ≥ 4 tokens; or ≥ 5 tokens containing an "asking verb" (`sell/sells/serve/serves/have/has/stock/carry/offer/make/…`) mid-sentence. Tokenisation is `[^\p{L}\p{N}']+`-split, lowercased. Deliberately conservative — short dish/brand names ("fish and chips", "char kway teow", "What The Burger") never trip it.

### `dessert-drink-keywords.js` (new)

- `DESSERT_DRINK_TERMS` — a `Set` of ~150 normalised SG-relevant dessert + drink dish names (curated `DESSERT_TERMS` + `DRINK_TERMS`, lowercased + diacritic-stripped on read). `looksLikeDessertOrDrink(text)` → `{ term, kind: 'dessert'|'drink', venueKeywords[], primaryTypes[] }` | null — matches the curated set, or a few fragments (`ice cream`, `kaya toast`, `bubble tea`, `teh tarik`, …), or a suffix (`…cake/tart/pie/pudding/cookie/waffle/pancake/macaron/eclair/kueh/bingsu/…` → dessert; `…latte/frappe/smoothie/milkshake/shake` → drink); bails on > 6 words / > 48 chars. `dessertDrinkQuery(hit, cuisineLabel)` → `"<cuisineLabel?> <term> bakery cafe Singapore"` (dessert) / `"… <term> cafe Singapore"` (drink), capped 80 chars. `venueKeywords` (bakery / patisserie / kueh / dessert / kopitiam-ish name fragments) + `primaryTypes` (`bakery` / `cafe` / `dessert_shop` / `ice_cream_shop` / `coffee_shop` / `tea_house` / `food_court` / …) drive the dessert-specific above/below ranking.

### `freetext-log.js` (new)

- `logFreeTextQuery(redis, text, meta = {})` — fire-and-forget; no-op when `!redis.isOpen` or `text` is blank. Builds `{ q: text.slice(0,80), ts: Date.now(), src: meta.src || 'chat', chip: meta.chip === true, m: meta.matchedKnownTerm || null, n: Number.isFinite(meta.resultCount) ? … : null }` and writes it to a global capped list `freetext:log` (`lPush` + `lTrim 0 4999` + `expire DAY_TTL_S`) **and** a per-day list `freetext:log:<YYYY-MM-DD>` (`rPush` + `expire DAY_TTL_S`). **No chatId / user identifier in the entry.** `DAY_TTL_S = 90 * 24 * 60 * 60` (v0.60.132 — was 30 d). `dumpFreeTextLog(redis, n = 50)` → `lRange freetext:log 0 n-1` parsed, newest first (`n` clamped 1–500). Swallows all errors.

### `index.js` — wiring

- Chat free-text handler (in `bot.onText` for non-command text): after `looksLikePlaceQuery` and before the nation-overlay / R.E.D / misrep / cooking-method probes — `if (looksLikeQuestion(text)) { logFreeTextQuery(…, { matchedKnownTerm: 'question-declined', resultCount: 0 }); safeSend(t('freetext.questionDeclined', lang), { parse_mode: 'HTML' }); return; }`. Also logs (`matchedKnownTerm` = `'red-ambiguous'` at the R.E.D side-by-side return, `'cooking-method'` at the pivot return, `'red'|null` before `runFreeTextSearch`).
- `runFreeTextSearch` — `disambiguated = !!(ftCuisine || ftDishLabel)`; when `!disambiguated`, `dessertHit = looksLikeDessertOrDrink(text)` and `dessertQuery = dessertDrinkQuery(dessertHit, null)`; `pipeline.discover({ …, queryOverride: disambiguated ? text : (dessertQuery || undefined) })`; when `dessertHit`, a dessert-specific above/below ranking (above = `primaryType` ∈ `dessertHit.primaryTypes` OR name carries a `venueKeyword` OR name carries the term; below = rest) + `dividerAfter` / `dividerText`. (See "createWaitStatus re-use" below for the v0.60.139 "please wait" addition.)
- `/api/cuisine/search` — early: `ftRawIn = String(req.body?.freeText||'').trim()`; `if (ftRawIn && looksLikeQuestion(ftRawIn)) { logFreeTextQuery(…, { src:'cuisine-tma', chip, matchedKnownTerm:'question-declined' }); return res.json({ venues: [], questionDeclined: true }); }`. In the `ftQualifier` block: `dessertTmaHit = looksLikeDessertOrDrink(ftRawIn)`; if a hit, `cuisineQueries = [dessertDrinkQuery(hit, cuisineMetas.length === 1 ? cuisineMetas[0].name : '')]`; else the v0.60.126 qualifier-fold. Payload gains `dessert: dessertTmaHit`. Before `res.json(payload)`: `logFreeTextQuery(…, { src:'cuisine-tma', chip:hadCuisineChip, matchedKnownTerm: chipDisambig ? 'red' : misrepNote ? 'misrep' : cookMethodMatches ? 'cooking-method' : dessertTmaHit ? 'dessert-drink' : null, resultCount: dedupedTop.length })`.
- `/ftlog [N]` — `bot.onText(/^\/ftlog(?:@\w+)?(?:\s+(\d{1,3}))?$/, …)` gated by `isOwnerChat(msg.chat.id)` (silent log + return for non-owners); dumps `dumpFreeTextLog(redis, clamp(N, 1, 200, default 40))` as a `<pre>` block.

### `web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx`

- `questionDeclined` state; in `runSearch`, `if (r.questionDeclined === true) { setQuestionDeclined(true); setVenues([]); setMisrepNote(null); setCookMethodPivot(null); setComboInfo(null); setFirstLoadPending(false); return; }` else `setQuestionDeclined(false)`. A banner (`questionDeclined && !loading`) rendered above the misrep / cooking-method banners. The `dessert` payload flag is plumbed but not yet given its own banner.

---

sections.heading: `cuisine-family.js` (new — v0.60.135; extended v0.60.136, v0.60.138)
sections.body:
- **Families**: `east-asian` / `southeast-asian` / `south-asian` / `european` / `middle-eastern` / `latin` / `american` / `african`.
- `RESTAURANT_TYPE_FAMILY` — Google Places (New) v1 *cuisine-specific* restaurant `primaryType` → family (`chinese_restaurant` → east-asian, `german_restaurant` → european, `mexican_restaurant` → latin, …). Non-cuisine types (`restaurant` / `cafe` / `bar` / `bakery` / `pizza_restaurant` / `seafood_restaurant` / `fine_dining_restaurant` / `meal_takeaway` / …) are deliberately absent → no family.
- `CUISINE_FAMILY_RULES` — `[needles[], family]` pairs; `cuisineFamily(name)` normalises (NFD + diacritic-strip + lowercase + `_-` → space) then returns the first matching needle's family (specific demonyms before broad umbrellas). `UMBRELLA_NO_FAMILY` (`fusion`/`modern`/`international`/`western`/`asian`/`continental`/`halal`/…) → null. So "European"/"Czech"/"Slavic"/"German" → european; "Cantonese"/"Sichuanese"/"Japanese" → east-asian; "Thai"/"Peranakan" → southeast-asian; "Fusion"/"Western" → null.
- `restaurantFamily(primaryType)` → family|null; `cuisineFamily(cuisineName)` → family|null; `isLikelyMismatch(primaryType, cuisineName)` → true ONLY when both families are known and differ.
- `GENERIC_DISH_WORDS` (food-component nouns + prep/method words + search boilerplate); `distinctiveDishWords(dishPhrase)` → normalised tokens ≥ 3 chars not in `GENERIC_DISH_WORDS`; `FAMILY_DEMONYMS` (derived from `CUISINE_FAMILY_RULES`, ≥ 4 chars, dropping `"american (new)"`-style parentheticals); `familyDemonyms(family)` → array.
- `BAKERY_CAFE_DISH_WORDS` (quiche / tart / pie / pastry / croissant / scone / éclair / macaron / cake / cookie / brownie / bread / bagel / sandwich / panini / crepe / pancake / waffle / donut / pretzel / custard / flan / pudding / …) + `BAKERY_CAFE_VENUE_TYPES` (`bakery` / `cafe` / `coffee_shop` / `dessert_shop` / `dessert_restaurant` / `donut_shop` / `chocolate_shop` / `candy_store` / `confectionery` / `ice_cream_shop` / `tea_house` / `sandwich_shop` / `bagel_shop` / `breakfast_restaurant` / `brunch_restaurant` / `cat_cafe`) + `BAKERY_CAFE_NAME_WORDS` (strong bakery/patisserie name fragments — `bakery` / `bakeshop` / `bakehouse` / `patisserie` / `boulangerie` / `konditorei` / `pastry` / `cakery` / `confectionery` / … — NOT bare `cafe`). `looksLikeBakeryCafeDish(dishPhrase)` → bool.
- `venuePlausiblyServes(venue, { cuisineName, dishPhrase })` → bool. `fam = cuisineFamily(cuisineName)`; if `!fam` → `true` (don't demote umbrella/unknown). Else true iff: `name.includes(normalisedCuisineName)` (≥ 4 chars); OR any `distinctiveDishWords(dishPhrase)` token is in `name`; OR `restaurantFamily(venue.primaryType) === fam`; OR any `familyDemonyms(fam)` token (≥ 4 chars) is in `name`; OR (`looksLikeBakeryCafeDish(dishPhrase)` AND (`venue.primaryType ∈ BAKERY_CAFE_VENUE_TYPES` OR `name` carries a `BAKERY_CAFE_NAME_WORDS` fragment)). `name = norm(venue.name)` only — not the address (avoids false matches like "Singapore German Centre").

### `index.js handleSearchTurn` — single-query path (uses `cuisine-family.js`)

- After the resolver chain (R.E.D / technique short-circuit / Gemini intent — see "R.E.D ordering" below) and the nation-overlay / cooking-method checks, the single-query path: `searchVenuesByDish(intent.searchTerm, intent.cuisine||null, …)` → up to 6 venues; `dishPhraseForCard = cleanDishPhrase(intent.searchTerm || userText) || userText`; `plausible = (v) => venuePlausiblyServes(v, { cuisineName: intent.cuisine||null, dishPhrase: dishPhraseForCard })`; `aboveVenues = venues.filter(plausible)`, `belowVenues = venues.filter(v => !plausible(v))`; `ordered = [...above, ...below].slice(0,6)`; `aboveShown = min(aboveVenues.length, ordered.length)`, `belowShown = ordered.length - aboveShown`. Render each card via `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` (per-card `try/catch` → `N. **Name**\n📇 area` fallback) with `dishPhrase: i < aboveShown ? dishPhraseForCard : ''`. If `aboveShown > 0 && belowShown > 0` → insert `tn('freetext.divider', lang, { dish: esc(dishPhraseForCard) })` between the above-cards and below-cards in the `'\n\n\n'`-joined block. If `aboveShown === 0 && belowShown > 0` → prepend `tn('freetext.allBelow', lang, { dish: esc(dishPhraseForCard) })` and render all cards with no `dishPhrase`.

### `index.js runCookingMethodFanOut`

- `dishPhrase: venuePlausiblyServes(venue, { cuisineName: hit.cuisineLabel, dishPhrase: hit.term }) ? hit.term : ''` on each `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` call (was `dishPhrase: hit.term` unconditionally; v0.60.135 first used `isLikelyMismatch(...) ? '' : hit.term`, then v0.60.136 switched to `venuePlausiblyServes`).

sections.heading: `venue-templates.js` — `escapeHtmlForTelegram` alias (v0.60.133)
sections.body: - `module.exports` gains `escapeHtmlForTelegram: escapeHtml` (identical `& < >` escape). `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` (index.js) calls `require('./venue-templates').escapeHtmlForTelegram(...)` on its first line; without the export every call threw `TypeError: … is not a function` → callers with a per-card `try/catch` (`runCookingMethodFanOut`, and now `handleSearchTurn`'s single-query path) silently degraded to the name-only fallback; callers without one let the throw escape the `bot.onText` callback → `/s` went silent. Also fixes `index.js:867` (`${require('./venue-templates').escapeHtmlForTelegram(p.name)}` in the `/hidden`-ish header). New `__tests__/venue-templates.test.js` cases.

sections.heading: `index.js` — `runSearchCommand` / `handleSearchTurn` (v0.60.133, v0.60.134, v0.60.135 hardening)
sections.body:
- `runSearchCommand` wraps `await handleSearchTurn(chatId, arg, lang)` in `try { … } catch (err) { console.error('[Search] handleSearchTurn fatal:', …); safeSend(chatId, <EN/FR "search for X failed, try again">); }` — no `/s` turn can go silent regardless.
- `handleSearchTurn` (v0.60.134) — `disambig = gc.disambiguateTerm({ text: userText, ctx: { lang, locale:'SG', lastDisambig: conv?.lastDisambig } })` runs **first**. `let intent = null; let disambigDisclosure = null;`. If `disambig.kind !== 'none' && disambig.kind !== 'parent-cuisine'`: LOW-confidence-with-alternatives → render the side-by-side picker (`safeSend`), `sc.appendExchange(…, 'ambiguous')`, persist `setLastDisambig`, `return`; else if `disambig.searchSpec?.searchPhrase` → `disambigDisclosure = disambig.disclosure[…]`, `setLastDisambig`, `intent = { intent:'dish', searchTerm: disambig.searchSpec.searchPhrase, cuisine: disambig.chosen?.cuisine || null, why:'' }`. The technique short-circuit (`gc.lookupTechnique(userText)` → `runTechniqueFanOut`) and the Gemini `classifySearchIntent` step (+ the ambiguous-clarify branch) run only `if (!intent)`. Downstream: `const techEntry = (!disambigDisclosure && intent.intent === 'tool') ? gc.lookupTechnique(userText) : null;` and the cooking-method block is `if (!disambigDisclosure && cmMatches && cmMatches.length) { … }`. The unused `const axios = require('axios')` was dropped.

sections.heading: `i18n.js` — copy (v0.60.131 → v0.60.138)
sections.body:
- `freetext.questionDeclined` (EN/FR) — "🙂 I can't answer questions in free text yet. Type a dish or cuisine name (e.g. *chiffon cake*, *laksa*, *ramen*), or use /cuisine …" (`<i>` markup; `parse_mode='HTML'`).
- `freetext.divider` (EN/FR) — `⇩─ Eateries with similar dishes or cuisine ─ ⇩\n⇩─ not exactly {dish} ─ ⇩` (the `──` doubled dashes trimmed to `─` in v0.60.133; `{dish}` HTML-escaped at the call sites in v0.60.135).
- `freetext.allBelow` (EN/FR) — "⚠️ *No Singapore eateries clearly serve {dish} — these just matched your search words:*" (`<i>` markup).
- `privacy.body` (EN/FR) — the "Search terms" bullet (v0.60.131), reworded to "expires after 90 days" (v0.60.132), then replaced with the one-liner "Search and Selection are kept and expire after 90 days." / "Recherche et sélection sont conservées et expirent après 90 jours." (v0.60.137). `privacy-html.js` renders `privacy.body` verbatim → the hosted Privacy-Policy-URL page tracks it; `app.js`'s comment about `escapeHtmlForTelegram` is unrelated.

sections.heading: `cooking-methods.js` — `COMMON_DISH_LEADING_BLOCKLIST` (v0.60.131)
sections.body: - A `Set` of common food-component nouns, cooking-state adjectives, common fruit/veg/protein/drink words, and a few Western dish names. In `firstMatchInCuisine` (inside `findCookingMethodMatches`): an entry whose first token is in the blocklist no longer matches via the single-token-substring rule or the ordered-prefix rule (it still matches when ALL its tokens are present). Stops the v0.60.129 .md merge's `…paprika-stewing` / `ramen reduction` / `pizza stone-baking`-style compounds from making `/s ramen` / `/s pizza` / `/s chicken` / `/s beef` / `/s fish` / `/s rice` / `/s noodle` / `/s soup` / `/s curry` / `/s egg` / `/s tofu` fire the cooking-method pivot. Regression test block in `__tests__/cooking-methods.test.js`. (The pre-existing ordered-prefix quirk for genuine distinctive method words — `mohinga` → "mohinga broth-building", etc. — is intentional and unchanged.)

sections.heading: `createWaitStatus` — re-use + hardening (v0.60.139)
sections.body: - `createWaitStatus(chatId, lang, queryLabel)` now: `let msgId/timer/typingTimer/autoTimer/ticks/done`; `const finish = async () => { done = true; clearInterval(timer); clearInterval(typingTimer); clearTimeout(autoTimer); if (msgId) await bot.deleteMessage(...).catch(); … }`; `bot.sendMessage(initial).then(m => { msgId = m?.message_id; if (done) { if (msgId) bot.deleteMessage(...); msgId = null; return; } … typingTimer = setInterval(…,4000); timer = setInterval(…,15000); autoTimer = setTimeout(() => finish().catch(), 4*60*1000); })`. Returns `{ finish }`. Used by: `runTechniqueFanOut` / `runNationIconicFanOut` / `runCookingMethodFanOut` (pre-existing), and now `runFreeTextSearch` (created after `setProcessing`, `finish()`ed before `deliverPicks` / before the `bot.noresults` reply, and in the inner `finally` as a net) and `handleSearchTurn`'s single-query path (created before `searchVenuesByDish`, `finish()`ed before the final `safeSend`; the 4-min `autoTimer` covers the no-try/finally case).

sections.heading: `pipeline.js` / `index.js` — TMA card `restaurantType` + `recentReview` (v0.60.140)
sections.body: - `pipeline.js DISCOVER_FIELD_MASK` gains `'places.primaryTypeDisplayName'`; `discover()`'s candidate map gains `primaryTypeDisplayName: p.primaryTypeDisplayName?.text || ''` (pass-through). `index.js /api/cuisine/search`, in the existing `for (const v of top) { … delete v.regularPeriods; delete v.reviews; }` cleanup loop: `if (!v.restaurantType) v.restaurantType = humaniseRestaurantType(v.primaryTypeDisplayName, v.primaryType) || '';` (a Michelin-cross-ref-set `restaurantType` wins; `humaniseRestaurantType` falls back to humanising the `primaryType` enum — `thai_restaurant` → "Thai" — when the display label is absent); `if (!v.recentReview && v.reviews?.[0]?.text) v.recentReview = String(v.reviews[0].text).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,160);`; `delete v.primaryTypeDisplayName;`. `ResultCard.jsx` already renders both — no frontend change.

sections.heading: `web/cuisine/src/v2/components/BackFab.jsx` — `closeOnly` (v0.60.141)
sections.body:
- New prop `closeOnly`. When set: `hasHistory` is forced `false` (label always "🔚 end"); `onClick` calls `w.close()` (try/catch — webview tearing down) then a `setTimeout(() => { try { w.close(); } catch {} }, 350)` (Telegram occasionally ignores the first); if `w` is null (TMA opened outside Telegram), falls back to `history.back()`. `web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx` renders `<BackFab inline closeOnly />`. `web/cuisine/src/api/tg.js`'s native-`BackButton` handler is unchanged (`history.length > 1 ? history.back() : w.close()` — "back to the Menu hub" when launched from there is intentional).

technical.preamble:
# Technical — soleat v0.60.130 (delta entry)

> Per `doc/CLAUDE.md` §3 + AU-1: supersedes `technical-0_60_117-11_05_26-1600.md` by reference. All prior architecture stands; this entry adds the v0.60.118 → v0.60.130 components — principally the two `data/*.md`-backed lookup tables (misrepresented dishes; cooking methods by cuisine), the free-text dish-search relevance/divider machinery, the `/weather` expansion, and the Cuisine-TMA location-anchor / `/api/cuisine/search` `freeText` plumbing.

---

sections.heading: `/weather` expansion (v0.60.118)
sections.body:
### `weather.js`

- **Cached fetchers** (Redis-keyed, so the NEA feed is hit ≤ once per window regardless of pick/search volume): `getNowcastCached` (`nea:2h-nowcast`, 300 s), `getRainfallCached` (`nea:rainfall`, 60 s), `get24hCached` (`nea:24h-forecast`, 1800 s); new `fetch24hForecast()`.
- **Pure helpers**: `inSgBounds({ lat, lng })` (lat > 1.48 ⇒ a JB pick — skip NEA caveats); `WEATHER_ZONE_CENTROIDS` (W/N/C/S/E) + `zoneKeyFor(lat,lng)` / `zoneLabelFor(key)`; `resolveArea(text)` (free-text → `{ lat, lng, label }`: matches the ~47 NEA nowcast area names first, then the 5 broad zones + synonyms); `rainAlertFor(venue, { nowcast, rainfall })` (per-venue: "raining near {area} now" from a > 0.2 mm station, or "{desc} in {area}'s 2h outlook" when the nowcast for the nearest area is wet, else `null`); `headOutLine({ nowcast, rainfall })` (the interpreted lead line — raining / showery / good window); `tonightOutlookFor(venueOrZone, twentyFourH)` (picks the evening 24h period for the zone → "Tonight in the {zone}: {desc}"); `attachRainAlerts(redis, picks, lang, isRainSensitiveVenue, tn)` (best-effort: mutates `v.rainAlert` on rain-sensitive venues; any failure → no alerts, never blocks delivery).

### `venue-filters.js`

- `isRainSensitiveVenue(v)` → true for `primaryType` `food_court` / `market`, or a name/address match on `hawker` / `food centre` / `market` / `kopitiam` / `al-fresco` / `outdoor` / `rooftop` / `riverside` / `quay` / `waterfront` / `esplanade` / `pasar malam` / etc. Ordinary (likely-indoor) restaurants get no caveat — a rain line there is just noise.

### `venue-templates.js`

- `formatVenueBlock` renders `p.rainAlert` (one line, after the footfall row, before travel-time) when present.

### `index.js`

- `/weather` regex now captures an optional `<area>` → `runWeatherCommand(chatId, lang, areaArg)`. With an arg: `weather.resolveArea(areaArg)` (else a "I don't know that area …" reply); without: the cached pin (or SG centroid). The reply gains: a "— for {area} —" sub-line (when an area was given), the `headOutLine` lead, the existing temp / humidity / rain / wind / 2h lines, the 24h "🌙 Tonight in the {zone}" line, and the `tempC ≥ 33` air-con nudge.
- `deliverPicks` + `deliverSurprise` call `weather.attachRainAlerts` (best-effort) before formatting.

### `i18n.js`

- New EN + FR keys: `weather.areaUnknown`, `weather.forArea`, `weather.headOutRaining` / `headOutShowery` / `headOutGood`, `weather.hotNudge`, `weather.tonight`, `weather.rainNowNear`, `weather.rainSoonNear`.

### Tests

- New `__tests__/weather.test.js` (`inSgBounds`, `zoneKeyFor`/`zoneLabelFor`, `resolveArea`, `rainAlertFor`, `headOutLine`, `tonightOutlookFor`) + cases added to `__tests__/venue-filters.test.js` (`isRainSensitiveVenue`). +20 tests (1587 → 1607).

---

sections.heading: Cuisine-TMA location anchor + `POST /api/cuisine/set-location` (v0.60.119 → v0.60.120)
sections.body:
- **`web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx`** — `locationAnchor` is now the durable search anchor (nothing nulls it on `pagehide`/background, unlike `searchCenter`). `runSearch(snap, anchor, opts)` anchor chain: `anchor || searchCenter || locationAnchor || userLoc`. `runSearchAt(lat, lng, name)` also `setLocationAnchor({ lat, lng, name })` (so the map's "Search this area" pin also persists). The banner `locationName` effect keys on `locationAnchor ?? userLoc`: uses the anchor's `name` verbatim when present, else reverse-geocodes its coords, else the device / cached pin.
- **`web/cuisine/src/v2/components/LocationField.jsx`** — accepts `anchor`; resting label = `pickedLabel || (anchor.name when ≠ userLoc) || currentLabel || …`; the `×` clear button shows whenever a distinct anchor is active (not just right after a pick) and snaps back to the device pin.
- **`web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/api.js`** — `saveUserLocation({ lat, lng })` → `POST /api/cuisine/set-location`. Called from `App.jsx onSelect` **only** when the pick carries a non-empty label (a `×` clear / map pan / "Search this area" does not call it).
- **`index.js`** — new `POST /api/cuisine/set-location`: verifies `initData` (`twa-auth.js`), validates lat/lng, `setUserLocation(redis, chatId, lat, lng)`. So an explicit place pick becomes the user's `/location` across TMA sessions and into chat commands; map exploration leaves it untouched.

sections.heading: Bus features (v0.60.121)
sections.body:
- **`transport.js busArrivals()`** — now returns services **sorted by next-bus ETA** (services with no live next reading sink to the bottom; ties broken by service number, numeric where possible). The chat-side `formatBusArrivalsHtml` already re-sorted, so this is a no-op there and fixes the map InfoWindow order.
- **`public/app.js`** — the bus-stop map InfoWindow now band-groups the arrival rows the same way the chat reply does (`№ 145, 273, 120 — ≤5 min` instead of one row per service).
- **`index.js`** — the Bus menu's "🗺 Plan a route" button is now a direct `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&travelmode=transit` URL button (origin = device location in Maps; destination typed by the user). The `transport:bus:route` callback / `/transport busroute` text path is unchanged.

---

sections.heading: Free-text dish-search relevance + divider (v0.60.122 → v0.60.127)
sections.body:
### `index.js deliverPicks` — optional section divider

- New `opts.dividerAfter` (integer N) + `opts.dividerText` (string): when both are set and `0 < N < blocks.length`, the rendered list is split — `blocks[0..N)` then `dividerText` then `blocks[N..]`. No-op for every other `deliverPicks` caller.

### `index.js runFreeTextSearch` — `opts.cuisine` / `opts.dishLabel` / disambiguated ranking

- New `opts.cuisine` / `opts.dishLabel` (passed from the message handler when R.E.D's `disambiguateTerm` resolved the query, e.g. "goulash dumplings" → "Czech guláš with bread dumplings", European). When disambiguated: `pipeline.discover({ ..., queryOverride: text, maxResults: 15 })` feeds Places the anchored phrase verbatim (don't append `" cuisine restaurant"` on top of `"… restaurant Singapore"`); keep up to 20 survivors; score each venue:
  - **STRONG keywords** = the cuisine name + `getDishKeywords(cuisine)` (curated per-cuisine dish/demonym vocabulary) — a hit on the **venue name** (or a `<cuisine>_restaurant` `primaryType` match) ⇒ the venue self-identifies as that cuisine ⇒ **above the line** (`exact = true`).
  - **WEAK keywords** = generic words pulled from the dish *label* that aren't already strong ("bread", "dumplings" from "Czech guláš with bread dumplings") — a hit on these *alone* is a bare word-match (a Chinese 灌汤包 also "has dumplings") ⇒ **below the line**, where it just orders the tier (soft score). A strong word found only in a *review* is also a soft signal, not an above-the-line ticket.
  - `above` sorted rating → distance; `below` sorted soft-score → rating → distance; `venues = [...above, ...below].slice(0, 8)`; if `above.length > 0 && above.length < venues.length` → `dividerAfter = above.length`, `dividerText = trnBot('freetext.divider', lang, { dish: cleanDish })`.
  Plain free text (no disambiguation) keeps the distance order `filterFreeTextResults` produced, just shows up to 8 instead of 5.

### `cuisine-dish-keywords.js` — `european` keyword list

- New `european` entry: the broad category R.E.D assigns to Central/Germanic dishes (goulash → "Czech guláš with bread dumplings", schnitzel, …) — goulash-family dishes + accented variants + the relevant nationality / region demonyms (`czech, czechia, bohemian, moravian, slovak, hungarian, magyar, austrian, german, bavarian, polish, slavic, balkan, croatian, serbian, romanian, bulgarian`) + signature dish words (`knedlik, bread dumpling, svickova, trdelnik, kolache, langos, palacinky, schnitzel, spaetzle, pierogi, kielbasa, bratwurst, sauerkraut, pretzel, currywurst, rouladen, bigos, pelmeni, apfelstrudel, sachertorte, tafelspitz`) + distinctively Central/Germanic *eatery* name-words (`hospoda, pivnice, pivovar, brotzeit, gasthaus, gasthof, bierhaus, brauhaus, biergarten, ratskeller, csarda, bierstube`).

### `i18n.js freetext.divider`

- See the Amendments table in `journal-0_60_130` for the full reword chain. Final (v0.60.130) value: `'⇩── Eateries with similar dishes or cuisine ── ⇩\n⇩── not exactly {dish} ── ⇩'` / `'⇩── Établissements aux plats ou cuisine similaires ── ⇩\n⇩── pas exactement {dish} ── ⇩'` (`{dish}`-templated; two lines so line 1 doesn't wrap).

### Cuisine-TMA "Tell me" box → `freeText` (v0.60.126)

- `web/cuisine/src/v2/components/TellMePanel.jsx` — controlled `value`/`onChange`; the Enter→submit handler removed (search only via the → button / 🔍 Search buttons / FAB).
- `web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx` — `nlText` state (pre-fillable from a `/cuisine` deep-link's `freeText`); `runSearch` passes `freeText: nlText.trim()` to `searchCuisine`.
- `web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/api.js` — `searchCuisine` forwards `freeText` when non-empty.
- `index.js /api/cuisine/search` — `const ftQualifier = String(req.body?.freeText || '').trim().slice(0, 80); if (ftQualifier) cuisineQueries = cuisineQueries.length ? cuisineQueries.map(q => \`${q} ${ftQualifier}\`.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()) : [ftQualifier];` — so a typed qualifier steers the Places query (it already fed the criteria hash + the R.E.D disambig probe). `runFreeTextSearch` restores the `cleanDish` var (passed to the divider).

---

sections.heading: `misrepresented-dishes.js` — data/*.md-backed lookup table #1 (v0.60.128)
sections.body: - **Source** — `data/Misrepresented Dish Dessert Drink.MD` (operator-authored; 759 entries `Name - often assumed X, but actually Y.`; the first line is a usage note, not an entry — filtered by requiring a space-hyphen-space separator + a short name). - **Module** — reads the .md once at `require` time; `parseFile()` → `{ entries: [{name, desc}], byKey: Map, prefix: Map }`. `norm(s)` = NFD → strip combining diacritics → strip apostrophes → lowercase → punctuation→space → collapse. `singularizeLastWord(s)` = drop a trailing `s`/`es` on the last word (with `ss`/`us`/`is`/`ous` guards) so "goulash dumplings" matches "Goulash dumpling" and "fortune cookie" matches "Fortune cookies" — entries are indexed under both their normalised name and its singularised form. - **Lookup** — `lookupMisrepresentedDish(query)` → `{ name, note }` or `null`. Bails if the normalised query is blank, > 48 chars, or > 6 words. (1) exact / singularised exact `byKey` match; (2) a single-word query → the **unique** entry in `prefix` whose name starts with that word ("goulash" → "Goulash dumpling"). Never throws (the data file is read defensively). - **Wiring** — `index.js` chat free-text handler: after the R.E.D pre-step (skipped if R.E.D produced a disclosure) and the misrep step, `safeSend` an HTML `ℹ️ {name} — {note}` line (caller HTML-escapes name + note), then continue to `runFreeTextSearch` (the note doesn't change the search). `index.js /api/cuisine/search`: after the `chipDisambig` probe, if `req.body.freeText` matches and R.E.D didn't fire, `misrepNote = lookupMisrepresentedDish(ftRaw)`; `misrepresentation: misrepNote` on the payload. `web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx`: `misrepNote` state from `r.misrepresentation`; banner above `` (cleared on error). `i18n.js misrep.note` (EN/FR; `{note}` payload stays English). - **Tests** — new `__tests__/misrepresented-dishes.test.js` (parse count ≥ 700; exact / singular-plural / single-word-prefix lookup; accent/punctuation normalisation; junk guards). +11 (1607 → 1618). ---

sections.heading: `cooking-methods.js` — the .md merge + multi-match (v0.60.129 → v0.60.130)
sections.body:
- **Baseline (v0.60.12, unchanged on disk)** — `COOKING_METHODS` = a hand-curated `{ slug: [~30 method strings] }` literal for 70 cuisines; `tokenize` / `stripDiacritics` helpers; `isOrderedPrefix`; `findCookingMethod(text, opts)` (first hit; sticky-cuisine bias); `slugToLabel` / `getMethodsForCuisine` / `getCuisineSlugs`.
- **Merge (v0.60.129)** — at module load: `parseCookingMethodsMd()` reads `data/cooking method reference by cuisine.md` (sections `Cuisine — method1, method2, …`; the file's header sentences have no em-dash separator so they're naturally excluded). `MD_LABEL_TO_SLUG` maps the .md cuisine labels to the dict's slug convention (e.g. `'Sichuan' → 'sichuanese'`, `'Hong Kong' → 'hong-kong'`, `'Northeastern Chinese' → 'northeastern-chinese'`). `mergeMdCookingMethods()` (an IIFE): for each section, UNION the .md method list into `COOKING_METHODS[slug]` — existing tokens kept (existing wins on display order), new tokens appended, deduped by normalised (diacritic-stripped, lowercased, trimmed) form. **`MD_BARE_VERB_STOPLIST`** — a single-token .md term whose only token is a generic English cooking verb (`steaming`, `smoking`, `frying`, `pickling`, `roasting`, `braising`, … ~50 words) is dropped: a bare single-token entry false-matches any input containing the verb (the matcher's single-token rule is `userLower.includes(token)`). Multi-token compounds (`tea-smoking`, `deep-frying`, `charcoal grilling`) are unaffected (they tokenize to ≥ 2 tokens and require all to appear). Net: 94 cuisine slugs (was 70); per-cuisine method counts vary (≥ 20 — new .md-only cuisines like European / Dessert lose a few to the stoplist). New slugs: `hokkien, teochew, hainanese, hakka, shanghainese, hunan, northeastern-chinese, northwestern-chinese, hong-kong, macau, taiwanese, bengali, gujarati, jordanian, uzbek, eurasian, dessert, fusion, european, mediterranean, australasia`.
- **`findCookingMethodMatches(text, opts) → Array<{ slug, cuisineLabel, term }>`** — same matching rules as `findCookingMethod` (substring on a single-token term; all-tokens or ordered-prefix on a multi-token term; sticky-cuisine first), but collects ALL plausible cuisine hits — one entry per slug, in scan order (sticky first). Bails on blank / < 3-char / no-token input → `[]`. `findCookingMethod` is now `findCookingMethodMatches(text, opts)[0] ?? null` (semantics preserved — same first hit). New module exports: `findCookingMethodMatches`, `_MD_LABEL_TO_SLUG`, `_parseCookingMethodsMd` (alongside the existing `COOKING_METHODS`, `findCookingMethod`, `getMethodsForCuisine`, `getCuisineSlugs`, `slugToLabel`, `_stripDiacritics`, `_tokenize`).

sections.heading: Cuisine TMA search: deep pool + per-chatId accumulating exclusion + query-variant escalation
sections.body:
### `pipeline.discover()` — new opt-in params

- `maxPages` (default `1`) — when `> 1` and the cuisine text-search path is taken, after the first `places:searchText` call the function walks the response `nextPageToken` up to `maxPages - 1` more times and concatenates the `places` arrays. Field mask gains `nextPageToken`. Hard-capped at 3 (Google's text-search ceiling — ~60 results). The `searchNearby` path is untouched (no `pageToken` support there). Existing callers (default `maxPages: 1`) are unchanged.
- `queryOverride` (default `null`) — when a non-empty string is passed and cuisines are present, it is used verbatim as the Places `textQuery` instead of the v0.57.15 default `` `${cuisineQuery} cuisine restaurant` ``. Used by the escalation loop to switch phrasings.

### Redis keys (all prefixed with the verified Telegram `chatId`)

| Key | Type | TTL | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cuisine:seen:{chatId}:{criteriaHash}` | Set of placeIds | `SEEN_SET_TTL_S` = **12 h** | The accumulating exclusion: every venue ever shown for these criteria this session. Appended (and TTL refreshed) on every 🔍. Cleared by ↺ Start over or a criteria change (different hash). |
| `cuisine:pool:{chatId}:{criteriaHash}:v{variantIdx}` | JSON array of venue objects (raw `discover` output) | `POOL_CACHE_TTL_S` = **20 min** | The cached 3-page pool for one query-variant. First 🔍 of a window builds it (3 Google calls); re-clicks reuse it. If it expires the next click re-paginates the same query → same pool → dedup still works. |
| `cuisine:variant:{chatId}:{criteriaHash}` | integer string | `SEEN_SET_TTL_S` (12 h) | Which of the four query-phrasing variants the user is currently paging through (0…3). Bumped by the escalation loop. |

`criteriaHash` = `computeCriteriaHash({ cuisines, filters, prices, radius, region, freeText })` — sha256 truncated to 16 hex chars. Note it is **location-independent** (no lat/lng), so a coarse area is implied by the cuisine + region only; the 50 km SG-wide `locationBias` makes Google's results roughly SG-wide regardless, and the key is per-chatId anyway.

### Helpers (`index.js`)

- `cuisineSearchVariants(cuisineName)` → `[{ idx: 0, queryOverride: null }, { idx: 1, queryOverride: '<name> restaurant Singapore' }, { idx: 2, queryOverride: 'best <name> restaurant Singapore' }, { idx: 3, queryOverride: 'authentic <name> food Singapore' }]`. Returns `[{ idx: 0, queryOverride: null }]` (escalation off) for an empty name.
- `readSeenSet / appendSeenSet / resetSeenSet(chatId, criteriaHash)` — `sMembers` / `sAdd`+`expire` / `del`. `resetSeenSet` also `del`s `cuisine:variant:…` and `cuisine:pool:…:v0…v7`.
- `readVariantIdx / setVariantIdx(chatId, criteriaHash[, idx])` — `get` / `set … EX SEEN_SET_TTL_S`.

### `POST /api/cuisine/search` flow (single-cuisine path)

1. **`resetSeen` flag** — if `req.body.resetSeen === true`, `resetSeenSet(csChatId, computeCriteriaHash({…}))` before anything else, so the rest of the request starts from variant 0 with an empty seen-set.
2. **Discover branch (single cuisine)** — `cuisineDisplayName = cuisinesForDiscover.length === 1 ? cuisinesForDiscover[0] : ''`; `variants = cuisineSearchVariants(cuisineDisplayName)`; `cuisineSearchHash = computeCriteriaHash({…})`; `cuisineVariantIdx = readVariantIdx(...)`. Then a loop (capped at `variants.length`): for the current variant, fetch its pool — pool-cache HIT reuse (and slide its 20-min TTL); MISS → `pipeline.discover({ maxPages: 3, queryOverride })` + cache. If the *raw* pool has at least one placeId not in the seen-set, **or** it is the last variant → use it and break; else `cuisineVariantIdx++` and retry. Persist `cuisineVariantIdx` via `setVariantIdx`. (Multi-cuisine AND/OR and no-cuisine warm-start paths are unchanged; they set `cuisineSearchHash = ''` ⇒ escalation off, plain dedup downstream.)
3. **Filters** — `venueFilters.passesVenueFilter` + cuisine-name validation + haversine `distanceM` + 80 km gate + distance sort, all on the chosen pool (unchanged from prior versions).
4. **Dedup-slice** — `dedupHash = cuisineSearchHash || computeCriteriaHash({…})`; `seen = readSeenSet(...)`; `unseenVenues = venues.filter(v => v.placeId && !seen.has(v.placeId))`; `atLastVariant = !cuisineSearchHash || cuisineVariantIdx >= cuisineVariantCount - 1`; `dedupExhausted = venues.length > 0 && unseenVenues.length === 0 && atLastVariant`; `top = (unseenVenues.length ? unseenVenues : venues).slice(0, 12)`; `poolCount = |seen ∪ top.placeIds|` (cumulative distinct shown for these criteria).
5. **Enrich `top`** — crowd signal, footfall, dishes, Michelin annotation (unchanged).
6. **Append seen** — `appendSeenSet(csChatId, dedupHash, top.map(v => v.placeId))` (refreshes the 12 h TTL).
7. **Response** — `{ venues: dedupedTop, exhausted: dedupExhausted, poolCount, … }` (the `exhausted`/`poolCount` plumbing is from v0.60.115). Railway log line `D702 discover variantIdx=N/M returned K candidates`.

- `lib/api.j
