journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Operator: *"Doesn't show the back fab in cuisine when I tap the search fab. Is there a clipboard '/clipboard' for user?"*

- **[DELTA]**

  **Back FAB visibility fix (the real bug)**
  - Root cause: in v0.60.146 (PR #385) the ⇠ Prev button was nested inside `ResultPanel.jsx`'s existing `{totalPages > 1 && (…)}` strip — the *in-response* page nav for the 12-venue chunk. Since `/api/cuisine/search` returns exactly 12 venues per response and `PAGE_SIZE = 12`, `totalPages = 1` and the strip never renders → the back FAB **never appeared** on the standard "search → 12 results → ▶ for next 12" flow. This was a bug in the *placement*, not the back-FAB logic itself (the server endpoints + page-history Redis list are fine, verified by the v0.60.146 unit tests).
  - Fix: in `App.jsx`, the ⇠ Prev now lives as a **floating action button** in the existing fixed-position FAB column (above the 🔍 Search FAB), visible whenever `pageStackDepth > 0`. Same styling as the other FABs (`#7FDBDB` background, rounded-t-md + rounded-b-[14px], `w-7 h-7`). Tap behaviour is the same as before — POST `/api/cuisine/session/back`, replace `venues` with the previous page, decrement `pageStackDepth`, clear `exhaustedNote` + `sessionFull`.
  - The dead inline-strip branch in `ResultPanel.jsx` is removed (with a comment explaining the move). The props `pageStackDepth` / `sessionFull` / `onBackOnePage` are kept on `ResultPanel`'s signature for backward compatibility but no longer used inside the component.

  **`/clipboard` alias**
  - Added to the existing `bot.onText` regex (`index.js:1829`). The handler accepted `/clip` and `/cl`; it now also accepts `/clipboard`. Same behaviour — lists the user's last 50 cuisine clips, optional cuisine filter / index / `clear`.

Tap → previous list re-renders. Tap ▶ again → next list. Walks all the way back to the first list.

journal.title: [HDR] #112 | 17:00:00 SGT 13-05-26 | v0.60.147 | n/a kb | 1 PR
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Operator (Q&A confirmed answer): *"Full LLM narrate parity (vibe + whatToOrder)"* for Michelin cards — they should look like cuisine-chip / free-text cards (curated badge **plus** restaurantType + dishes + recentReview + vibe) instead of the skeleton they shipped at v0.60.142 (curated badge only). PR #376 / v0.60.140 restored `restaurantType` + `recentReview` for the non-Michelin path; the operator's "status cold" decision then deferred LLM narration. That deferral is now reversed for Michelin only (cuisine-chip path stays as-is to avoid Gemini cost regression there).

- **[DELTA]**

  **`pipeline.js` — new `narrateMichelinVenues({ candidates, lang })`**
  - A narrate-only variant of `rankAndNarrate` (no re-ranking — the Michelin path already filters/sorts its curated list 3★ → 2★ → 1★ → Bib Gourmand; we just want per-venue narration). The prompt explicitly says *"add narration to EVERY one — DO NOT drop any"* and *"reference the Michelin recognition correctly (no hallucination)"*. Uses the same `llm.generate` + `withRetry` + `extractJsonArray` plumbing as `rankAndNarrate`.
  - Returns a placeId-keyed map `{ placeId: { vibe, signatureDish, dishes } }`. The caller merges these into its venue array. Defensive: drops hallucinated placeIds (any placeId not in the input `candidates`). `dishes` is truncated to 3.
  - Failure modes — `llm.isReady() === false`, `withRetry` throws, `JSON.parse` fails, parsed result is not an array, or no good placeIds — all return `{}`. The caller's Michelin response still ships (curated badge + review-extracted dishes + recentReview from step 1 below). **Never throws.**
  - Localised: `lang === 'fr'` adds a French-locale prompt block + iconic-SG-dish whitelist (laksa / char kway teow / kaya toast / hokkien mee / …) so French narration keeps SG dish names un-translated.
  - Exported from `pipeline.js`'s `module.exports`.

  **`index.js` — `handleMichelinSearch` (lines ~5574–6010)**
  - **FIELD_MASK** (line ~5684) gains `places.reviews` and `places.editorialSummary`. Cuisine-chip path already fetches `reviews` via `pipeline.discover`'s mask; Michelin's separate `searchText` call now matches.
  - **Venue object** (line ~5736 onward) passes the `reviews` array through (kept until cleanup below) and converts `editorialSummary.text` to `googleSummary.overview` (≤ 320 chars) — matches the cuisine-chip path's shape.
  - **Step 1 — review-derived dish extraction + recentReview** (mirrors the inline block in `/api/cuisine/search` at line ~9057; slimmed down to keep this PR's blast radius small — no shared module yet, deferred): for each Michelin venue with `Array.isArray(reviews)`, run the same two regex captures + the same TRAIL_STOPWORDS + CATEGORY_BLOCK filters + capitalisation/length heuristics. Populates `v.dishes` (top 3) and `v.recentReview` (first ≤ 200 chars). Same 4-month window cutoff. Wrapped in try/catch; failure leaves the curated card alone.
  - **Step 2 — LLM narrate.** `pipeline.narrateMichelinVenues({ candidates: filteredVenues, lang: csLang })`. Merge: `v.vibe = n.vibe`, `v.signatureDish = n.signatureDish`, and **prefer LLM-curated dishes over review-extracted** when both present (`v.dishes = n.dishes.slice(0, 3)`). Try/catch; failure leaves step-1 fields intact.
  - **Cleanup.** `delete v.reviews` on every venue before the response is sent (the heavy payload was only needed for the local dish/narrate steps). `googleSummary.overview` is small enough to ship to the TMA (parity with the cuisine-chip path).

  **`__tests__/michelin-narrate.test.js` (new, 6 tests)** — exercises `pipeline.narrateMichelinVenues` with a stubbed `llm-client` + `gemini-retry`:
  - Good-response path → placeId-keyed `{ vibe, signatureDish, dishes }` map.
  - Hallucinated-placeId entries are dropped.
  - `llm.isReady() === false` → empty map (graceful).
  - Parse failure → empty map.
  - Empty `candidates` → empty map.
  - `dishes` truncated to 3 even when the LLM returns more.

  **`package.json` → `0.60.147`.**

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**

  ```bash
  (clean)
  $ npx vitest run __tests__/michelin-narrate.test.js
   Test Files  1 passed (1)

  $ npm test -- --run

        Tests  1706 passed (1706)
  ```

journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Operator: *"When I click 'search icon' FAB says Japanese,Korean cuisines, it will list results and continue to click # , after 3 or 4 click# , it is stuck with same list. Can you check did we lock in the maximum results, how many we allow and store, can you include 'back' to refer 'back' FAB icon to previous list until list #1 and invokes tracking. We should allow up to 120? Be robust in the functions to work as this is sensitive with Michelin criteria."* Refined by Q&A: cap = **80 per Cuisine TMA session** (not 120), held in a **temporary clipboard distinct from `clip:<chatId>`** (the existing 100-entry `/clip` recall in `clip-store.js`); the clipboard **resets each time Cuisine launches**; back-FAB walks back to the first list with tracking; especially sensitive for Michelin.

- **[DELTA]**

  **`cuisine-session.js` (new)** — Redis helpers for the per-Cuisine-TMA-launch session clipboard. Distinct from `clip:<chatId>` (`/clip` recall) and from `cuisine:seen:<chatId>:<criteriaHash>` (long-lived per-criteria dedup). Keys:
  - `cuisine:session-seen:<chatId>` SET, 30 min TTL, cap **80 placeIds** — the 80-cap, refused past 80 → terminal.
  - `cuisine:session-pages:<chatId>` LIST (LPUSH at head), 30 min TTL, cap 10 — JSON-encoded slim page payloads, newest at index 0.
  - `cuisine:session-meta:<chatId>` HASH, 30 min TTL — `started_at`, `last_search_at`, `total_served`.
  Exports `startSession`, `recordPage`, `popPage`, `seenCount`, `getSeen`, `isExhausted`, `depth`. All fire-and-forget; never throws (mirrors `usage-log.js`).

  **`__tests__/redis-stub.js`** — extended with list operations `lPush`, `lPop`, `lRange`, `lLen`, `lTrim`; `del`/`exists` also clear/check the lists Map.

  **`__tests__/cuisine-session.test.js` (new, 10 tests)** — `startSession`/`recordPage`/`seenCount`/`depth`/`popPage`/`isExhausted` against the in-memory redis-stub. Pins the 80-cap, the 10-entry page-list trim, the empty-batch skip, and the "popPage does NOT trim session-seen" navigation-aid invariant.

  **`index.js` — `/api/cuisine/search` (the hot path)**
  - **Multi-cuisine variant escalation.** `cuisineSearchVariants(cuisineNameOrList)` now accepts an array of cuisine names (e.g. `['Japanese', 'Korean']` → "Japanese + Korean" joined into the variant prompts). The single-cuisine gate at the call site is gone; both single- and multi-cuisine now escalate through the 4 query phrasings as the pool exhausts.
  - **Session-clipboard outer gate.** After `readSeenSet`, also fetch `cuisineSession.getSeen(redis, csChatId)`; `trulyUnseen = unseenInCriteria.filter(v => !sessionSeen.has(v.placeId))`. The silent fallback at line ~8915 (`top = (unseenVenues.length ? unseenVenues : venues).slice(0, 12)` — the "stuck on the same list" bug) is **replaced** by `top = trulyUnseen.slice(0, 12)`. When `trulyUnseen` is empty, `top = []` and `exhausted: true` flows naturally (no more silently re-serving the same 12).
  - **`sessionFull` flag** added to the response when the per-session 80-cap is reached. The terminal note flips to *"You've seen the 80 maximum for this session. Close and re-open Cuisine for a fresh session."* (EN / FR).
  - **`pageStackDepth` in every response** — server reports the current depth of `cuisine:session-pages:<chatId>` so the client can enable the ⇠ Prev FAB only when ≥1 prior page exists.
  - **`cuisineSession.recordPage`** runs on every successful search (slim payload only — placeId / name / lat / lng / rating / priceLevel / address / area) so the back-FAB has a history to walk.
  - **Michelin parity (this PR — wiring only).** `handleMichelinSearch` also calls `cuisineSession.recordPage` and exposes `sessionFull` / `pageStackDepth` on its response; the 80-cap therefore applies to Michelin pagination too.

  **`index.js` — new endpoints**
  - `POST /api/cuisine/session/start` — `verifyInitData` then `cuisineSession.startSession(redis, chatId)` (wipes seen + pages + meta). Never blocks the TMA — falls back to `{ ok: false }` on any error.
  - `POST /api/cuisine/session/back` — `verifyInitData` then double-`popPage`: the head of the list is the CURRENT page; pop it, then pop the one BEFORE it (the previous list shown to the user), re-push it so depth stays consistent and the next "back" can pop again. Calls `usageLog.recordSearch(redis, chatId, { src: 'cuisine-tma-back' })` so each back tap is tracked in Oversight. Returns `{ ok: true, page, pageStackDepth }` on success or `{ ok: false, atStart: true }` when the user has already gone back to the first list.

  **Frontend (`web/cuisine/src/v2`)**
  - `lib/api.js` — new `startSession()` and `backOnePage()` helpers.
  - `App.jsx` — on mount (right after `fetchCatalogue`), calls `startSession()` so the per-session clipboard is wiped every TMA launch. New `sessionFull` / `pageStackDepth` state plumbed from every `/api/cuisine/search` response. A `runBackOnePage` handler is passed to `ResultPanel`; it POSTs `/api/cuisine/session/back`, replaces `venues` with the returned page, decrements `pageStackDepth`, clears `exhaustedNote` + `sessionFull`. The terminal copy switches to the 80-cap message when `sessionFull` is true (EN + FR).
  - `components/ResultPanel.jsx` — accepts `pageStackDepth` / `sessionFull` / `onBackOnePage` props. A new **⇠ Prev** button is inserted into the existing pagination strip when `pageStackDepth > 0`; it sits to the left of the existing ◀ (intra-response page nav) so the user has two distinct rewinds: ◀ pages within the current 12 (existing behaviour), ⇠ pops back to the previous list (new).

  **`package.json` → `0.60.146`.**

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**

  ```bash
  $ node --check index.js cuisine-session.js
  (clean)
  $ npx vitest run __tests__/cuisine-session.test.js
   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  10 passed (10)
  $ npm test -- --run
   Test Files  53 passed (53)
        Tests  1700 passed (1700)
  $ cd web/cuisine && npm run build
  ✓ built  (../../public/cuisine/…)
  ```

- **[STATUS]** STAGED → PROD on next Railway deploy after squash-merge. Frontend rebuild already in `public/cuisine/` for the test plan post-deploy.

- **[TEST]** Post-deploy:
  - `/cuisine` → pick Japanese **and** Korean → 🔍 → 12 results (variant 0). Tap ▶ → next 12 (variant 0 page 2). Tap ▶ → next 12 (variant 0 page 3 or escalate to variant 1). Keep tapping; the multi-cuisine variant escalation now deepens the pool through "good Japanese + Korean restaurant Singapore" → "best …" → "authentic …". Around tap 7 the session-seen SET should reach 80 → terminal "You've seen the 80 maximum for this session." Then ⇠ Prev walks back through prior lists down to the first.
  - Switch to ✳️ Michelin → 🔍 → ▶ … the same 80-cap behaviour; curated badges intact (PR-C will add the LLM narrate parity).
  - Close & re-open `/cuisine` → session-seen wiped on mount; first ▶ returns fresh results.
  - Oversight TMA (the v0.60.142 dashboard): `usage:criteria` should show `src:cuisine-tma-back` incrementing on each ⇠ Prev tap.

- **[KNOWN GAPS]**
  - PR-C (v0.60.147) — Michelin full LLM-narrate parity (the asymmetric-cards report — operator wants `vibe` + `whatToOrder` on Michelin too) — follows.
  - The 30-min session TTL is server-controlled. A long pause + return to the TMA without re-mount will still resume the session (cookie-less); the mount-effect `startSession()` is the explicit reset.
  - `cuisineSession.popPage(redis, chatId)` does NOT trim the session-seen SET. Going forward after going back will not re-show the same venues (they remain dedup'd). The user accepts that — going "back" is a navigation aid, not a dedup reset.
  - Still owed (carried from v0.60.144): `doc/Feature/` + `doc/Technical/` + `doc/Register/` catch-up for v0.60.142 → v0.60.147; `vault/v0.60.147/` snapshot at end of arc; `doc/Legal/` aggregate-usage-counts clause.

journal.title: [HDR] #110 | 11:00:00 SGT 13-05-26 | v0.60.145 | n/a kb | 1 PR
journal.body: - **[INTENT]** Operator: *"In Cuisine TMA the copy all button in /cuisine still shows occasionally same error. Check past PR and compare with current source code, first. Plan well."* — diagnosis (via the Phase 1 Explore agent): the `/api/cuisine/copy-all` handler builds an HTML body and calls `bot.sendMessage(..., { parse_mode: 'HTML' })` **without a try/catch**. Telegram rejects the body when a venue name contains a stray `&` or `<`/`>` that doesn't pass through `escapeHtml` (or when the rare path `buildMapHashUrl` returns `null` because every slim venue lacked lat/lng) — the outer catch then 500s and the TMA shows the `err.copyFailed` alert ("Couldn't send to chat — try again"). Past PRs #231 / v0.59.26 (trim-loop), #234 / v0.59.29 (16 → 12 cap), #200 / v0.58.53 (enrichment fields), #202 / v0.58.55 (FR i18n) fixed the body **size** but never wrapped the send itself; the failure mode is therefore state-dependent and recurring. - **[DELTA]** **`index.js` `/api/cuisine/copy-all` (lines ~7383–7475) — wrap the sends + drop-the-button null-safety** - Both `bot.sendMessage(...)` calls are now inside `try { … } catch { … }`. On a Telegram parse-mode rejection (or any other rejection): log the Telegram-supplied `err.response.body.description`, then **retry once in plain text** — the body is stripped of ``/`` tags and HTML entities (`&` → `&`, `<` → `<`, `>` → `>`) are unescaped. The reply_markup (when present) is carried into the retry. If the plain-text retry also fails, the handler 500s with `{ error: 'send_failed' }` and a structured `[Cuisine] copy-all sendMessage retry failed` Railway log line — same visible surface to the TMA, but actionable. - `buildMapHashUrl(slim, …)` returning `null` (every slim venue lacked lat/lng so `buildSlim` returned `[]`) no longer 500s the whole copy. The handler now drops the inline-keyboard map button, appends a one-line `📍 Map unavailable for this set.` (EN) / `📍 Carte indisponible pour cette sélection.` (FR) footer via `trn('pick.mapUnavailable', reqLang)`, and sends the message anyway. 12 valid venues with one bad-lat outlier shouldn't take the whole copy down. **`i18n.js`** - New key `pick.mapUnavailable` (EN + FR). Renders only when the multi-pin path can't build a map button — single-venue copies are unaffected. **`__tests__/copy-all-html.test.js` (new, 5 tests)** - HTML escaping survives venue names containing `&`/`<`/`>` (e.g. `A & B ` → `A & B <Bistro>` inside `formatVenueBlock`). - The plain-text retry's inverse (`` stripped, entities unescaped) recovers the human-readable name. - Clean venue names round-trip through both paths. - `escapeHtml` smoke (null/undefined/0 handling) — guards against `escapeHtmlForTelegram` regressing into the silent-render class that PR #369 / v0.60.133 fixed. - The map-unavailable body assembly carries the footer and still contains every venue block. **`package.json` → `0.60.145`.** - **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]** ```bash $ node --check index.js && node --check i18n.js (clean) $ npx vitest run __tests__/copy-all-html.test.js Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 5 passed (5) $ npm test -- --run Test Files 52 passed (52) Tests 1690 passed (1690) ``` - **[STATUS]** STAGED → PROD on next Railway deploy after squash-merge. No frontend change — the TMA's existing alert path is unaffected; the retry happens server-side. - **[TEST]** Post-deploy: `/cuisine` → pick a cuisine that surfaces a venue with `&`/`'`/`<` in its name (e.g. "Cluck Cluck & Co", "M&M's", anything with `'`/`&` punctuation), tap **Copy all** → message arrives intact. Repeat against a small-radius search where some venues lack lat/lng → still gets the picks, no map button + the "📍 Map unavailable" footer. Railway log shows no `[Cuisine] copy-all sendMessage failed` lines for normal traffic. - **[KNOWN GAPS]** - PR-B (v0.60.146) — the session clipboard / back FAB / 80-cap / multi-cuisine variant escalation work — is the next PR in this arc and addresses the pagination "stuck on the same list" report. Not in this PR. - PR-C (v0.60.147) — Michelin full LLM-narrate parity (the asymmetric-cards report) — follows. - Still owed (carried from v0.60.144): `doc/Feature/` + `doc/Technical/` + `doc/Register/` catch-up; `vault/v0.60.147/` snapshot at the end of this arc; `doc/Legal/` aggregate-usage-counts clause. ---

journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Operator, across this session:
  - (a) "Create a hidden admin interface … [ Soleat/oversight ] ties to my ChatID. It is a TMA, I would like to have statistics like how many use have login since the beginning, frequent users (> 1) by today, date, day, week, day (specify), free-text words use, cuisine, criteria etc." → resolved via Q&A to: identity = sha256(chatId) hashes + aggregate counts only (no browsable user list); launch = a hidden `/oversight` chat command → inline `web_app` button; a "search" for the frequency metric = Cuisine-TMA search + chat free-text dish search + `/s` + `/eat` + `/surprise`; "total users" = anyone who ever sent the bot anything; no backfill.
  - (b) "Create a separate table with coding and AI prompt interactive queries & responses Schema contain all the PR from PR#1, capable to dissect and categorise into many perspectives. Features impact, code impact, etc." → and "All PRs #1–#379, from metadata"; perspectives = category + triggering intent + AI approach, feature & UX impact, code / module / TMA impact, data / privacy / legal / test impact; described as a "Vibe Coding Record management system".
  - (c) "Do you have a database system for me to query and learn … my intention is to learn from my interactions in every PR and how to improve next time to reduce the PR? … it should be a https://Soleat.net/doc/vibe-journal.html?" → the hosted query page + insights/lessons.
  - (d) "Can you create a secret key to prevent people from access this document without this code? The Railway Service variable: VIBE_JOURNAL_KEY" (operator then set a short numeric key in Railway).
  - (e) "Update the Journal every time a new PR is created and done." → this entry + the standing rule.

- **[DELTA]** Grouped by PR:

  **Hidden owner-only "Oversight" admin TMA + usage-tracking layer (v0.60.142 — PR #379)**
  - New `usage-log.js` — Redis-only, fire-and-forget, never throws. Per-user entries are one-way `sha256` hashes (`hashChatId` from `location-cache.js` — the scheme already used for `loc:`/`proc:`), used **only** to de-dup counts; nothing else attached. Keys: `usage:users` SET (no TTL, `SCARD` = total users since tracking shipped); `usage:dau:<YMD>` / `usage:search:<YMD>` / `usage:searchmulti:<YMD>` SET, 90 d (daily-active / searchers / "frequent ≥ 2 searches that day"); `usage:cuisine[:<YMD>]` / `usage:criteria[:<YMD>]` HASH (cuisine & criteria popularity — `src:<chat-freetext|cuisine-tma|s|eat|surprise>`, `filter:<name>` for truthy filters, `price:<n>`, `region:JB`, `freetext`). `<YMD>` = UTC `YYYY-MM-DD` (matches `freetext-log.js`). Exports `recordUser(redis, chatId)`, `recordSearch(redis, chatId, { cuisines, filters, prices, region, freeText, src })`, `getStats(redis, { date, days })` (totalUsers / today / byDay / byDayOfWeek averages / topCuisines / topCriteria / topFreeText [aggregated from `freetext:log:<YMD>`] / recentFreeText [`dumpFreeTextLog` 50] / a "since tracking began; no backfill; 90-day per-day data" note).
  - New `web/oversight/` — Vite/React/Tailwind TMA scaffolded from `web/transport/` (`index.html`, `package.json`, `vite.config.js` [`base:'/app/oversight/'`, build → `public/oversight/`], `tailwind.config.js`, `postcss.config.js`, `src/{main.jsx,App.jsx,tg.js,styles.css}`). `App.jsx` = the single-screen dashboard: fetches `/api/oversight/stats?days=7` (or `?date=`) with `X-Telegram-Init-Data`; 401/403 → "Not authorised" screen; renders StatCards (total users / today active / today frequent), control buttons (This week 7d / Last 14d / 30d / Today only / `<input type=date>`), and bar-list sections (By day, By day of week, Top cuisines, Top criteria/filters, Top free-text words, Recent free-text), plus a `🔚 close` button.
  - `index.js` — `require('./usage-log')`; hidden `/oversight` `bot.onText` (owner-gated via `isOwnerChat`, silent no-op for non-owners, open when `TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID` unset — like `/ver` / `/ftlog`; not in `setMyCommands`) → `bot.sendMessage` with an inline `web_app` button to `https://${webhookDomain}/app/oversight`; `app.use('/app/oversight', express.static(...))` + `app.get('/app/oversight', …)` (no-cache HTML) + owner-gated `app.get('/api/oversight/stats', requireInitData, …)` (403 unless `isOwnerChat(req.tg?.user?.id)`; `date` / `days` params; `usageLog.getStats`); `usageLog.recordUser(redis, msg.chat.id)` alongside `touchActivity` in the main message handler; `usageLog.recordSearch(...)` in `/api/cuisine/search` (after the lat/lng + question-decline guards, `src:'cuisine-tma'`), the chat free-text handler (before `runFreeTextSearch`, `src:'chat-freetext'`), `runSearchCommand` (`src:'s'`), `runFlow` (`src:'eat'`), `runSurpriseCommand` + `runSurpriseCommandWithFreeText` (`src:'surprise'`) — all `.catch(()=>{})` fire-and-forget.
  - `user-data.js` — `forgetUserData` also strips the user's hash from `usage:users` + SCAN-then-`SREM` from every `usage:dau:*` / `usage:search:*` / `usage:searchmulti:*` (the `usage:cuisine` / `usage:criteria` HASHes carry no per-user attribution → nothing to erase); new `removeUsageMembership` export; the "keys this module is aware of" comment updated.
  - `i18n.js` — `privacy.body` (EN + FR) gains an aggregate-usage-counts bullet ("Usage counts … are kept only as aggregate numbers. The per-user entries are one-way sha256 hashes used solely to de-duplicate those counts … removed on /forgetme and expire after 90 days.").
  - `package.json` — `build:oversight` added to the `build` chain (5 TMAs now); version → `0.60.142`. `.gitignore` — `public/oversight/` added (Vite build output, like the other four TMA dirs). `__tests__/redis-stub.js` — `sCard` + `hIncrBy` added. New `__tests__/usage-log.test.js` (9 tests). The `web/menu/` hub is **not** touched — the TMA stays hidden (no tile). A `doc/Legal/` entry recording the aggregate-usage-counts disclosure was left for the next doc/Legal pass (the `/privacy` body bullet ships now).

  **Vibe-Coding Record (`doc/VibeCodingRecord/`) + hosted Vibe Journal page (v0.60.143 — PR #380)**
  - New `doc/VibeCodingRecord/` — a standalone, **regenerable** cross-section of every PR (deliberately *not* one of the eight `doc/` AU templates and *not* under the AU-1 append-only Recipe — it's a derived view, regenerated wholesale from a metadata snapshot; the append-only narrative still lives in `doc/Journal/` + `doc/Register/`):
    - `VibeCodingRecord.md` — the schema: column legend, category taxonomy (feature / fix / refactor / copy / prompt-tune / docs / infra / test), feature-area list, the hosted-page description, refresh steps, caveats.
    - `vibe-coding-record.md` — the ledger as Markdown: summary tallies (PRs per category, per feature area) + one row per PR #1–#379. Auto-generated.
    - `records.tsv` — the same data as TSV (machine-readable source of truth + raw `Title`). Auto-generated.
    - `generate.mjs` — a pure generator (no network / no repo I/O outside this folder + `public/doc/`): reads `data/`, writes `records.tsv`, `vibe-coding-record.md`, `public/doc/vibe-journal.json`, `public/doc/vibe-journal.html`. Heuristic categorisation is title/body-driven.
    - `data/prs.ndjson` — committed snapshot of GitHub PR metadata (`{ n, title, state, merged, body-excerpt }` per line). `data/pr-files.tsv` — committed snapshot of `git log origin/main` (`<PR#>\t<files>` for every squash-merged `(#NNN)` commit ≈ #78 onward; earlier PRs predate that convention → no file list).
  - New `public/doc/vibe-journal.html` — a self-contained interactive page (the full dataset is embedded; works offline / `file://` too): KPIs; an **Insights** panel — likely-rework pairs (a `fix` / follow-up-cue PR with an earlier PR in the same feature area within the previous 8 PRs, linked to it), churn by feature area & by module, PRs-per-release (MAJOR.MINOR), category mix, same-day clusters; a **"lessons to reduce rework"** list distilled from `.claude/skills/gia-preflight/SKILL.md`; and a **queryable ledger** — full-text search + dropdown filters (category / feature area / TMA / impact tag / release) + a "rework only" toggle + sortable columns; each row links to the GitHub PR and expands for modules / file count / burst membership. New `public/doc/vibe-journal.json` — the same records as `{ generated, count, records:[…] }` (for `jq` / DuckDB / pandas / spreadsheets).
  - `index.js` — `app.use('/doc', express.static(path.join(__dirname,'public','doc')))` + `app.get('/doc', …)` → redirect to `/doc/vibe-journal.html`. (Superseded same-arc by the gated routes in v0.60.144 — see Amendments.) `package.json` version → `0.60.143`. On the snapshot: 379 PRs (374 merged, 5 closed unmerged) — feature 250 / fix 53 / prompt-tune 25 / copy 23 / refactor 11 / docs 9 / infra 4 / test 4; 39 PRs flagged as likely rework. (No production logic changed beyond the static route — CI unaffected.)

  **Vibe Journal access gate — `VIBE_JOURNAL_KEY` (v0.60.144 — PR #381)**
  - `index.js` — the plain `express.static('/doc', …)` replaced by guarded `app.get('/doc', …)` + `app.get('/doc/:file', …)` routes (whitelisted to `vibe-journal.html` / `vibe-journal.json`). When the Railway service variable `VIBE_JOURNAL_KEY` is **set**, callers must supply it via `?key=<value>` in the URL (a correct `?key=` also drops a 30-day `httpOnly` cookie `vibe_key` scoped to `/doc`, so the in-page JSON link and the `/doc` redirect keep working without re-typing it), or the `X-Vibe-Key: <value>` request header (for `curl`); a missing/wrong key → `401` with a tiny "🔒 Vibe Journal — enter the access code" HTML form (light/dark). Responses are `Cache-Control: no-store` when gated, `public, max-age=300` when open. When the variable is **unset** the page stays public (the same default-open convention used by `isOwnerChat` etc.). The key lives only in the Railway variable — never committed; rotate by changing the value (takes effect on next deploy/restart). The served HTML embeds the full dataset, so the gate protects the *document* (and the `.json`), not individual fields. `doc/VibeCodingRecord/VibeCodingRecord.md` — an "Access gate (`VIBE_JOURNAL_KEY`)" section added. `package.json` version → `0.60.144`.

journal.title: [HDR] #108 | 15:30:00 SGT 12-05-26 | v0.60.131 → v0.60.141 | n/a kb | 11 PRs
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Operator, across this session: (a) "go through past PRs … what could we add" → the free-text search-term log discussion → "log identity-free; store [later: 90 days]"; (b) `/s` "not working" again — common dish words ("ramen", "pizza", "chicken", …) got hijacked into the cooking-method pivot after the v0.60.129 .md merge; (c) `/s goulash dumpling` silent → and then "make it resolve to Czech guláš"; (d) "the result doesn't use the standard template in free-text" + "no separation divider from exact to relevant" + "the 'try' line assumes the dish is available" (a Chinese dumpling house surfaced for "Czech guláš") → and again after the first fix ("still no divider"); (e) `/s Quiche Lorraine` listed hawker food courts with "Try quiche lorraine"; (f) "is there a 'please wait …' reply … in the free-text chat?" → no, so add it; (g) "where are the details … in Cuisine TMA? check previous PR" → restore the card's cuisine-type label + review snippet; (h) "I click 'end' in any TMA, especially Cuisine, it cannot close … is this a Telegram issue?" → mostly an app bug (the `history.length`-keyed back/close FAB) → fix it; (i) "review past PR, be 99% sure" → a hardening pass; (j) "create skills and procedural checklist to ensure these doesn't happen again"; (k) "[update] privacy document"; (l) re Photorealistic 3D Tiles: "dig deeper into what a full 3D-Tiles map would actually cost" → then "No. Status cold! No change."; (m) "Doc + Vault".

- **[DELTA]** Grouped:

  **Free-text: decline questions · steer dessert/drink terms · identity-free search-term log (v0.60.131 — PR #367)**
  - New `freetext-classify.js` `looksLikeQuestion(text)` — fires on a trailing `?`, or a leading interrogative/auxiliary (`does/do/is/are/can/what/which/who/why/how/should/has/have/…`; `where` deliberately excluded so "where is `<place>`" still works) with ≥ 4 words, or an "X sell/serve/have/stock Y"-style verb with ≥ 5 words. Conservative — "fish and chips" / "char kway teow" / "What The Burger" don't trip it. On a hit: chat replies `freetext.questionDeclined` ("type a dish or cuisine, or use /cuisine"); the Cuisine TMA returns `{ venues: [], questionDeclined: true }` → `App.jsx` shows a decline banner, no result list. Runs before the nation-overlay / R.E.D / misrep / cooking-method probes.
  - New `dessert-drink-keywords.js` — `DESSERT_DRINK_TERMS` (~150 SG-relevant: chiffon cake, ang ku kueh, ondeh ondeh, tau huay, chendol, ice kacang, mango sago, swiss roll, egg tart, kaya toast, durian puff, kopi, teh tarik, milo dinosaur, bubble tea, matcha latte, …) + suffix heuristics + `looksLikeDessertOrDrink(text)` → `{ term, kind, venueKeywords, primaryTypes }` + `dessertDrinkQuery(hit, cuisineLabel)`. `runFreeTextSearch` (chat) and `/api/cuisine/search` (TMA): when the typed text is a dessert/drink term, the Places query is steered toward bakeries / cafés / dessert shops / kopitiams (and the chat path adds a dessert-specific above/below ranking + `dessert: { term, kind }` on the TMA payload).
  - New `freetext-log.js` `logFreeTextQuery(redis, text, meta)` — identity-free: `{ q (≤80 chars), ts, src: 'chat'|'cuisine-tma'|'/s'-ish, chip, m: 'misrep'|'cooking-method'|'red'|'red-ambiguous'|'dessert-drink'|'question-declined'|null, n }` — **no chatId / user id**. Stored in a capped Redis list `freetext:log` (LPUSH + LTRIM, cap 5000) + a per-day list `freetext:log:<YYYY-MM-DD>`; fire-and-forget. New owner-only `/ftlog [N]` command (gated by `TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID`, like `/ver` — silent no-op for everyone else; open when the env var is unset) dumps the recent entries via `dumpFreeTextLog`. Logged at the chat free-text decline / R.E.D-ambiguous / cooking-method-pivot return points, before `runFreeTextSearch`, and on the `/api/cuisine/search` payload. `i18n.js`: `freetext.questionDeclined` (EN/FR); `privacy.body` gains a "Search terms — … kept *not linked to you* … no chat identifier" bullet (EN + FR). New `__tests__/freetext-classify.test.js` + `__tests__/dessert-drink-keywords.test.js`.

  **Search-term log retention 30 d → 90 d + privacy/Legal copy (v0.60.132 / v0.60.137 — PRs #368, #373)**
  - **v0.60.132** — `freetext-log.js DAY_TTL_S` 30 d → 90 d (the global capped `freetext:log` list also gets the TTL, refreshed on each write, so it self-clears after 90 days of inactivity — matching the existing `/privacy` "expires automatically after 90 days of inactivity" umbrella). `i18n.js privacy.body` (EN + FR) — the "Search terms" bullet says "expires after 90 days". New `doc/Legal/legal-0_60_132-12_05_26-0830.md` (per AU-1/AU-3: reproduces `legal-0_58_45-…` §§1–6 verbatim, adds the identity-free search-term-log clause to §3, the `freetext:log` / `freetext:log:<date>` 90-day rows to §4, and a §7 amendments table — L-2.1 the clause, L-2.2 30 d→90 d, L-2.3 back-records the stale `cuisine:search:*` 30 min → 30 s TTL). `doc/.serial-state.yml` `legal: 1→2`.
  - **v0.60.137** — `i18n.js privacy.body` (EN + FR) — the search-term bullet replaced with a plain one-liner: EN "Search and Selection are kept and expire after 90 days." / FR "Recherche et sélection sont conservées et expirent après 90 jours." (`privacy-html.js` renders `privacy.body` verbatim → the hosted Privacy-Policy-URL page tracks it).

  **`escapeHtmlForTelegram` export — fix thin cards / `/s` silence + trim divider dashes (v0.60.133 — PR #369)**
  - Root cause: `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` (the unified rich-card renderer for `/s` + chat free-text + the technique / cooking-method / nation-iconic fan-outs) calls `require('./venue-templates').escapeHtmlForTelegram(...)` on its first line — but `venue-templates.js` only exported `escapeHtml`. Every call threw `TypeError: … is not a function` → callers with a per-card `try/catch` (e.g. `runCookingMethodFanOut`) silently degraded to the `1. **Name**\n📇 address` fallback; callers without one (`handleSearchTurn`'s single-query path) let the throw escape the `bot.onText` callback → `/s` went **totally silent**. Fix: `venue-templates.js` exports `escapeHtmlForTelegram` as an alias of `escapeHtml` (identical `& < >` escape — also fixes `index.js:867`'s same call); `runSearchCommand` wraps `handleSearchTurn` in `try/catch` (friendly EN/FR "search failed, try again"); `handleSearchTurn`'s single-query path renders each card defensively (mirrors `runCookingMethodFanOut`). Also: `i18n.js freetext.divider` — the doubled box-drawing dashes `──` trimmed to a single `─` each side (operator: they wrapped / looked ugly). New `__tests__/venue-templates.test.js` cases asserting `escapeHtmlForTelegram` is exported, escapes `& < >`, handles null/undefined/numbers, equals `escapeHtml`.

  **`/s goulash dumpling` — R.E.D disambiguation runs first (v0.60.134 — PR #370)**
  - `handleSearchTurn`: the deterministic R.E.D `disambiguateTerm` pre-step now runs FIRST — before the technique short-circuit and the Gemini `classifySearchIntent` step. When the term is in `AMBIGUOUS_DISHES` it's authoritative: LOW confidence → render the side-by-side picker, no Places call (so bare `/s goulash` → the 🇭🇺/🇨🇿/🇦🇹 picker, matching the `/s` help copy); HIGH/MED → build a synthetic resolved `intent` from `searchSpec.searchPhrase` and skip the Gemini round-trip entirely (so `/s goulash dumpling` → search "Czech guláš with bread dumplings", with the disclosure header). The technique short-circuit and the Gemini intent step run only when R.E.D didn't resolve; `techEntry` fan-out and the cooking-method pivot are gated on `!disambigDisclosure` so a R.E.D resolution can't be overridden downstream. Dropped the now-unused `const axios = require('axios')` from `handleSearchTurn`. `__tests__/disambiguate-term.test.js` — "goulash dumpling" (no "with") → Czech HIGH/MED + non-empty `searchPhrase`; bare "goulash" @ SG → LOW with ≥ 2 alternatives.
  - (Note: a related earlier-in-session report — `/s` common dish words — was actually fixed in the v0.60.131 work? No: the `/s` "ramen/pizza/chicken hijacked into the cooking-method pivot" was a *separate* issue addressed by the `cooking-methods.js` `COMMON_DISH_LEADING_BLOCKLIST` — which landed in PR #367's branch as part of v0.60.131. See `feature-0_60_141` and the Amendments note on `cooking-methods.js`.)

  **`/s` + chat dish search — above/below divider, on-cuisine "Try X", `cuisine-family.js` (v0.60.135 → v0.60.138 — PRs #371, #372, #374)**
  - **v0.60.135** — new `cuisine-family.js`: coarse cuisine-family buckets (`east-asian` / `southeast-asian` / `south-asian` / `european` / `middle-eastern` / `latin` / `american` / `african`) — `restaurantFamily(googlePrimaryType)` (e.g. `german_restaurant` → european), `cuisineFamily(label)` (e.g. "European"/"Czech"/"Slavic" → european; "Cantonese" → east-asian; umbrellas like "Fusion"/"Western" → null), `isLikelyMismatch(primaryType, cuisineName)`. `handleSearchTurn`'s single-query path splits the Places results into above-the-line (NOT a confident cuisine-family mismatch — or the venue name mentions the dish/cuisine) and below-the-line, reorders above-then-below, shows ≤ 6, inserts the `freetext.divider` line between the tiers when both are non-empty, passes `dishPhrase` to `formatTechniqueVenueBlock` **only** for above venues ("🍽️ Try X" never on a text-match-only card), and prepends a plain `freetext.allBelow` caveat when everything is below the line. `runCookingMethodFanOut` gets the same gate on its "🍽️ Try `<method>`" line. `i18n.js freetext.allBelow` (EN/FR). New `.claude/skills/gia-preflight/SKILL.md` — a pre-commit/pre-PR safety checklist skill (invoke with `/gia-preflight`) codifying this session's failure modes (missing module export → silent render collapse; unescaped HTML interpolation; handler paths that `return` without sending / error-swallowing `catch`es; fuzzy matchers over-matching common queries after a bulk merge; resolver ordering deterministic-first; destructive git ops wiping WIP; plus `node --check` + `npm test` + version bump + re-read long functions + trace the actual render path). Review-hardening commit: HTML-escape the `{dish}` placeholder in the 3 `freetext.divider` call sites (one in `handleSearchTurn`, two in `runFreeTextSearch`) + the `🔎 Results for "…"` header in `runFreeTextSearch` (some carry raw user text — "fish & chips" would have broken the `parse_mode='HTML'` message). New `__tests__/cuisine-family.test.js`.
  - **v0.60.136** — the divider wasn't appearing: `isLikelyMismatch` only fired on a *confident* Google-primaryType-vs-cuisine contradiction, but Google tags dumpling shops / microbreweries with a generic `restaurant`/`bar` type → nothing demoted → every result classed "above" → no divider. New `venuePlausiblyServes(venue, { cuisineName, dishPhrase })` — "above" requires a **positive** signal on the venue NAME: it contains the cuisine name, a *distinctive* dish word (the dish-phrase tokens minus a generic-food/prep/boilerplate stoplist — so "dumpling"/"bread"/"with"/"fried" don't count; "czech"/"guláš"/"schnitzel"/"laksa"/"rendang" do), or a demonym of the dish's cuisine family (derived from `CUISINE_FAMILY_RULES`) — OR its `primaryType` is in that same coarse family. Umbrella/null dish cuisine → never demotes (conservative default). `handleSearchTurn`'s split and `runCookingMethodFanOut`'s "Try X" gate both switch from `isLikelyMismatch` to `venuePlausiblyServes`; `isLikelyMismatch` kept (still exported/tested). Added `familyDemonyms`, `distinctiveDishWords` exports + tests pinning the operator's `/s goulash dumpling` screenshot (Kapitan "Slavic Cuisine" above; the dumpling shops / microbrewery below).
  - **v0.60.138** — bakery/café dishes are cuisine-agnostic: `venuePlausiblyServes` gains a final positive-signal check — when the dish phrase names a bakery/café item (`BAKERY_CAFE_DISH_WORDS` — quiche, tart, pie, croissant, scone, éclair, cake, pancake, sandwich, bagel, …) a venue counts as plausible if its `primaryType` is a bakery/café type (`bakery` / `cafe` / `coffee_shop` / `dessert_shop` / `breakfast_restaurant` / …) OR its NAME carries a strong bakery/patisserie word (`bakery` / `bakeshop` / `patisserie` / `boulangerie` / `pastry` / `cakery` / … — *not* bare "cafe", which would over-promote e.g. "Cafe Iguana"). Only fires for bakery/café dishes ("/s ramen" still treats a bakery as below). So `/s Quiche Lorraine` → Choupinette + Tiong Bahru Bakery above with "🍽️ Try quiche lorraine", the divider, then Hawkers' Street @ ION + Lau Pa Sat below with no "Try". `looksLikeBakeryCafeDish` export + tests.

  **"Please wait" feedback on the free-text chat + `/s` single-query searches (v0.60.139 — PR #375)**
  - `runFreeTextSearch` (chat dish search) and `handleSearchTurn`'s single-query path each create a `createWaitStatus(chatId, lang, <query>)` before the Places call ("🔎 One moment — searching for eateries for X…", EN/FR, with the 15 s rotating reassurance + 60 s "did you mean something else?" nudge the `/s` fan-outs already had) and `finish()` it (delete the message) right before sending the results / "no results"; `runFreeTextSearch` finishes on every exit (deliverPicks, no-results, inner-`finally` net). `createWaitStatus` hardened: `finish` extracted to a named fn; a 4-minute `autoTimer` self-clean (so a caller that throws before `finish()` no longer leaks a `setInterval` editing a ghost "please wait" message); a `done` guard so a search that completes faster than the "please wait" message round-trips just deletes it instead of arming the timers.

  **Cuisine-TMA result cards — restore the cuisine-type label + review snippet (v0.60.140 — PR #376)**
  - The TMA's 🔍 Search hits `/api/cuisine/search`, which runs `pipeline.discover()` *without* the LLM narrate/rank step, so `restaurantType` / `dishes` / `vibe` / `recentReview` were never populated for plain (non-Michelin) venues → thin cards. This PR restores the two that need no LLM: `pipeline.js` adds `places.primaryTypeDisplayName` to `DISCOVER_FIELD_MASK` + passes it through `discover()`'s candidate map; `index.js /api/cuisine/search`, in the top-venue cleanup loop, sets `restaurantType = humaniseRestaurantType(primaryTypeDisplayName, primaryType)` ("Thai" / "Sushi" / …; falls back to humanising the `primaryType` enum; a Michelin-derived label wins) and `recentReview` from the first of the `reviews` we already fetch and then discard (≤ 160 chars). `ResultCard.jsx` already renders both — no frontend change. (Still missing for that path: the "🍴 What to order" line — needs venue-specific dishes, review-mining or the LLM narrate step — and `vibe` — LLM-generated, or Google's `generativeSummary` with a "Summarized with Gemini" disclosure; flagged in Deferred. Operator: "status cold, no change" on doing the LLM re-wire.)

  **Cuisine-TMA "end" FAB actually closes the Mini App (v0.60.141 — PR #377)**
  - `BackFab` gains a `closeOnly` prop; the Cuisine TMA passes `<BackFab inline closeOnly />`. With it the FAB is always "🔚 end" and always calls Telegram `WebApp.close()` — twice (~350 ms apart; `close()` is itself a bit flaky on Telegram Desktop/macOS and a repeat is a harmless no-op once the webview has shut). Root cause: `BackFab` (rolled onto every TMA in v0.60.55 / PR #311) toggles ⇠ back (`history.back()`) / 🔚 end (`close()`) on `window.history.length > 1` — meant for multi-page TMAs (the Menu hub); but the Cuisine TMA is an SPA that only `replaceState`s and is reached via `window.location.href = '/app/cuisine'` → the v2-app redirect, so `history.length > 1` is essentially always true on entry, leaving the FAB stuck in "⇠ back" mode where a tap the user meant as "end" did `history.back()` (pop the redirect entry / spin in place). The native Telegram header back button (`tg.js`) is left alone — its "back to the Menu hub" behaviour when launched from the hub is intentional. (Investigation also noted: `WebApp.close()` itself is not 100 % reliable on some clients/launch paths — the header X always works — so this only makes "end" *call* close() reliably instead of doing the wrong thing.)

  **This catch-up (v0.60.141 docs + vault)**
  - `doc/Feature/feature-0_60_141-12_05_26-1530.md`, `doc/Technical/technical-0_60_141-12_05_26-1530.md`, this journal, `doc/Register/register-0_60_141-12_05_26-1530.md` — the v0.60.131 → v0.60.141 delta entries.

  ```bash
  $ node --check index.js && node --check pipeline.js && node --check i18n.js \
      && node --check freetext-classify.js && node --check dessert-drink-keywords.js \
      && node --check freetext-log.js && node --check cuisine-family.js && node --check cooking-methods.js
  (clean)

  $ npm test -- --run
  Test Files  50 passed (50)
       Tests  1676 passed (1676)

  $ cd web/cuisine && npm run build
  ✓ built
  ```

journal.title: [HDR] #107 | 23:30:00 SGT 11-05-26 | v0.60.118 → v0.60.130 | n/a kb | 10 PRs
journal.body: - **[INTENT]** Operator, across this session: (a) expand `/weather` per the NEA-feeds discussion — a rain caveat on open-air picks, a `/weather ` "good window to head out?" answer, a 24-hour "tonight" line; (b) a location picked in the Cuisine-TMA Search-criteria builder must *lock in* (stop reverting to the device / `/location` pin) **and** update the banner label + the bot's `/location`; (c) bus: sort arrivals by ETA in the map InfoWindow, make "Plan a route" open Google Maps directly; (d) rename the Menu-TMA "Hawker" tile to "Hawker Centre, Food Centre"; (e) iterate the free-text dish-search result list so eateries that *actually serve* the typed dish sit above a divider and the looser Google text-matches below it — then reword that divider three times; (f) the Cuisine-TMA "Tell me" free-text box must feed the actual Places query (and Enter must not fire a search); (g) "read this, extract as a separate table for reference" → the `data/Misrepresented Dish Dessert Drink.MD` table wired into the free-text dish-search surfaces as an informational note; (h) "combine with existing cooking-methods.js + wire 'do you mean' pivot" → the `data/cooking method reference by cuisine.md` table merged into `cooking-methods.js`, with a "did you mean a cooking method?" tap-to-pivot on chat / Cuisine TMA / `/s`; (i) "ask in polite tone rather than 'did you mean'"; (j) reword the v0.60.127 divider to two operator-specified lines; (k) "remove the following words in result template … 'sanctuary picks'"; then: "append document. vault v0.60.130." - **[DELTA]** Grouped: **`/weather` expansion (v0.60.118 — PR #356)** - NEA-feed-backed, Redis-cached fetchers in `weather.js` (`getNowcastCached` 5 min, `getRainfallCached` 60 s, `get24hCached` 30 min; new `fetch24hForecast()`). Pure helpers: `inSgBounds`, `WEATHER_ZONE_CENTROIDS` + `zoneKeyFor`/`zoneLabelFor`, `resolveArea` (free-text → lat/lng via the ~47 nowcast area names then the 5 broad zones + synonyms), `rainAlertFor` (per-venue: "raining near {area} now" / "{desc} in {area}'s 2h outlook" / `null`), `headOutLine`, `tonightOutlookFor`, `attachRainAlerts` (best-effort mutator). `venue-filters.js` gains `isRainSensitiveVenue(v)` (food_court / market `primaryType` or a hawker / al-fresco / rooftop / waterfront name-or-address match). `venue-templates.js formatVenueBlock` renders `p.rainAlert`. `index.js`: `/weather` regex captures an optional `` → `runWeatherCommand(chatId, lang, areaArg)`; the reply gains the `headOutLine` lead, the 24h "🌙 tonight" line, the `tempC ≥ 33` air-con nudge, and a "— for {area} —" sub-line when an area was given; `deliverPicks` + `deliverSurprise` call `weather.attachRainAlerts` (best-effort). New `__tests__/weather.test.js` + `__tests__/venue-filters.test.js` (+20). `i18n.js`: `weather.areaUnknown`, `weather.forArea`, `weather.headOutRaining`/`Showery`/`Good`, `weather.hotNudge`, `weather.tonight`, `weather.rainNowNear`, `weather.rainSoonNear` (EN + FR). **Cuisine-TMA location anchor (v0.60.119 → v0.60.120 — PRs #357, #358)** - **v0.60.119** — a location picked in the Search-criteria `LocationField` is routed through `locationAnchor` (nothing nulls it on background) so it survives criteria-card collapses / FAB taps / TMA restore. `App.jsx`: `runSearch` anchor chain `anchor || searchCenter || locationAnchor || userLoc`; `runSearchAt(lat,lng,name)` also `setLocationAnchor(...)`. `LocationField.jsx`: accepts `anchor`; resting label prefers `pickedLabel || anchor.name | currentLabel`; the `×` clear shows whenever a distinct anchor is active. - **v0.60.120** — the banner "📍 {neighbourhood} · N nearby" effect now keys on `locationAnchor ?? userLoc` (uses the anchor's `name` verbatim, else reverse-geocodes its coords). New `POST /api/cuisine/set-location` (verifies `initData`, validates lat/lng, `setUserLocation(redis, chatId, …)`); `web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/api.js saveUserLocation`, fired from `App.jsx onSelect` only on an explicit place pick (a `×` clear / map pan / "Search this area" does **not** call it) — so the picked place becomes the user's `/location` across TMA sessions + chat commands, but casual map exploration doesn't clobber the saved pin. **Bus features (v0.60.121 — PR #359)** - `transport.js busArrivals()` returns services **sorted by next-bus ETA** (no-live-reading → bottom; ties by numeric service number) — a no-op for the chat reply (`formatBusArrivalsHtml` already re-sorted), fixes the map InfoWindow order. `public/app.js` bus-stop InfoWindow now band-groups arrivals (`№ 145, 273, 120 — ≤5 min`). "🗺 Plan a route" is now a direct `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&travelmode=transit` URL button (origin = device location in Maps; user types the destination) instead of a follow-up message; the `transport:bus:route` callback / `/transport busroute` text path still works directly. **Free-text dish search — "actually serves it" above the line + Menu tile (v0.60.122 → v0.60.127 — PRs #360–#363)** - **v0.60.122/123** — Menu-TMA "Hawker" tile renamed to "Hawker Centre, Food Centre" (`web/menu/src/i18n.js tile.hawker.label`, the one multi-word exception to the single-word-tile rule). `index.js deliverPicks` gains `opts.dividerAfter` (N) + `opts.dividerText` (splits the list into above-the-line / below-the-line; no-op for every other caller). `runFreeTextSearch` gains `opts.cuisine`/`opts.dishLabel` (passed when a R.E.D disambiguation resolved the query) → scores each venue against `cuisine name + getDishKeywords(cuisine) + dishLabel words`, splits into above (`score > 0`) / below (`score 0`), shows ~7–8, emits the divider after the above block; feeds the anchored phrase to Places via `queryOverride` when disambiguated. New `european` keyword list in `cuisine-dish-keywords.js` (goulash-family dishes + Central/Germanic demonyms). `i18n.js freetext.divider`. - **v0.60.124** — STRONG vs WEAK keyword split so the divider actually fires: STRONG = cuisine name + curated per-cuisine dish/demonym vocabulary + a `*_restaurant` `primaryType` match → above the line; WEAK = generic words pulled from the dish *label* ("bread", "dumplings") → a hit on these *alone* is a bare word-match → below the line (ahead of unrelated results, behind the real cuisine matches). `i18n.js freetext.divider` reworded (#1). - **v0.60.125** — one-line divider; a venue goes above only when its **name** carries a strong keyword (it self-identifies as the cuisine) or its `primaryType` is the cuisine's `*_restaurant` type; a strong word found only in a *review* is now a soft signal that orders the below tier. `cuisine-dish-keywords.js`: distinctively Central/Germanic *eatery* name-words added to `european` (`hospoda, pivnice, pivovar, brotzeit, gasthaus, gasthof, bierhaus, brauhaus, biergarten, ratskeller, csarda, bierstube`). `i18n.js freetext.divider` reworded (#2). - **v0.60.126/127** — Cuisine-TMA "Tell me" free-text box: controlled input (`TellMePanel.jsx`), Enter no longer submits (search only via the → button / 🔍 Search FABs); `App.jsx` lifts the box value into `nlText` state (pre-fillable from a `/cuisine` deep-link's `freeText`); `runSearch` passes `freeText: nlText.trim()` to `searchCuisine`; `web/cuisine/src/v2/lib/api.js searchCuisine` forwards `freeText`; `index.js /api/cuisine/search` folds `req.body.freeText` into the Places query (`cuisine=Portuguese + freeText="goulash dumplings"` → `"Portuguese goulash dumplings"`; no cuisine → the free text is the whole query; capped 80 chars). Two-line dish-search divider with the dish name on its own (second) line so line 1 doesn't wrap; `index.js runFreeTextSearch` restores the `cleanDish` var. `i18n.js freetext.divider` reworded (#3 — two lines). **Operator reference tables wired in (v0.60.128 → v0.60.130 — PRs #364, #365)** - **v0.60.128** — `data/Misrepresented Dish Dessert Drink.MD` (759 entries `Name - often assumed X, but actually Y`) → new `misrepresented-dishes.js` (parses the .md at module load into a `{ name, note }` map; `lookupMisrepresentedDish(text)` = exact-normalised match + last-word singular/plural fold + single-word prefix-disambiguation; bails on >6 words / >48 chars; never throws). Chat free-text handler `safeSend`s an `ℹ️ {Name} — {note}` line before `runFreeTextSearch` (only when R.E.D didn't itself disclose — no double note). `/api/cuisine/search` attaches `misrepresentation: { name, note }` to the payload when `freeText` matches. `web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx` renders a banner above ``. `i18n.js misrep.note` (EN/FR; `{note}` stays English — source data is English-only). New `__tests__/misrepresented-dishes.test.js` (+11). Distinct from `/s`. - **v0.60.129** — `data/cooking method reference by cuisine.md` (~70 cuisine sections, traditional verbatim method terms) **merged into `cooking-methods.js`** at module load (UNION into the existing chef-English `COOKING_METHODS`; existing tokens kept, new tokens appended, deduped by normalised form; bare single-token common verbs — "steaming"/"smoking"/"pickling"/… — filtered out via a stoplist so they don't false-match arbitrary input). The .md adds ~24 new cuisine slugs (`hokkien, teochew, hainanese, hakka, shanghainese, hunan, northeastern-chinese, northwestern-chinese, hong-kong, macau, taiwanese, bengali, gujarati, jordanian, uzbek, eurasian, dessert, fusion, european, mediterranean, australasia`) → 94 slugs total (was 70). New `findCookingMethodMatches(text, opts)` returns ALL plausible cuisine matches (one per slug, scan order); `findCookingMethod` is now `…Matches(text)[0]` (backward-compat). A "did you mean a cooking method?" tap-to-pivot keyboard (`buildCookMethodKeyboard`, callback `cookm::` / `cookm:L:` — text capped 40 chars to stay under Telegram's 64-byte limit; handler re-derives the match list) wired on: the chat free-text handler (after the R.E.D + misrep steps; skipped when R.E.D disclosed); `handleSearchTurn` (a verbatim single-cuisine method still fans out directly — the pre-v0.60.129 power-user path; ambiguous / non-verbatim → pivot); `/api/cuisine/search` (attaches `cookingMethod: { query, matches:[{slug,cuisine,method}] }`); `web/cuisine/src/v2/App.jsx` renders a banner with cuisine chip-buttons that prefill that cuisine into the criteria and re-run the search. `i18n.js cookmethod.didYouMean` / `cookmethod.literalBtn` (EN/FR). `__tests__/cooking-methods.test.js` extended (shape assertions relaxed to floors; +11). New `bot.on('callback_query')` branch for `cookm:`. - **v0.60.130** — copy round: the cooking-method pivot prompt is now politer ("🙂 Were you perhaps after a cooking method? Tap a cuisine below, or search literally." — chat / `/s` / the Cuisine-TMA banner; EN + FR); `i18n.js freetext.divider` reworded to the operator's two lines (`⇩── Eateries with similar dishes or cuisine ── ⇩` / `⇩── not exactly {dish} ── ⇩`); `index.js deliverPicks` header drops "sanctuary picks" → "Soleat's {label} picks" (EN) / "Sélections de Soleat · {label}" (FR). **This catch-up (v0.60.130 docs + vault)** - `doc/Feature/feature-0_60_130-11_05_26-2330.md`, `doc/Technical/technical-0_60_130-11_05_26-2330.md`, this journal, `doc/Register/register-0_60_130-11_05_26-2330.md` — the v0.60.118 → v0.60.130 delta entries. - `doc/.serial-state.yml` — counters bumped. - `vault/v0.60.130/` — frozen mirror at this commit (see `VAULT_README.md`). - `package.json` — bumped across the arc to `0.60.130`. - **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]** ```bash $ node --check index.js && node --check cooking-methods.js && node --check misrepresented-dishes.js && node --check i18n.js (clean) $ cd web/cuisine && npm run build ✓ built (App / index bundles emitted to public/cuisine/assets/) $ npm test -- --run Test Files 47 passed (47) Tests 1629 passed (1629) ``` - **[KNOWN GAPS]** - **"Did you mean" pivot is always-on for any cooking-method match in chat / TMA.** Only `/s` keeps the verbatim-single-cuisine fast path. Chat / TMA show the pivot even on an unambiguous single-cuisine hit (per the operator's "Better to check" instruction). If that proves too chatty, the `isUnambiguousVerbatimMethod` boundary in `handleSearchTurn` is the place to extend it to the other surfaces. - **The misrep table only adds a note; it never steers the search.** `goulash dumplings` is steered by R.E.D's `AMBIGUOUS_DISHES`, not by the misrep table; for the long tail (e.g. "fortune cookies → Japanese-American") there's no good way to steer Places, so the literal search runs alongside the note. By design. - **`/weather`'s "opened ≤ 100 days" — n/a here; that's the /surprise gate** (carried by reference from earlier journals). The `/weather` rain caveat only fires on rain-sensitive (open-air) picks; an indoor mall pick gets no rain line. - **The cooking-method `.md` merge filters bare common verbs but the pre-existing matcher still has an ordered-prefix quirk** — e.g. `findCookingMethod('smoking')` returns Sichuanese via the existing `'smoking with cypress'` entry's ordered-prefix rule. That predates this arc; not fixed here (out of scope). The merge stoplist only stops the *new* .md bare verbs from making it worse. - **"sanctuary picks" still appears in non-result-template copy** — the `/buddy` help text (`i18n.js buddy.on.body`, itself a retired user-facing feature), the "a friend shared a sanctuary pick" share message, two "couldn't find sanctuary picks" empty-state lines, and `public/app.js`'s status message. The operator's instruction scoped the change to the result template only. - **Cuisine-TMA `set-location` only fires on an explicit place pick** — a `×` clear, a map pan, or "Search this area" deliberately do **not** persist to `/location`, so casual map exploration doesn't overwrite the saved pin. - **ICA scrape, no queue counts, v0.60.101 chips, the v0.60.117 cuisine-search known gaps (single-cuisine-only escalation, 4 programmatic phrasings, per-chatId pool cache)** — unchanged known gaps from `journal-0_60_117`; carried by reference. ---

journal.title: [HDR] #106 | 16:00:00 SGT 11-05-26 | v0.60.107 → v0.60.117 | n/a kb | 9 PRs
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Operator, across this session: (a) lift the nav FABs off the screen edge; (b) "Soleat" not "Gia's" in pick headers, drop per-pick cards on multi-pick; (c) `/s` · `/search` empty-arg should always show the (operator-supplied) instruction, harden the `/s <dish>` fan-out; (d) retire `/buddy` as a user-facing feature (keep backend source); (e) `/s asado` disambiguation; (f) — the big one — make the Cuisine TMA's 🔍 Search "intelligent enough to know it wants new searching after seeing 60 eateries": cache results per ChatID, ensure the next set is genuinely new (exclude the previous), store a deep pool, escalate to wider query phrasings once exhausted, and only then offer ↺ Start over — "Fresh round should be after the last N places are listed regardless of TTL". Then: "Append and Update documentation. Vault v0.60.117."

- **[DELTA]** Grouped:

  **Cuisine TMA "never-repeat search" (v0.60.114 → v0.60.117 — the through-line)**
  - **v0.60.114/115** — per-chatId seen-set dedup (`cuisine:seen:{chatId}:{criteriaHash}`). Each 🔍 filters previously-shown placeIds; when nothing new remains the server stops resetting/reshuffling and returns `exhausted: true` + `poolCount`; TMA renders a sticky terminal note. (Also: `/s asado` disambiguation.)
  - **v0.60.116** — `pipeline.discover()` gains `maxPages` (walks Google `searchText` `nextPageToken` up to 3 pages, ~60 raw → ~30–50 after throttle); the 3-page pool is cached per-chatId (`cuisine:pool:{chatId}:{criteriaHash}`); `top` becomes the next 12 *unseen* venues from it; `SEEN_SET_TTL_S` 60 min → 15 min sliding.
  - **v0.60.117** — `pipeline.discover()` gains `queryOverride`; `index.js` gets `cuisineSearchVariants()` (4 ordered phrasings), `cuisine:variant:{chatId}:{criteriaHash}` index, per-variant pool cache key (`…:v{idx}`), an inline escalation loop in the single-cuisine branch (when a variant's pool is fully seen → bump variant, fetch the next phrasing's pool, serve its fresh batch on the same click), `resetSeen` request flag, and a reworked dedup-slice (`exhausted` only when the last variant's pool is also fully seen; `poolCount` = cumulative distinct shown). `SEEN_SET_TTL_S` 15 min → **12 h** (hygiene only — no time-based reset). Cuisine TMA: `searchCuisine({ resetSeen })`, `runSearch(snap, anchor, { resetSeen })`, a "↺ start over" link on the terminal note, new `result.startOver` + reworded `result.exhausted*` i18n (EN + FR). Single-cuisine path only; multi-cuisine AND/OR + no-cuisine warm-start unchanged.

  **Smaller items (v0.60.107 → v0.60.113)**
  - **v0.60.107** — nav FABs lifted above the screen edge / home indicator on all 4 TMAs.
  - **v0.60.108** — pick headers say "Soleat" not "Gia's"; `deliverPicks` drops per-pick cards when >1 pick.
  - **v0.60.109 → v0.60.112** — `/s` · `/search`: empty-arg always renders the operator-supplied instruction block (EN + FR); `/s <dish>` cooking-method fan-out hardened + progressive "please wait" interim message.
  - **v0.60.113** — `/buddy` user-facing surface removed (handler + callback commented out; Connect button, buddy footer, `/ver` line, `routeMenuCommand` case, `setMyCommands` EN+FR, `start.intro` / `privacy.body` / `forgetme.followup` mentions, `tile.buddy.label` all removed). Backend modules kept on disk, unreferenced. — G2 destructive action, operator-directed.

  **This catch-up (v0.60.117 docs + vault)**
  - `doc/Feature/feature-0_60_117-11_05_26-1600.md`, `doc/Technical/technical-0_60_117-11_05_26-1600.md`, this journal, `doc/Register/register-0_60_117-11_05_26-1600.md` — the v0.60.107 → v0.60.117 delta entries.
  - `doc/.serial-state.yml` — counters bumped.
  - `vault/v0.60.117/` — frozen mirror at this commit (see `VAULT_README.md`).
  - `package.json` — `0.60.116 → 0.60.117` (bumped in the v0.60.117 work commit).

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**

  ```bash
  $ node --check index.js && node --check pipeline.js
  (clean)

  $ cd web/cuisine && npm run build
  ✓ built (App / index bundles emitted to public/cuisine/assets/)

  $ npm test -- --run
  Test Files  45 passed (45)
       Tests  1587 passed (1587)
  ```

- **[KNOWN GAPS]**
  - **Escalation is single-cuisine only.** Multi-cuisine AND/OR searches keep the v0.60.116 behaviour (plain per-chatId dedup, no variant escalation). Follow-up.
  - **Four programmatic phrasings, not a curated dictionary.** `cuisineSearchVariants` builds `"<X> restaurant Singapore"` / `"best <X> …"` / `"authentic <X> food …"`. Google ranks these differently enough to surface ~20–40 non-overlapping venues each, but a per-cuisine alias / iconic-dish phrase set (e.g. Cantonese → "dim sum cha chaan teng Singapore") would do better. The `nation-overlay.js` `aliases[]` and `iconicDishes[]` arrays are the obvious source. Follow-up.
  - **Per-chatId pool cache, not shared.** Recommended a shared (criteria + coarse-area) pool for scale (≈100–1000× fewer Places calls + ~100× less Redis at 5000 users); operator chose per-chatId for now. A cron pre-warm of top-cuisine pools would bound Google calls by *cuisines* not *users* — also a follow-up. (See the Decisions table in `register-0_60_117`.)
  - **`criteriaHash` is location-independent.** Two chats searching the same cuisine+filters from different parts of SG share the conceptual "criteria" but each has its own per-chatId keys; the 50 km SG-wide `locationBias` makes Google's pool roughly SG-wide anyway, so the practical drift is small.
  - **ICA scrape, no queue counts, v0.60.101 chips** — unchanged known gaps from `journal-0_60_106`; carried by reference.

---

journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Per Human Lead 2026-05-11 (three asks in one message): (a) FR audit and fixes for everything yesterday + today touched; (b) update the doc system to cover the arc since `journal-0_60_41`; (c) freeze a `vault/v0.60.106/` snapshot. Six thematic sub-arcs in this period, vaulted together as `vault/v0.60.106/` since they close on the same day:

  1. **Menu TMA hub polish + tile shrink** (v0.60.42 → v0.60.71) — bus URL fix, /ver gating, /start trim, hawker labels, Menu hero/tile slim, dispatch keepalive, /location alias batch, compact tiles, empty-load fix, bus-stop popup polish.

  3. **Cuisine TMA combo cuisine + criteria preview** (v0.60.79 → v0.60.91) — Cuisine criteria preview line (replaces `1c · 0f` count), ice-blue FABs (later reverted to aqua), AND/OR combo cuisine search with banner fallback, name-validation tightening (Turkish + South Indian false-match fix), pills in header, square emoji set.
  4. **Cross-TMA navigation standardisation** (v0.60.92 → v0.60.98) — aqua FABs (#7FDBDB) across all 4 TMAs, ⇠ U+21E0 back glyph, text labels `back / end / ↑ top / ↓ down`, ⇣ ⇡ swap, "flip-to-top at bottom of page" via `atBottom` state, Train TMA: shrink current-status block, ticker tinted bg, "7 days" spelled out, Cuisine FAB swap (search above scroll), FR audit pass #1, Train TMA title rename, ticker title "Scroll to view another train line", `Open MRT Map` → `🇸🇬 Train Map and Status`, `View stations on map` → `View nearest {n} stations`, carpark Title Case helper.
  5. **Train TMA: LRT + auto-switch + popup status** (v0.60.99 → v0.60.100) — `All Lines` reset chip at start of scroll, one-shot PNG → Google Map auto-switch on first line chip tap (`useRef` guard added in follow-up per Codex P2), LRT lines included in default scroll (`LINES.filter((l) => !l.future)`), lighter scroll-panel border, station InfoWindow shows per-line train status, /transport train: surface LRT stations in nearest enrichment (`light_rail_station` added to `nearestMrtStations` includedTypes; 35 LRT-only stops added to `STATION_LINES`).
  6. **Traffic + /checkpoint + FAB shrink + FR audit + vault** (v0.60.101 → v0.60.106) — v0.60.101 cuisine-type label chips (reverted at v0.60.102 per operator), uncap `/traffic` incidents (Telegram chunking added), expand `/checkpoint` cameras via lat/lng bbox + drop `/causeway` alias, best-effort ICA queue scrape with explicit attribution + graceful fallback, shrink + lower FAB buttons across all 4 TMAs (`h-8 → h-7`, `bottom-4 → bottom-2`, `text-[11px] → text-[10px]`), FR audit pass #2 + transport TMA i18n module created + 4-TMA BackFab localisation + this journal + vault snapshot.

- **[DELTA]** Grouped by sub-arc. Heavy lifting in the per-PR commit messages on `main`; this journal preserves the arc-level intent.

  **Sub-arc 6: Traffic + /checkpoint + FAB shrink + FR audit + vault (the v0.60.106 close)**

  - `web/hawker/src/components/BackFab.jsx` + `web/menu/src/components/BackFab.jsx` — wire `useLocale()` + the new keys.
  - `web/hawker/src/App.jsx` + `web/menu/src/App.jsx` — wire `t('btn.fabTop/Down/...')` for the right-side scroll FAB.
  - `transport.js` — `CHECKPOINT_BBOXES` (Woodlands + Tuas, each ~3 km) replaces the 4-camera allow-list. New `fetchIcaCheckpointStatus()` scrape with cheerio + regex heuristics over ICA's public `trafficupdates` page, 60 s in-memory cache, graceful null on parse failure.

If ICA's HTML changes, the queue lines silently drop and the cameras still send.

journal.title: [HDR] #104 | 20:00:00 SGT 08-05-26 | v0.59.54 → v0.60.41 (catch-up arc) | n/a kb | 19 PRs
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Per Human Lead 2026-05-08 ("do the documentation, vault"): document the 42-version arc that landed between v0.59.53 (the cuisine-search-rotation + /hidden-variety milestone vault) and v0.60.41 (the embedded hawker-map + Anthropic-spend-cut milestone). Eight thematic sub-arcs in this period, vaulted together as `vault/v0.60.41/` since they close on the same day:
  1. **R.E.D ambiguity spine** (v0.59.54 → v0.60.4) — deterministic `disambiguateTerm` + `AMBIGUOUS_DISHES` seed dictionary + /s integration.
  2. **NATION_OVERLAY + multi-surface disambig** (v0.60.5 → v0.60.7) — 67-cuisine overlay, parent-cuisine umbrella, /s + free-text + /cuisine wiring, agemono Japanese routing fix.
  3. **Tier-2 + dedup + Michelin annotation** (v0.60.8 → v0.60.20) — Michelin curated tile + per-chatId search dedup + ResultPanel pagination strip + sticky cuisine + Tier-2 NATION_OVERLAY Phase 2 (28 cuisines).
  4. **Sticky cuisine + halal/veg + pagination polish** (v0.60.21 → v0.60.28) — `findNationIconic` stickyCuisine bias, Michelin Halal/Veg filter, dish-phrase clean, 3-button refresh shuffle, page-sync map.
  5. **/hidden grounding audit** (v0.60.29 → v0.60.33) — address-mismatch salvage, prompt hardening, distance pre-filter, `dropBlocksByName` haversine post-filter, "I found N" count rewrite.
  6. **Spend cut + special-command tidy** (v0.60.34 → v0.60.36) — Michelin sliceCap restored 24, /cuisine warm-start 12 → 8, search 24 → 12, /hidden EXACTLY 5, Claude tier 3 default OFF, /hidden out of public menu, /h alias dropped.
  7. **Menu rewrite + Michelin coverage** (v0.60.37 → v0.60.39) — 12-command canonical menu (EN + FR), `/share` → `/search` correction, Michelin pure 24 → 130, combo cap removed (full SG-table coverage).
  8. **Hawker multi-pin + embedded map** (v0.60.40 → v0.60.41) — `hawker-vault` reads `data/hawker-coords.json`, `/api/hawker/centres-by-region` exposes lat/lng, `scripts/fetch-hawker-coords.js` data.gov.sg fetcher, `HawkerMapPanel.jsx` embedded multi-pin map.

- **[DELTA]** Grouped by sub-arc.

  **Sub-arc 1: R.E.D ambiguity spine (v0.59.54 → v0.60.4, captured in `vault/v0.60.41/`)**
  - `gemini-client.js` — new `disambiguateTerm({text, ctx})` deterministic dictionary (no LLM). Returns `{kind, chosen, alternatives, confidence, isTourist, disclosure, searchSpec}`.
  - `gemini-client.js` — new `AMBIGUOUS_DISHES` seed list (≥30 entries): carrot cake (SG savoury vs Western dessert), bak kut teh (Teochew vs Hokkien), goulash (HU/CZ/AT), wonton (Cantonese/Sichuan), laksa (Penang vs SG), satay (MY/ID/SG), etc. Each entry has `{match[], kind, interpretations[]}` with per-interpretation `{id, label, cuisine, flag, defaultIn[], signals[]}`.
  - `index.js handleSearchTurn` — disambig pre-step before classifySearchIntent. HIGH/MEDIUM confidence override `intent.searchTerm` to `disambig.searchSpec.searchPhrase` + prepend disclosure. LOW confidence → render both interpretations, no Places call.
  - `search-conversation.js` — sticky-disambig threading via `setLastDisambig` / `lastDisambig` in conversation state.
  - `__tests__/disambiguate-term.test.js` — 34 tests covering schema, high/medium/low confidence, modifier dominance, locale defaults, sticky, tourist heuristic, language-of-query is NOT a nationality signal.

  **Sub-arc 2: NATION_OVERLAY + multi-surface (v0.60.5 → v0.60.7)**
  - `nation-overlay.js` — 67-cuisine overlay, each entry `{flag, aliases[], iconicDishes[], sharedWithNeighbors[], neighboringCuisines[], touristExplainer{en,fr}, populationInSG}`. Singaporean cap exception of 200 entries (dishes + drinks); other cuisines capped at 30.
  - `nation-overlay.js findNationIconic(text, opts)` — multi-tier match (exact → token-set → diacritic-strip).
  - `index.js handleSearchTurn` — `findNationIconic` shortcut before classifySearchIntent. Routes `/s milo dinosaur` → SG drink, `/s kaya toast` → SG food, `/s chilli crab` → SG food via `runNationIconicFanOut`.
  - Free-text chat path (`runFreeTextSearch`) — same `findNationIconic` short-circuit. Dinosaur Milo no longer hits "Jurassic World".
  - `cooking-methods.js` — 70 cuisines × 30 methods deterministic table for technique-mention queries (`/s mohinga` → Burmese, `/s tahdig` → Persian, `/s pörkölt` → Hungarian).
  - Agemono technique alias broken out from French `friture` parent (was routing /s Agemono to French venues) — now its own entry with `defaultOrigin=Japanese`.
  - 445 NATION_OVERLAY tests + 30 cooking-methods tests.

  **Sub-arc 3: Tier-2 + dedup + Michelin annotation (v0.60.8 → v0.60.20)**
  - `michelin-2025.js` — curated 130-entry SG Michelin Guide 2025 dataset (2 three-star + 7 two-star + 32 one-star + 89 Bib Gourmand). `findMichelinMatch(name, address)` 3-tier match (exact → postal → token-fuzzy). `formatMichelinLine(entry)` for chat / TMA card.
  - `index.js /api/cuisine/catalogue` — synthetic "✳️ Michelin List" tile pushed onto `getByCategory()` result. Two-Michelin-tile bug surfaced when the cached array got mutated in-place (fixed in v0.60.25/v0.60.22).
  - `index.js handleMichelinSearch` — branch on `michelin` slug. Per-chatId dedup so consecutive 🔍 taps surface a different slice. Star-tier sort (3-star → 2-star → 1-star → Bib Gourmand). Bib Gourmand shuffled within tier.
  - `web/cuisine/src/v2/components/ResultCard.jsx` — Michelin annotation row "✳️ Michelin · ⭐⭐⭐ · 2025" / "✳️ Bib Gourmand · 2025" rendered below the maps URL.
  - v0.60.18: cuisine pre-filter + chip/NL disambig + UX subtlety (tip-bubble shows once per session, cuisine-search bubble timing).
  - v0.60.19: TMA centering on anchored location (was: GPS) + `/hidden` distance-text rewrite (real haversine vs Gemini prose).
  - v0.60.20: Tier-2 Phase 2 — 28 additional cuisines (66 total in NATION_OVERLAY now), Chinese + Michelin parent-cuisine expansion, /hidden hang fix.

  **Sub-arc 4: Sticky cuisine + halal/veg + polish (v0.60.21 → v0.60.28)**
  - `nation-overlay.js findNationIconic` — accepts `opts.stickyCuisine`. When prior turn locked a cuisine, that cuisine's iconicDishes scanned first.
