  - `search-conversation.js setLastCuisine` — Redis-persisted per-chatId.
  - `michelin-2025.js` — `vegetarian: true` flag on Candlenut, Pangium, Thevar (the only validated vegetarian-friendly entries in SG 2025 starred).
  - `index.js handleMichelinSearch` — Halal / Vegetarian filter via curated `michelinHalal` / `michelinVegetarian` tags (returns empty rather than wrong-filter venues).
  - `index.js cleanDishPhrase` — strips "restaurant Singapore" boilerplate from /s "Try" line.
  - v0.60.22: cuisines-vault `getByCategory` returns a fresh shallow copy; ResultPanel pagination strip with `📄 X / Y` indicator.
  - v0.60.25: Fisher-Yates shuffle on dedup reset (cures "the 3 Search buttons cannot refresh").
  - v0.60.26: MIN_SURVIVORS=2 → 1 (deliver any verified survivor; only escalate when allDropped); visible escalation progress on tier 2/3 ("↻ Widening to 1.5–3 km…", "↻ Wider Claude web search (up to 90 s)…").
  - v0.60.27: server slice 12 → 24 so the TMA pagination strip renders.
  - v0.60.28: small floating FABs (w-8 h-8), trim in-pagination strip to ◀ 📄 ▶, page-sync map (markers rotate with active page).

  **Sub-arc 5: /hidden grounding audit (v0.60.29 → v0.60.33)**
  - `hidden-verify.js lookupVenue` — address-mismatch salvage path. When name match ≥ 0.7 but address tokens don't overlap, accept Places-resolved venue (was: hard reject).
  - `gemini-client.js HIDDEN_GEMS_PROMPT_TEMPLATE` — explicit "address must be copied verbatim from the venue's authoritative Google Maps listing" rule. Plus "HARD CONSTRAINT — DISTANCE" lifted out of EXCLUDE list to top of prompt with "if fewer than 3 venues exist within the band, return fewer (or zero) — saying 'I found nothing' is correct, returning a 6 km venue is wrong" instruction.
  - `hidden-verify.js parseBlocks` — extracts `claimedDistanceM` from Gemini's "approx X km" prose.
  - `hidden-verify.js verifyHiddenGemsOutput` — pre-filter blocks whose `claimedDistanceM` exceeds `opts.maxDistanceM * 1.2` (20 % tolerance) BEFORE Places lookup.
  - `hidden-verify.js dropBlocksByName(text, names)` — re-parses verified text, drops blocks whose `displayHeading` is in `names`, renumbers survivors, rewrites the "I found N hidden gems" prefix count to match. EN + FR.
  - `index.js runSurpriseCommand verifyAndFilter` — haversine-drops out-of-radius venues from BOTH text and venues array (was: only counted survivors). Pre-v0.60.33 the haversine filter only gated tier 2/3 escalation; out-of-band venues still appeared in delivered text.
  - `hidden-verify.js verifyHiddenGemsOutput` — rewrites Gemini's "I found N hidden gems" intro count to match post-Places survivor count (cures "found 4 gave 3" mismatch).

  **Sub-arc 6: Spend cut + special-command tidy (v0.60.34 → v0.60.36)**
  - **Anthropic burn audit** — Human Lead surfaced $30 spend on 08-05. Audit traced peak to /hidden tier 3 Claude (Sonnet + web_search_20260209, $0.05–0.10 per call) firing on the Coconut Club hallucination test cycle.
  - `index.js runSurpriseCommand` — Claude tier 3 gated on `HIDDEN_CLAUDE_TIER3=true` env (default OFF). Removes the highest-cost-per-call Anthropic surface.
  - `gemini-client.js HIDDEN_GEMS_PROMPT_TEMPLATE` — "Return up to 8 results. Aim for at least 5" → "Return EXACTLY 5 results." Reduces Gemini output tokens + verifier surface.
  - `index.js /api/cuisine/warm-start` — `pickTopN(venues, 12)` → `pickTopN(venues, 8)` so the first /cuisine open completes faster (less Places enrichment fan-out).
  - `index.js /api/cuisine/search` — slice cap 24 → 12 (each 🔍 Search tap returns 12; click again rotates dedup pool).
  - `index.js setMyCommands` — `/hidden` dropped from public command menu (joins `/legal` / `/ver` as "special commands"; bot.onText handler still accepts).
  - `index.js bot.onText` — `/^\/(?:hidden|h)/` → `/^\/hidden/` (alias `/h` removed; chat /h typos no longer trigger /hidden).

  **Sub-arc 7: Menu rewrite + Michelin coverage (v0.60.37 → v0.60.39)**
  - `index.js setMyCommands` — full rewrite to canonical 12-command menu per Human Lead's spec. Removed: `/search`, `/clip` from public menu (handlers retained). `/cuisine` description mentions "or /c"; `/location` mentions "or /l". EN + FR.
  - `index.js setMyDescription` — 508/512 EN, 509/512 FR. Lists the 12 commands + "Tap 🍴 Cuisine Picker to jump in." hint.
  - `index.js setMyShortDescription` — "Soleat — for Solo eats. Singapore dining concierge + a quick simple transport guide." (EN, 84/120). FR variant 78/120.
  - **/share → /search correction** — initial v0.60.37 menu listed `/share`. User clarified intent was `/search` (alias `/s`, the conversational dish/ingredient finder). Replaced. /share's handler stays in the bot but unlisted.
  - `index.js handleMichelinSearch` — pure-Michelin sliceCap 24 → 130 (full curated SG Michelin Guide 2025 dataset). Pagination strip renders 11 pages of 12.
  - v0.60.39: combo Michelin + cuisine sliceCap also uncapped (was 28). `sliceCap = pool.length` so every entry that survives `cuisineTagMatches` passes through to Places lookup. "Chinese + Michelin" expanded across 7+ regional sub-cuisine slugs now matches 30+ entries from the 130-row table without losing the tail.

  **Sub-arc 8: Hawker multi-pin + embedded map (v0.60.40 → v0.60.41)**
  - `hawker-vault.js` — `loadCoords()` reads optional `data/hawker-coords.json` (case-insensitive name-keyed `{lat, lng}` map). `loadAll` merges into each centre. Match-rate logged at boot.
  - `index.js /api/hawker/centres-by-region` — response now exposes `lat,lng` per centre (null when missing).
  - `web/hawker/src/i18n.js` — new `btn.viewAllOnMap`, `btn.openFullscreenMap`, `map.loading`, `map.nokey`, `map.noCoords`, `map.openInGoogleMaps`, `map.aria` (EN + FR).
  - `web/hawker/src/App.jsx` — when active region's centres carry coords, builds `/app/map#venues=<base64>` multi-pin URL; falls back to v0.50 Google Maps text query when absent.
  - `scripts/fetch-hawker-coords.js` — one-shot CLI fetching data.gov.sg `resource_id=d_4a086da0a5553be1d89383cd90d07ecd`, normalising name spelling, cross-referencing with the 123-centre vault, writing `data/hawker-coords.json`. Includes `--dry` flag for match-rate preview.
  - `web/hawker/src/components/HawkerMapPanel.jsx` (NEW, ~180 LoC) — embedded Google Maps multi-pin TMA mirroring `web/cuisine/src/v2/components/MapPanel.jsx`. AdvancedMarkerElement + PinElement; gold + 🆕 glyph for `isNew` centres, red + 🍚 for established. fitBounds on region tab change. InfoWindow on pin tap with name + address + "Open on Google Maps" CTA via `window.__giaHawkerOpenMap`. Phone min(420px, 50vh); tablet min(560px, 55vh). Graceful "coordinates not yet loaded" placeholder before the JSON ships.
  - External "View N on the map" button repurposed as "🗺 Fullscreen map ↗" when coords present (opens dedicated /app/map TMA).

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**

  - PR #284 v0.60.19 + PR #285 v0.60.21 + PR #286 v0.60.27 + PR #287 v0.60.28

journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Per Human Lead 2026-05-07 ("update documentation, full catch-up since v0.58.49"): document the 100-version arc that landed between v0.58.49 (the pre-FR baseline vault) and v0.59.53 (the cuisine-search-rotation + /hidden-variety milestone vault). - **[DELTA]** Grouped by sub-arc.

  - 270 keys snapshotted in `vault/v0.59.17/i18n-snapshot/STRINGS.md`.

  - **v0.59.30-39**: webhook-domain auto-fallback (soleat.net ↔ soleat.up.railway.app via probe + onSwitch listeners), African collapse (Ethiopian/Kenyan/Nigerian → African generic), Hong Kong + Macau under China Regional, Sri Lankan + Pakistani added, Slavic / Eastern European new bucket, Belgian + Dutch + Irish dropped + European generic catch-all added, /hidden hallucination guard (name-similarity match against Places via `hidden-verify.js` v0.59.39, NAME_FLOOR=0.5), Telegram menu-button refresh on host switch, /hidden free-text mode (`/hidden Tanjong Pagar MRT` → 200m-3km radius search).
  - **v0.59.40-44**: missing `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` returns `apiError` marker (was: silently dropped all blocks); dish-tail throttle (cap 2 per shared last-token like "porridge" / "rice" / "noodle") for "3 porridge in a row" clusters; broader Singaporean / Dessert / Fusion expansion picks (3→5); `/clip` command with filterable last-50 per-chatId clip history, 30 d TTL (`clip-store.js`).
  - **v0.59.45-50**: catalogue copy — "over 55 cuisines" replaces hardcoded "66 choices" across slash-menu + start intro EN+FR; distance-sort gated on `!skipCacheForShuffle` (was undoing `lightShuffle`); true Fisher-Yates `lightShuffle` (was tier-preserving, pinning ≥4.5★ at top); Australian + New Zealand merge to "Australasia" (v0.59.48) reverted in v0.59.49 after empirical web-search showed they're distinct SG categories; v0.59.50 fix `/c New Zealand` returning nothing — revert over-narrow "New Zealand Kiwi" override + don't pin empty cache + add `australasia` to `GATED_CATEGORIES` + add Australian / NZ / Australasia entries to `cuisine-dish-keywords.js`.
  - **v0.59.51-53**: Clear pill on collapsed Search Criteria header; empty-cuisine search now seeds a textQuery from a 7-seed pool ('highly rated restaurants', 'popular restaurants', 'best restaurants near me', etc.) routing through searchText (was: searchNearby with POPULARITY returning same 3 venues deterministically); /hidden max bumped 5 → 8 + diversify-across-categories clause in `HIDDEN_GEMS_PROMPT_TEMPLATE`.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  - 911 Vitest tests pass at v0.59.53 (was 781 at v0.59.17 baseline).
  - All 4 TMAs build clean (cuisine 147.23 kB gzipped 47.56 kB, others smaller).
  - Lockfile versions match `package.json` versions across all 5 workspace + 4 lockfiles.
  - `vault/v0.59.53/` snapshot at 463 files, regenerable via `cp -a vault/v0.59.53 /tmp/x && cd /tmp/x && npm install && npm test`.

- **[STATUS]** PROD code on `main`. Railway deploys from `main`. Merged PRs across the arc: #203-#258 + the v0.58.55 / v0.59.17 / v0.59.53 vault PRs. Specifically the v0.59.41 → v0.59.53 sub-arc landed PRs #246 (v0.59.41), #247-#258 (one per version), #259 (vault).

- **[TEST]** Reproducible by Human Lead on Telegram:
  - `/c` empty cuisines → 🔍 → tap repeatedly → ordering AND venue mix vary each click (was: same 3 venues).
  - `/c` Dessert → 🔍 → 8+ dessert venues across kueh / cake shops / ice kachang / etc.
  - `/c` New Zealand → 🔍 → returns WAKANUI / Magpie / Blackbird / Moa Tiki (subset). NOT zero.
  - `/c` Singaporean → 🔍 → 5 random dishes per call, per-chatId LRU memory excludes recently-shown picks.
  - `/hidden` (GPS) → 5+ distinct venues across categories (was 1-2).
  - `/hidden marina bay` → 5+ distinct venues, no longer pinned on The Coconut Club.
  - `/clip` → list of last 50 cuisine clips with cuisine filter; `/clip Italian` filters; tap "Resend N" reposts the original clip; `/clip clear` wipes after confirm.
  - Cuisine TMA result list collapsed criteria → Clear pill visible alongside the toggle.

- **[KNOWN GAPS]**
  - Telegram-side TMA bundle caching: users sometimes see an older v0.59.41 footer despite Railway redeploying. Force-close + reopen the TMA pulls fresh JS. No code-side fix possible without a service worker.
  - /hidden hallucinated addresses: `hidden-verify.js` drops blocks when name-similarity to Places is below 0.5, but partial-address hallucinations (e.g. "23 Beach Road" instead of the real "269 Beach Road" for The Coconut Club) sometimes pass through name-match. Not enough signal to fix at v0.59.53; tracked in Register.
  - Australasia + Australian + NZ small-pool reality: even with the gate fix, NZ in SG is genuinely sparse (~4-5 venues). When Places returns 0, /c NZ shows empty. SMALL_POOL bypass keeps the gate from over-filtering, but there's no rescue from genuinely zero matches.
  - Empty-cuisine seed rotation can occasionally return the same seed across rapid taps (1/7 chance per tap). Acceptable randomness.

- **[ADVICE]** The cuisine-search rotation arc is a textbook "fix-after-fix landed but the real bug was downstream" case study. v0.59.42 added `lightShuffle`. v0.59.43 added cache-skip. v0.59.46 ungated distance-sort. v0.59.47 made shuffle non-tiered. v0.59.52 routed empty path through searchText. Each fix addressed a real problem; the user reporting "same 3 venues" persisted because the *next* layer downstream was still deterministic. The lesson: when a bug "still persists" after a fix, audit ALL transforms between source and response, not just the one closest to the source.

journal.title: [HDR] #102 | 12:00:00 SGT 05-05-26 | v0.58.45 | n/a kb | n/a lines
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Long arc of Cuisine-Picker UX hardening, /hidden refactor to a single Gemini-with-Google-Search call, and operational latency / privacy fixes after deploy-time bug reports. Versions v0.54.0 through v0.58.45 (≈ 25 ships in 28 hours).

- **[DELTA]** Folded into thematic groupings rather than per-version walkthrough; cross-link by version where Human Lead's verbatim ask drove the change.

  ### A. /cuisine Cuisine Picker — UX hardening
  - **v0.58.10** — `/cuisine <args>` copy-syntax tokeniser. `/cuisine thai halal $$ @Raffles_Place radius:5 region:JB` round-trips through a URL-hash that the TMA reads. Recipient pastes the command, picker re-opens with the exact state.
  - **v0.58.16** — Default-OFF Halal/newlyOpened (was ON, polluted blank-state results). Warm-start fallback to highly-rated when narrow seed yields < 3.
  - **v0.58.17** — Tier-1 responsive layout (max-w 640 → 1024). Gives the map breathing room on tablet/desktop.
  - **v0.58.20** — Bounded geolocation resolution (5 s GPS timeout → server cache → SG centroid).
  - **v0.58.21** — 30-min staleness gate on cached location; cuisine TMA ignores stale anchors and asks for a fresh GPS reading.
  - **v0.58.23** — Always-on Share-pin keyboard for `/location`; no-args `/cuisine` location-status banner.
  - **v0.58.26** — **/cuisine zero-coord guard.** Railway-log evidence showed the TMA firing `/api/cuisine/search` with `center=0.0000,0.0000` because every userLoc setter accepted any non-null coord, including `{lat:0,lng:0}` from buggy initData / cache / GPS paths. New `isValidCoord()` rejects zero/NaN/out-of-range across all paths. Server `/api/cuisine/search` now 400s on zero-coord. The bot's `/cuisine` handler now pre-resolves cached location and deep-links it via `#lat&lng` so the TMA opens already anchored.
  - **v0.58.27** — Free-text noise-guard (`looksLikePlaceQuery`) so "hi"/"ok"/emoji-only doesn't trigger a 5-restaurant reply with buddy footer. Reverse-geocode hardening: SG_CENTROID short-circuit, natural-feature filter (`/catchment|reservoir|park|river/`), TTL 24h → 1h. Cuisine "New" chip now auto-re-searches on toggle (was waiting for explicit 🔍 Search).
  - **v0.58.29** — Six Cuisine Picker UI fixes: sub-cuisine drawer full-screen → centered modal popup; search-criteria card subtle accent tint; map "Show your location" 📍 recenter button; auto-collapse search criteria after results; "Collapse ▴ / Edit search ▾" pill; html font-size 16px → 17px (+1pt across the TMA).
  - **v0.58.31** — Shared `venue-filters.js` deny-list. Strips multi-tenant building names (Lau Pa Sat, Maxwell Food Centre, SAFRA, VivoCity, etc.) at the source. Patterns are start-anchored so stalls inside complexes ("Tian Tian @ Maxwell", "JUMBO Seafood — Riverside Point") still pass. Wired into `/cuisine` search + warm-start, NL path, free-text. Replaces three duplicate inline `NON_FOOD_TYPES` Sets.
  - **v0.58.32** — Tell-Me brand passthrough: typing "sushi tei" prepends the verbatim text as the first searchText query when it's brand-like (3-40 chars, ≤ 4 words, contains letters). Inferred cuisines follow as fallback. "japanese food in raffles place" still picks up `["Japanese"]`.
  - **v0.58.41** — Cuisine copy-syntax now accepts bare `/cuisine` (was 400'd when no tokens). Warm-start results are shareable.

  ### B. /hidden — refactored to a single Gemini call (the long arc)
  - **v0.58.22** — *(predates v0.53)* Hidden-gems C1+C3+C4 deterministic evaluator + Claude C2/C5 with webSearch. Replaced rarity-score-only path that surfaced popular places.
  - **v0.58.28** — **Full rewrite to Gemini-with-Google-Search.** Per Human Lead's spec, the entire C1–C4 evaluation, source verification, distance check, and chain blacklist are handled by a single grounded Gemini call. New `gemini-client.js` wraps `@google/generative-ai` with the spec prompt + `tools: [{ googleSearchRetrieval: {} }]`. Anchor verification: cached lat/lng reverse-geocoded; "Singapore" / catchment / reservoir / park results re-prompt the user to type a place name. Output is the spec format verbatim.
  - **v0.58.30** — `/hidden` progress pulses every 12 s with rotating lines so users see life past 20 s during the Gemini-with-Search call.
  - **v0.58.31** — `/hidden` prompt EXCLUDE block expanded with explicit hawker / clubhouse / mall rules. Reported as "too tight" by Human Lead → reverted in v0.58.32 (single "Shopping mall food court chains" line restored). Specific names handled deterministically server-side via `venue-filters.js` for cuisine flows; /hidden trusts Gemini's judgment.
  - **v0.58.33** — `searchToolForModel(model)` picks `googleSearch` (Gemini 2.x) vs `googleSearchRetrieval` (1.x) by version regex. Gemini 2.0 renamed the tool — using the wrong name produces an immediate 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT.
  - **v0.58.34** — 3-step fallback chain. User's GEMINI_MODEL + detected tool → user's GEMINI_MODEL + opposite tool → known-good fallback. `degraded` flag in the response surfaces a one-line "fell back to <model>" hint to the user.
  - **v0.58.35** — Replaced dead `gemini-1.5-pro` fallback with a chain `[gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-flash-latest]` after Railway logs showed the previous fallback target itself returning 404 on `v1beta`.
  - **v0.58.36** — `stripMarkdown()` removes `**bold**`, `__italic__`, `*single*`, ATX headings, backticks. Chunker regex relaxed `/(?=\n\d+\.\s+\S)/` so numbered headings starting with `**` (Gemini's emitted Markdown) still trigger a split. Output is now plain text.
  - **v0.58.37** — Tighten "hidden" definition: at-least-2 of {C1, C2, C3, C4} AND must include C1 OR C3. C2+C4 alone (popular + unique) is /cuisine territory. New EXCLUDE rule: > 300 reviews disqualifies unless C1 fires. Three template rows dropped per Human Lead: `Criteria met:`, `Confidence:`, `Sources:` block.
  - **v0.58.41** — Per-attempt deadline (60 s) + overall timeout (240 s); pulse cap at 10 (120 s coverage); "drafting the picks and citing sources" → "drafting the picks"; smart "Gemini overloaded — retry in a minute" / "/hidden timed out after 4 minutes" error messages instead of a debug dump when every attempt is 503.
  - **v0.58.42** — Tool regex now matches `*-latest` aliases as 2.x+. Dead `gemini-2.0-flash` removed from chain (Google retired it for new users). 503 transient retry: 2 s backoff + same-model retry within each attempt.
  - **v0.58.44** — **`thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget: 0`.** Web-research-validated finding from Google's own dev guide: dynamic thinking adds many seconds before the first token; setting it to 0 matches Gemini 2.0 Flash latency. Single biggest user-perceived speed win. Plus tightened `generationConfig` (`temperature: 0.3, topP: 0.8, maxOutputTokens: 3072`) and chain refresh `gemini-flash-latest → gemini-2.5-flash → gemini-2.5-flash-lite` (dropped slow 2.5-pro).
  - **v0.58.45** — Forbid fabricated `https://www.google.com/maps/place/<name>/@lat,lng/data=!1s0x<hex>` URLs (Gemini was inventing Place IDs and coords). Prompt rule + post-process `rewriteFabricatedPlaceUrls()` rewrites any `place/` URL into `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=<name>+Singapore`. Also strips "meets C3 and C4" / "Meeting C2+C4" criteria letters from "Why a gem" prose via `stripCriteriaLeak()`.

  ### C. /location — privacy + UX
  - **v0.58.25** — Keyword routing: `/location current` (and `now`/`here`/`me`/`my`/`gps`/`device`) folds into the no-args path.
  - **v0.58.42 follow-up** — Splits the keyword path: `/location current` now ONLY shows a Share-pin keyboard with "tap to share your current location" copy. Cached display reserved for bare `/location`. Bot can't auto-detect device GPS; the reply makes that the entire conversation, not a footer.
  - **v0.58.38 → v0.58.40 (REVERTED)** — `address-sanitiser.js` to strip Singapore floor-unit notation (`#08-123`, `31-02 Marina Blvd`) from displayed labels for privacy. Reverted in v0.58.40 after Human Lead reported it caused a `/hidden` loop in production. Re-introduction is open in Register; will land with proper guards on the next attempt.

  ### D. Operations + ops UX
  - **v0.58.43** — Bumped overall `/hidden` timeout 90 s → 180 s → 240 s as evidence accumulated. Per-attempt 60 s deadline (Promise.race) prevents one slow model from eating the whole budget.
  - **/cuisine /command bot handler** — pre-resolves cached location and deep-links it via `#lat&lng` to the TMA. When no fresh cache, also sends a Share-pin reply-keyboard so the user can fix the anchor in one tap.

  ### E. Documentation
  - **README.md** refreshed: bot handle `@soleat_bot` (was `@sole_bot`); added Gemini path; updated `/hidden` description; documented `WEBHOOK_DOMAIN` custom-domain setup; added `GEMINI_API_KEY` / `GEMINI_MODEL` env vars; updated test count 250 → 399; corrected free-text behaviour (no longer goes through gatekeeper); added `venue-filters.js` and `gemini-client.js` to the repo-layout table; documented apartment-level address sanitisation as in-flight.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ node --check index.js
  $ node --check gemini-client.js
  $ node --check venue-filters.js
  $ npm test
   Test Files  21 passed (21)
        Tests  399 passed (399)
  $ cd web/cuisine && npm run build
   ✓ 62 modules transformed.
   ✓ built in 1.77s
  ```

- **[STATUS]** v0.58.45 PROD via PR #191 (squash-merge pending CI). Railway auto-deploys on merge to main. Soak window starts at "let's run for a few days" (Human Lead, 12:00 SGT 05-05-26).

- **[TEST]** Reproducible smoke tests:
  1. `/hidden` from a known SG location → first response in **10–25 s** (was 30–90 s pre-v0.58.44). Output blocks are plain text, no `**bold**`, no fabricated `place/` URLs (only `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=…`), no "meets Cx" leaks in prose.
  2. `/cuisine` open default → warm-start returns 5 places within ~2 s; tap "🔗 Copy syntax" with no filters → bot DMs bare `/cuisine` (no error).
  3. Type "sushi tei" in chat → returns Sushi Tei locations first, then Japanese restaurant fallback.
  4. `/location current` → only the Share-pin keyboard prompt (no cached-value distraction).
  5. SG_CENTROID coords (1.3521, 103.8198) → reverse-geocode returns "Singapore" (short-circuit), not "Central Catchment".

- **[KNOWN GAPS]**
  - **Address apartment-number sanitisation reverted** (`v0.58.38 → v0.58.40`); will reland with the prod loop fix when investigated.
  - **`@google/generative-ai` 0.24.1 is end-of-life as of 2025-11-30.** Migration to `@google/genai` deferred — current SDK still works for our call shape; migration is hygiene + future features (Live API, Veo) we don't currently use.
  - **Streaming `/hidden` results** (`generateContentStream`) deferred. Would emit picks one-by-one to chat as Gemini generates them; user-perceived first-pick latency drops from ~15 s to ~5–10 s. Folded into Register as deferred work.
  - **Testing on TMA `web/cuisine` v2** is end-to-end manual; no Playwright harness yet.

---

journal.title: [HDR] #101 | 08:15:00 SGT 04-05-26 | v0.53.0 | n/a kb | n/a lines
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Four Human Lead-driven changes:
  1. `/surprise` and `/carpark` get the v0.52.0 location-preload pattern (5-min staleness gate, reverse-geocoded "📍 Current: <addr>" header).
  2. `/carpark` "all 5 in one map" button (TMA `/app/map` web_app, mirrors `/surprise`).
  3. `/recognised` rewrite — drop the broken Ferracin Michelin scraper, switch to LLM-driven multi-award fetch (Michelin Star + Bib Gourmand + Asia 50 + Asia 100 + World Culinary Awards). Year-scoped: prior year before June, current year June+. Drop walking-distance ranking; show island-wide groupings sorted by date desc.
  4. Ship cuisine TMA v2 (the map-first / flip-card / multi-cuisine rewrite that was reverted from v0.52.0).

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **NEW shared helper `ensureFreshLocationOrPrompt(chatId, label)`** in `index.js`. Reads cached location, returns `null` (after firing `LOCATION_REQUEST_KEYBOARD`) if stale (>5 min) or missing. When fresh, also sends a "📍 Current: <reverse-geocoded address>" header line. DRYs the pattern across `/transport` (via `sendTransportMenu`), `/surprise`, `/carpark`. Uses `reverseGeocodeAddress` (v0.52.0 helper, 24h cache).

  2. **`runSurpriseCommand`** rewritten to call `ensureFreshLocationOrPrompt(chatId, '/surprise')` at entry. Removes the inline `getUserLocation` + `bot.sendMessage(LOCATION_REQUEST_KEYBOARD)` block. Same for the `PIPELINE_TASKS_ENABLED=false` legacy branch (now uses the same shared helper).

  3. **`runCarparkCommand`** rewritten:
     - Uses `ensureFreshLocationOrPrompt(chatId, '/carpark')` (was: silently defaulted to Raffles Place when no cached location — confusing).
     - Adds the "5 carparks on one map" button mirroring `/surprise`'s `deliverPicks` pattern: `buildMapHashUrl(carparks, { webhookDomain })` → `web_app: { url: <TMA /app/map> }`. Falls back to legacy `sendGoogleMapsContainer` (Maps directions URL) when `webhookDomain` unset.

  4. **NEW `recognised-fetch.js`** — LLM-driven SG culinary-awards fetcher.
     - Replaces v0.52.0's `michelin-scraper.js` (Ferracin selectors are 6+ years stale, return 0 cards on the modern Michelin Guide site).
     - Uses Anthropic `web_search` (already wired via `llm.generate({ webSearch: true })`) with a strict prompt covering all 5 award bodies Human Lead specified: MICHELIN Star (1/2/3★), MICHELIN Bib Gourmand, Asia's 50 Best Restaurants, Asia's 100 Best Restaurants, World Culinary Awards.
     - Year scoping (`targetYear()`): SGT month → if month ≤ 5, use previous year; if June+, use current year. Never goes back >1 year.
     - Output JSON contract: `{year, awards: [{award, date, name, dishes, mapsUrl}, ...]}`. Each award category fully specified; mapsUrl pinned to `?api=1&query=<name>+Singapore` form.
     - `sortAwards()`: date DESC, then name ASC, then dishes ASC.
     - `groupByAward()`: returns array of `{award, entries}` ordered by `AWARD_ORDER` (Star 3 → Star 2 → Star 1 → Bib → Asia50 → Asia100 → WCA → others alphabetical).
     - 24h Redis cache, keyed by `recognised:fetch:v1:<year>` so a year boundary cleanly invalidates.

  5. **`runRecognisedCommand`** fully rewritten:
     - Drops location prompt (per Human Lead — "ditch entirely, just show award groupings island-wide").
     - Drops `recognised-store` dependency, drops `michelin-scraper`, drops `summariseAwards` / `RECOGNISED_FILTER_ALIASES` / `venueMatchesCategory` / `RECOGNISED_RADIUS_M` / `RECOG_TOPN`.
     - Drops the `<filter>` argument (no longer applicable — output is always the full grouping).
     - One Telegram message per award group (so each can carry its own inline-keyboard map buttons, capped to 8 per group).

  6. **DELETED `michelin-scraper.js`** and `__tests__/michelin-scraper.test.js`.

  7. **NEW `cuisines-vault.js`** — 73-cuisine catalogue parser. Reads `doc/Feature/cuisines_js.MD` (the user's `CUISINE_CATEGORIES` JS-export spec) directly via regex over its consistent structure. No re-authoring of the data into a separate MD table — single source of truth. Sync read, module-level memo cache. Exports `getAllCuisines`, `getByCategory`, `findBySlug`, `findByNameOrKeyword`, `slugify`, etc.

  8. **NEW `web/cuisine/src/v2/`** — 4th major rewrite of the cuisine TMA. Coexists with v1 chip-grid behind `?v=` query param (default `2`).
     - **`App.jsx`** — composes everything. Debounced 350ms search trigger. Inferred cuisines/filters from NL response sync back into UI state.
     - **`lib/api.js`** — POST/GET wrappers for `/api/cuisine/{catalogue, search, nl-query}`.
     - **`lib/state.js`** — URL-hash-synced filter state (`#cuisines=ramen,thai&halal=1&prices=$,$$&r=800`). Reload preserves state.
     - **`components/QuickFilters.jsx`** — `[Open now] [≤10 min walk] [Halal] [Vegetarian] | [$] [$$] [$$$]` (multi-select chips per Human Lead spec; dropped Solo-friendly / Hawker / Cafe).
     - **`components/CuisineDrawer.jsx`** — 8-category collapsible accordion. Common Here open by default; others collapsed. Multi-select max 5; over-cap dims rest. Auto-opens any category with selections. Clear-all footer.
     - **`components/MapPanel.jsx`** — Google Maps JS via `/maps-key`. AdvancedMarkerElement; user blue, venues green, focused orange.
     - **`components/ResultCard.jsx`** — name + rating + price + walk + vibe + 📍 Maps + 📋 Copy.
     - **`components/FlipPanel.jsx`** — CSS-3D flip card (rotateY 180°). Front = ResultsList; back = textarea + Submit. Auto-flips back after NL submit; "From: '<text>' [Edit]" badge persists on results.

  9. **NEW backend endpoints** in `index.js`:
     - `GET /api/cuisine/catalogue` — returns the 8 categories + 73 cuisines.
     - `POST /api/cuisine/search` — multi-cuisine OR via `pipeline.discover`; post-fetch filters for openNow / price / halal / vegetarian / walking-time.
     - `POST /api/cuisine/nl-query` — keyword-infers cuisines (max 5) + filters from free text; returns `inferredCuisines + inferredFilters` so TMA syncs UI.

  10. **MODIFIED `web/cuisine/src/main.jsx`** — dual-render via `?v=` query param (default `2`).

- **[REUSED]**
  - `llm.generate({ webSearch: true })` for `recognised-fetch.js`.
  - `pipeline.discover` for `/api/cuisine/search` + `/api/cuisine/nl-query`.
  - `buildMapHashUrl` from `maps-url.js` for `/carpark` + `/surprise` map button.
  - `reverseGeocodeAddress` from v0.52.0.
  - `applyTelegramTheme`, `initData` from existing `api/tg.js`.
  - The v0.50.0 hawker-vault MD-file pattern as the model for `cuisines-vault.js`.

- **[DELTA]**
  - **NEW** `cuisines-vault.js` (~135 lines), `recognised-fetch.js` (~180 lines).
  - **NEW** `web/cuisine/src/v2/` — full directory: `App.jsx`, `lib/{api,state}.js`, `components/{QuickFilters, CuisineDrawer, MapPanel, ResultCard, FlipPanel}.jsx` (~600 lines).
  - **NEW** `__tests__/cuisines-vault.test.js` (15 tests), `__tests__/recognised-fetch.test.js` (18 tests). Total 215 → 248 (+33).
  - **MODIFIED** `index.js`: shared `ensureFreshLocationOrPrompt`, `runSurpriseCommand` + `runCarparkCommand` use it; `runRecognisedCommand` rewritten; 3 new `/api/cuisine/*` endpoints.
  - **MODIFIED** `web/cuisine/src/main.jsx` — version-switch.
  - **DELETED** `michelin-scraper.js` + its tests, plus `summariseAwards` / `RECOGNISED_FILTER_ALIASES` / `venueMatchesCategory` / `RECOGNISED_RADIUS_M` / `RECOG_TOPN` (~80 lines orphans).
  - **VERSION** root + 4× TMA `package.json` 0.52.0 → 0.53.0.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  16 passed (16)
       Tests  248 passed (248)
  $ cd web/cuisine && npm run build
  ✓ built in 2.32s
  → public/cuisine/index.html (0.56 kB)
  → assets/index-*.js (146 kB / 47 kB gzip)
  → assets/App-*.js × 2 (v1 + v2 split chunks)
  ```

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.53.0`.
  2. `/surprise` first call: prompts location share. After: shows `📍 Current: <addr>` header then runs.
  3. `/surprise` re-call within 5 min: no prompt; renders header from cache.
  4. `/carpark` first call: prompts location. After: header → 5 carparks → "🗺 View all 5 on map" web_app button → TMA leaflet view with 5 pins.
  5. `/recognised` shows "🏆 Pulling Singapore culinary awards…" → after ~10–20 s (cold) shows one message per award group, sorted Star 3 → Star 2 → Star 1 → Bib → Asia 50 → Asia 100 → WCA. Each message has up to 8 inline-keyboard map buttons.
  6. `/recognised` second call within 24 h: cached, instant.
  7. Today is May 2026, so `/recognised` shows 2025 awards (per `targetYear` rule).
  8. `/cuisine` opens the v2 TMA: map at top, quick-filter chips, 8-category accordion, flip-card panel.
  9. `?v=1` falls back to v1.

- **[OUTCOME CLAIMS — falsifiable]**
  - **C1 — `/surprise` and `/carpark` both prompt for location on stale cache.** *Test:* delete `loc:<hash>` Redis key, re-call → prompt fires.

- **[INTENT]** Apply Human Lead's "amendments before v0.52.0" directive — five distinct cleanups + rewrites:
  1. `/hawker` menu simplification (drop 4 buttons, rename, rewire Browse to v0.50.0 region picker)
  2. Populate "Hawker Centre Status" TMA via LLM-driven NEA fetch (cheerio scrape can't reach the tabbed/iframe data)
  3. `/transport` location preload + display in menu header
  4. Remove `/heritage_food` entirely
  5. `/recognised` rewrite — drop seed-based recognised-store, scrape Michelin Guide SG live (Ferracin pattern)

  The previously-built /cuisine TMA full rewrite (PR #107) is reverted off the branch; that work becomes a v0.53.0 candidate.

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **`/hawker` menu simplified** (`sendHawkerMenu`):
     - Top-level keyboard reduced to 2 buttons: `🧹 Cleaning info` + `🗺 Browse`.
     - Removed: `🚏 Nearest 3` (was a single-purpose wrapper around `/eat`-style ranking), `👥 Crowd` (no live API; the proxy via carparks was misleading), `🗺 By zone` (replaced by `Browse` which uses the canonical 122-centre vault).
     - `Browse` callback (`hawker:list:menu`) wires to v0.50.0's `runHawkerListMenu` → 5-region picker → alphabetical list with maps URLs.
     - Cleaning-info screen (`runHawkerCleaning`) reduced to 2 buttons: `🧹 Hawker Centre Status` (renamed from "Open closures TMA") + `⬅️ Back`. Dropped: `📅 NEA hawker mgmt` (external link the user called meaningless), `🤖 Live closure list (web search)` (now baked into the TMA endpoint).
     - Callback dispatch in `bot.on('callback_query')` collapsed to 4 cases (was 9): `hawker:menu`, `hawker:cleaning`, `hawker:list:menu`, `hawker:list:region:<R>`.
     - Deleted helper functions: `sendHawkerZonesMenu`, `runHawkerNearest`, `runHawkerZone`, `runHawkerCrowd`, `runHawkerClosureLive`, `runHawkerClosureLiveRefresh`, `carparksNearCentre`, `formatCentreBlock` (~280 lines removed).

  2. **NEW `nea-fetch.js`** — LLM-driven NEA closure fetcher.
     - Uses Anthropic `web_search` (already wired via `llm.generate({ webSearch: true })`).
     - Strict prompt directs Claude to extract two tables from `/our-services/hawker-management` (cleaning, 4 quarters) and `/announcements` (R&R Works), returning JSON.
     - Caches 12 h in Redis (`nea:fetch:v1`).
     - Output shape matches existing `nea-scrape` contract (`{closures: {headers, data}, rnrWorks: {headers, data}}`) so the Hawker TMA renders unchanged.
     - Robust JSON extraction: strips markdown fences + extracts `{...}` from prose-prefixed responses.

  3. **MODIFIED `/api/hawker/closures` endpoint** in `index.js`:
     - Tries `nea-fetch` (LLM) first.
     - Falls back to legacy `nea-scrape` (cheerio) only on LLM error — both will return empty rows in that case, but the TMA renders its diagnostic banner cleanly.

  4. **`/transport` location preload** (`sendTransportMenu`):
     - On every open: read cached location.
     - If absent or older than 5 minutes (`STALE_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000`), fire `LOCATION_REQUEST_KEYBOARD` immediately and exit (per Human Lead: "just refresh current location as preload").
     - When fresh: reverse-geocode via Google Geocoding API (cached 24 h on a 4-decimal-place grid) and prepend the human-readable address to the menu header:
       ```
       🚉 Singapore transport
       📍 Current: 46 Telok Blangah Drive, Singapore 100079
       [🚇 Train] [🚌 Bus]
       [🚖 Taxi/PHD] [🚗 Drive]
       [📍 Refresh location]
       ```
     - New `transport:refresh-loc` callback wipes the location cache + re-prompts.

  5. **NEW shared helper `reverseGeocodeAddress(lat, lng)`** in `index.js` — reused from the existing `/api/reverse-geocode` Express endpoint code path. 24 h Redis cache. Used by `sendTransportMenu`; available for any future menu wanting a "current location" header.

  6. **Removed `/heritage_food`**:
     - `bot.onText(/^\/heritage[-_]?food/)` registration deleted.
     - `runHeritageFoodCommand` function deleted (~70 lines).
     - Menu-router case + `setMyCommands` entry deleted.
     - Orphaned helpers `isHeritageSignal`, `HERITAGE_RADIUS_M` deleted (no remaining callers).

  7. **NEW `michelin-scraper.js`** — SG-only Michelin Guide scraper.
     - Pattern adapted from `NicolaFerracin/michelin-stars-restaurants-api` (cheerio + axios).
     - Targets `https://guide.michelin.com/en/sg-region/restaurants/all-starred` (1★/2★/3★) AND `…/bib-gourmand`.
     - Selectors include both Ferracin's 2019 classes (`.card__menu`, `.card__menu-content--title>a`) AND modern fallbacks (`[class*="restaurant__card"]`, `h3 a`, `article`) to survive Michelin redesigns.
     - Pagination via `<base>/page/<N>`; probes up to 10 pages or until empty.
     - 1.5 s rate-limit between page fetches.
     - Cache 24 h Redis (`michelin:sg:v1`).
     - Dedupes by link (some venues appear on both lists; prefers starred).

  8. **MODIFIED `runRecognisedCommand`**:
     - Drops `recognised-store` (seed-based pre-import).
     - Calls `michelin-scraper.getMichelinSG(redis)` → ~50 venues.
     - For top 25 by name-match (cap to keep cost bounded), resolves each to a Google Place via `pipeline.discover` (1 result, 50 km radius). Skips ones that don't resolve to coords.
     - Sorts by haversine distance to user, keeps top 5, runs `rankByWalkingTime` for walk-min enrichment.
     - Filter args simplified: `michelin` / `bib` / no-arg (was 6+ aliases mapping to award categories that no longer apply).
     - Maps URL via `googleMapsUrl(v)` (v0.48.2 helper) so the iOS Apple-Maps fix carries over.
     - Removed orphans: `RECOGNISED_FILTER_ALIASES`, `venueMatchesCategory` (~30 lines).

  9. **Tests**:

- **[REUSED]**

  - `pipeline.discover` for Michelin venue → Google Place resolution.
  - `rankByWalkingTime` from `vibe-suggest.js`.
  - `googleMapsUrl` from `maps-url.js` (v0.48.2 iOS-friendly URL).
  - `getUserLocation` / `setUserLocation` from `location-cache.js` (already had `setAt` timestamp for staleness check).

  - **NEW** `__tests__/michelin-scraper.test.js`, `__tests__/nea-fetch.test.js` (22 tests combined).

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**

  ```
  → OK
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  15 passed (15)
       Tests  225 passed (225)        # was 204; +21
  ```

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.52.0`.
  2. `/hawker` → top-level shows only `🧹 Cleaning info` + `🗺 Browse`. No "Nearest 3", "By zone", "Crowd".
  3. `/hawker` → Cleaning info → only `🧹 Hawker Centre Status` + Back. No "NEA hawker mgmt", no "Live closure list".
  4. `🗺 Browse` → 5-region picker (v0.50.0). Tap a region → alphabetical list with maps URLs.

  6. `/transport` first open: prompts for location share. After share: re-runs `sendTransportMenu` with `📍 Current: <address>` header.

- **[INTENT]** Build a Hitachi-style /transport experience. Human Lead's request: "use official MRT schematic but incorporate the picture, by https://www.hitachi.com/rd/research/design/service/travel-information/index.html" + screenshot of JR's Yokohama-Line travel-info card (line badge + name + "Delay" status icon + cause + network map with affected line highlighted). Plain-text Telegram chat can't render a schematic, so the Hitachi-faithful experience lives in a new TMA; the chat message gets a per-line summary + a "🗺 Open MRT map" button.

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **NEW `mrt-lines.js`** — single source of truth for SG MRT line metadata: code, English name, official LTA hex, emoji, endpoints, parent (for the Changi Branch). Ships a `parseStatusByLine(rawAlerts)` function that takes an LTA `TrainServiceAlerts` payload and returns a per-line `{status, cause, direction, time, raw}` map. `affectedLines(text)` regex-matches synonyms (EWL/East-West Line/east west, NSL/north-south, CCL/circle line, etc.). Most-severe-status-wins across multiple messages for the same line.

  2. **NEW `mrt-engineering.js`** — reads `data/mrt-engineering-closures.md` (committed, Human Lead curates). Schema per row: `date | line | direction | type | time | note`. Exports `upcoming(todayISO, days)` and `todayClosures(todayISO)`. Type vocabulary: `early-closure`, `late-opening`, `closure`, `extension-test`. Module-load memo cache (file is committed, no TTL needed).

  3. **NEW `data/mrt-engineering-closures.md`** — skeleton with 4 example rows (TEL/EWL/NSL/CCL across May–June 2026). Human Lead replaces with real SMRT/SBS-published advisories.

  4. **NEW `data/mrt-system-map.svg`** — hand-authored simplified SG MRT schematic (1000×800 viewbox). 10 lines as polylines (NSL/EWL/CGL/NEL/CCL/DTL/TEL + 3 LRTs) + 30 key interchange/terminal stations as circles + labels. IDs follow `line-<code>` and `stn-<code>` patterns so the TMA can mutate the DOM to highlight the focused line + mute others. Colours match official LTA palette (#009645 for EWL etc.).

  5. **NEW `web/transport/` TMA** — fourth TMA (after cuisine/menu/hawker). React + Vite + Tailwind, same scaffolding as the others. Components:
     - **`LineBadge`** — JR-style coloured letter tile (the "JH" badge in the Yokohama-Line reference).
     - **`SystemMap`** — fetches the static SVG, mutates DOM to flash focused line + mute others. Uses `applyHighlight()` on every focus change (no React-controlled SVG; cheaper).
     - **`LineStatusPanel`** — Hitachi-style side card. Shows: badge + line name + "For \<endpoint\>" direction + endpoints + status icon (▲ delay / ⛔ closure / ✕ disrupted / ✓ normal) coloured by severity + cause line + LTA notice excerpt (collapsible).
     - **`AffectedTicker`** — horizontal-scroll bottom strip of all affected lines. Tap to focus a different line on the map + side panel. Mirrors Hitachi's bottom marquee.
     - **`LocationCard`** — "📍 You are here" with reverse-geocoded address + nearest 3 MRT stations.
     - **`EngineeringList`** — next-7-days closure list with type-emoji prefix (🌙 early / 🌅 late / 🚧 closure / 🔬 extension-test).

  6. **NEW backend endpoints** in `index.js`:
     - `/app/transport` — serves the TMA index.
     - `/app/transport/mrt-system-map.svg` — serves the static schematic with 1h cache.
     - `/api/transport/status` — composes per-line status (LTA TrainServiceAlerts, parsed) + affected codes + upcoming engineering closures + (TODO) reverse-geocoded address. Open endpoint (same pattern as `/maps-key` in v0.46.1; no per-user data).

  7. **MODIFIED `runTransportTrain`** in `index.js` — adds:
     - Per-line breakdown ("⚠️ Affected lines: 🟢 EWL East-West Line — delay (signal fault) / [direction]")
     - "🔧 Upcoming engineering (next 7 d)" summary (top 5)
     - "🗺 Open MRT map (Hitachi-style)" web_app button → opens the new TMA
     - "🔄 Refresh" callback button

  8. **Build pipeline** — `package.json#scripts.build` adds `build:transport`; `postinstall` re-runs `build` so Railway picks it up automatically on next deploy.

- **[REUSED]**
  - LTA `TrainServiceAlerts` API (already polled by v0.41.0 `updateTransitStatus` cron; our new endpoint re-fetches for freshness).
  - `nearestMrtStations(lat, lng, ...)` from `transport.js` (v0.31.1).
  - The `web/hawker` TMA scaffolding as a structural template (vite config, Tailwind theme, tg.js helpers).

- **[DELTA]**
  - **NEW** `mrt-lines.js`, `mrt-engineering.js` — core data + parsers (~150 lines combined).
  - **NEW** `data/mrt-engineering-closures.md`, `data/mrt-system-map.svg` — content.
  - **NEW** `web/transport/` — full TMA (package.json, vite.config.js, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html, src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx, src/styles.css, src/tg.js, src/data/lines.js, src/components/{LineBadge, LineStatusPanel, SystemMap, AffectedTicker, EngineeringList, LocationCard}.jsx). ~600 lines net new.
  - **MODIFIED** `index.js`: 3 new endpoints (`/app/transport`, `/app/transport/mrt-system-map.svg`, `/api/transport/status`) + per-line breakdown in `runTransportTrain` + TMA button.
  - **MODIFIED** `package.json` + 3× TMA: 0.50.0 → 0.51.0; +`build:transport` script.
  - **NEW** `__tests__/mrt-lines.test.js` (13 tests), `__tests__/mrt-engineering.test.js` (10 tests). Total 181 → 204.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  13 passed (13)
       Tests  204 passed (204)
  $ cd web/transport && npm install && npm run build
  ✓ built in 1.31s
  → public/transport/index.html (0.55 kB)
  → assets/index-*.js (151 kB / 49 kB gzip)
  → assets/index-*.css (8 kB / 2.4 kB gzip)
  ```

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.51.0`.
  2. `/transport` → 🚇 Train → text view shows: status header + "⚠️ Affected lines:" block (when any disruption) + "🔧 Upcoming engineering (next 7 d)" + "🗺 Open MRT map" button.
  3. Tap "🗺 Open MRT map" → TMA opens. Header reads "🚇 SG MRT" + timestamp + "✓ All lines normal" or "⚠️ N lines affected".
  4. Schematic renders with the focused line flashing + others muted at 22% opacity (Hitachi-style).
  5. Side panel reads: line badge (coloured letter tile) + line name (English) + "For \<endpoint\>" + status icon + "status: Delay" / "cause: Signal fault" / "section: \<from\> ↔ \<to\>".
  6. Bottom AffectedTicker scrolls horizontally; tap a different affected line → focus shifts.
  7. Engineering list shows up to 7-day window from `data/mrt-engineering-closures.md`.

- **[OUTCOME CLAIMS — falsifiable]**
  - **C1 — TMA visually mirrors the Hitachi reference card** (line badge + name + "For \<dest\>" + status icon + cause). *Test:* visual comparison with the screenshot Human Lead provided.
  - **C2 — When LTA reports a disruption, only the affected line(s) flash** on the schematic; others are muted. *Test:* mock `/api/transport/status` to return `affectedCodes: ['CCL']` and confirm CCL polyline animates.
  - **C3 — `parseStatusByLine` correctly extracts line codes from natural-language LTA messages.** *Test:* 13 unit-tested cases cover EWL/NSL/CCL/TEL synonyms + most-severe-wins.
  - **C4 — Engineering MD parser reads the live data file.** *Test:* `eng.loadAll().length > 0` against the committed file (asserted in tests).
  - **C5 — Build pipeline includes transport TMA.** *Test:* `npm run build` exits 0 + emits `public/transport/index.html`.
  - **C6 — All 204 unit tests pass.** *Test:* CI badge green.

- **[KNOWN GAPS / SCOPE CUTS]**
  - **No reverse-geocode in this PR.** `/api/transport/status` returns `address: null` — the LocationCard will hide. Wiring Google Geocoding API in is straightforward (~20 lines) but adds an API call per TMA open. Defer to v0.51.1 or batch with the next /transport iteration.
  - **No first/last-train countdown.** Needs station-level dataset from LTA MRTStation feed; deferred.
  - **The schematic is hand-authored, not the official LTA system map.** Human Lead asked for "official MRT schematic" — I authored a simplified 30-station version that follows the official line colours but omits most stations for legibility on a phone screen. If the official LTA SVG can be sourced (LTA system-map PDF), drop it into `data/mrt-system-map.svg` and the TMA picks it up automatically. The current SVG geometry is approximate; not geographically accurate.
  - **Engineering closures are seeded with 4 example rows.** Real SMRT/SBS advisories need to be transcribed into `data/mrt-engineering-closures.md`. The MD format is human-editable; one row per affected day.
  - **No "Update location" button on the TMA.** TMAs can request location via `Telegram.WebApp.requestLocation()` (newer API). Defer.
  - **AffectedTicker shows top 7 lines as fallback** when nothing's affected — purely so the UI is non-empty. Could be hidden instead; cosmetic.
  - **No CRL/JRL on the schematic** — they're not yet operational (CRL Phase 1 opens 2030, JRL 2027). The lines metadata flags them `future: true` so the chat code can skip them, but the SVG omits them entirely.

journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Replace the v0.49.0 PDF-based hawker vault with the human-curated `data/list-of-hawker-centres.md` file (Human Lead committed it to main as `643a79a`). Add 5-region segmentation (Central/South/East/North/West) per Human Lead's directive: "spend time to segment by north, south, east west, central. sort by alphabetic, with google url".

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **REWRITTEN `hawker-vault.js`** — drops PDF fetch + pdf-parse + Redis cache. Reads MD file from disk at module load, parses into 122 records (107 markets + 16 new − 1 closed = 122; Bukit Timah Market is closed for redevelopment till 2029).
     - `parseMd(md)` — line-by-line pipe-table scanner. Skips header + separator + closed rows. Strips `#` footnote marker from names. Extracts postal from `S(NNNNNN)` form (takes first when slash-pair like `S(161022/162022)`).
     - Each parsed centre is enriched in-place with `region` + `mapsUrl` so consumers don't need to derive them.
     - Module-level memo cache (no TTL — file is committed, so process lifetime is enough).

  2. **5-region classifier (`regionForCentre`)** — first-match wins:
     - **Strong-signal name keywords** (~50 distinctive places per region): `bedok`, `tampines`, `pasir ris`, `marine parade`, `geylang`, `kallang` → East; `yishun`, `woodlands`, `hougang`, `sengkang`, `punggol`, `ang mo kio`, `bishan` → North (combines URA's North + Northeast); `jurong`, `clementi`, `bukit batok`, `holland`, `pasir panjang`, `queenstown` → West; `tanjong pagar`, `chinatown`, `outram`, `tiong bahru`, `bukit merah`, `telok blangah` → South; `orchard`, `newton`, `novena`, `toa payoh`, `bukit timah` → Central.
     - **Postal-sector fallback** when no keyword matches:
       - 01–10, 14–16 → South (CBD + Tiong Bahru/Bukit Merah)
       - 17–37 → Central (Orchard, Newton, Novena, Toa Payoh, Macpherson)
       - 38–52, 81–82 → East
       - 53–57, 72–80 → North
       - 11–13, 58–71 → West
     - Regex uses negative lookahead to avoid false matches (e.g. `bukit timah(?! market)` so the closed Bukit Timah Market doesn't override; `tanglin(?! halt)` to keep Tanglin Halt Market in West).

  3. **`getByRegion(region?)`** — lazy-builds the 5-region index once, sorts each region alphabetically by `name.localeCompare(en, sensitivity:base)`. Returns the full `{Central, South, East, North, West}` map when called with no arg.

  4. **`formatRegionList(region)`** — Telegram-friendly markdown output. Each centre as: `1. *Name* 🆕\n   address\n   📍 <maps_url>`. The 🆕 badge marks the 16 "new hawker centres" (Ci Yuan, Bukit Panjang, etc.). Truncates at 3800 chars to fit Telegram's 4096 ceiling.

  5. **`mapsUrlForCentre(centre)`** — uses the documented Google Maps URLs API: `?api=1&query=<encoded "Name, full address">`. The full address gives Google Maps a precise resolution target — much better than `<name> + Singapore` (v0.48.1) which often hit wrong places for generic "Blk N <street>" names.

  6. **NEW `/hawker` UI: "📋 Browse all centres by region"** button on the cleaning-info screen → opens a region picker (5 region buttons with emoji + count) → selecting a region renders the alphabetical list with maps URLs. Two callback handlers: `hawker:list:menu`, `hawker:list:region:<Region>`.

  7. **MODIFIED `nea-scrape.js#getStructuredClosures`** — vault loader is now sync (`vault.getAllCentres()` no longer takes `redis`). Same match logic at ≥0.85 confidence; vault failure still non-fatal.

  8. **DROPPED `pdf-parse` dep** — was added in v0.49.0; replaced by direct MD-file read.

- **[REUSED]**
  - `fs.readFileSync` — Node built-in, no new deps.
  - v0.49.0 fuzzy matchers (`normaliseName`, `editDistance`, `findByName`) kept verbatim for `nea-scrape.js` consumers.
  - `safeSend`, callback dispatch in `index.js` — same pattern as other `hawker:*` handlers.
  - The MD file at `data/list-of-hawker-centres.md` — Human Lead's commit `643a79a` on main.

- **[DELTA]**
  - **REWRITTEN** `hawker-vault.js` — ~280 lines, 13 exports. Drops async PDF fetch + Redis cache; adds region classifier + 5-region segmentation + alphabetical sort + format helpers.
  - **REWRITTEN** `__tests__/hawker-vault.test.js` — 36 tests (was 22; covers parseMd, region classification by keyword + postal fallback, integration with the live MD file, mapsUrlForCentre, fuzzy matchers).
  - **MODIFIED** `nea-scrape.js#getStructuredClosures` — sync vault load (no redis arg).
  - **MODIFIED** `index.js` — +2 callback handlers (`hawker:list:menu`, `hawker:list:region:<R>`); +2 functions (`runHawkerListMenu`, `runHawkerListRegion`); +1 button on the cleaning-info menu.
  - **REMOVED** `pdf-parse` from `package.json` — no longer needed.
  - **VERSION** `package.json` + 3× TMA: 0.49.0 → 0.50.0.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ node -e "console.log(require('./hawker-vault').formatRegionSummary())"
  → 🍜 *122 hawker centres* (snapshot 25 Jul 2025)
    *Central*: 22 · *South*: 21 · *East*: 27 · *North*: 27 · *West*: 25
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  11 passed (11)
       Tests  181 passed (181)        # was 167; +14 net
  ```

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.50.0`.
  2. `/hawker` → 🧹 Cleaning info → tap "📋 Browse all centres by region" → 5 region buttons appear with counts (Central 22 / South 21 / East 27 / North 27 / West 25 = 122 total).
  3. Tap any region → alphabetical list with name + address + 📍 Maps URL per centre. New centres show 🆕 badge.
  4. Tap any 📍 link → Google Maps app opens on the correct centre pin.
  5. `/hawker` → "🧹 Cleaning closures" → closure rows whose names match a vault centre have their Maps URL anchored to the official address (not just `<name> Singapore`); Railway log shows `vaultMatched: true` for those rows.

- **[OUTCOME CLAIMS — falsifiable]**
  - **C1 — Vault parses 122 centres from the in-repo MD file.** *Test:* `vault.getAllCentres().length === 122` (verified in sandbox).
  - **C2 — Every centre has a non-empty region in the 5-region set.** *Test:* `every(c => REGIONS.includes(c.region))` (asserted in tests).
  - **C3 — Every region is alphabetically sorted by name.** *Test:* `names === [...names].sort()` per region (asserted in tests).
  - **C4 — Every centre's mapsUrl resolves to a Google Maps place when tapped on iOS.** *Test:* manual — tap 📍 on Maxwell, Bedok, Yishun, Jurong, Clementi.
  - **C5 — `/hawker list:region:<R>` callback returns within 200 ms** (sync read from memo cache; no I/O).
  - **C6 — Vault load is sync + lazy.** *Test:* `require('./hawker-vault')` doesn't read the file; first call to `getAllCentres()` does.
  - **C7 — All 181 unit tests pass.** *Test:* CI badge green.

- **[KNOWN GAPS / SCOPE CUTS]**
  - **Region classification is heuristic.** Some borderline centres could legitimately go either way (e.g. Holland Village = West vs Central; Adam Road = Central vs North). The keyword regex prefers consistency over perfection — Human Lead can refine `REGION_KEYWORDS` in `hawker-vault.js` directly if a specific centre lands wrong.
  - **No "South" in URA's official 5-region scheme.** URA splits SG into Central/East/North/Northeast/West. The "South" region used here groups CBD + Tiong Bahru + Bukit Merah + Telok Blangah which URA classes as Central. Used because Human Lead asked for N/S/E/W/Central explicitly.
  - **MD file is a snapshot.** When NEA publishes a new quarterly list, `data/list-of-hawker-centres.md` needs a manual update (human-readable diff in PR — much better than auto-pulling stale data). Cache is per-process so a deploy after an MD update picks it up immediately.
  - **No TMA-side region browser yet.** The `/hawker` Telegram menu has the new "Browse by region" button, but the `/app/hawker` TMA still only renders cleaning closures. TMA enhancement deferred.
  - **Bukit Timah Market is excluded.** It's "closed for redevelopment till 2029" so it has no usable address. When it reopens, the MD edit will re-add it automatically (parser detects the `closed for redevelopment` substring).
  - **`#` footnote rows kept** (Chong Pang, Old Airport, Toa Payoh Lor 5, Whampoa, etc. — managed by FairPrice on behalf of NEA). The footnote is stripped from the display name; the operator info lives in `mgmt`.

journal.title: [HDR] #97 | 20:30:00 SGT 03-05-26 | v0.49.0 | n/a kb | n/a lines
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Build a canonical 125-hawker-centre vault sourced from the NEA master-list PDF (`list-of-hcs_-25-july-2025.pdf` — provided by Human Lead). The v0.48.x scrape + LLM web_search paths return centre names that may be mistyped, abbreviated, or hallucinated. Cross-referencing against the canonical 125 lets us drop fakes/dupes, normalise to NEA spelling, and build address-anchored Maps URLs (much more precise than the current `<name> + ' Singapore'` form).

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **NEW `hawker-vault.js`** — module that fetches the PDF once, parses it with `pdf-parse`, and caches the structured 125-record list in Redis with 30-day TTL.
     - `fetchAndParsePdf()` — axios GET (responseType: arraybuffer, 20s timeout) + `pdfParse(Buffer)` + `parsePdfText` → `[{name, address, postal}]`.
     - `parsePdfText(text)` — heuristic parser. NEA's PDF lays out centres as numbered records:
       ```
       1. Adam Road Food Centre
          2 Adam Road, Singapore 289876
       ```
       Scans for `/Singapore (\d{6})$/` as the postal anchor, walks back ≤3 lines to find the numbered name. Dedupes by postal.
     - `getAllCentres(redis)` — cache-first wrapper. 30-day TTL key `nea:hawker-vault:v1`.
     - `normaliseName(s)` — lowercase, strip "Centre/Center/Market/Food/Hawker/Complex/Cooked", drop punctuation. Both inputs and vault names normalised before comparison.
     - `editDistance(a, b)` — standard Levenshtein DP.
     - `findByName(centres, query)` → `{centre, score, distance}` or `null`. Returns exact matches at score 1; substring matches scored by length ratio; edit-distance fallback at ≥75% similarity.
     - `mapsUrlForCentre(centre)` — builds `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<encoded "name, address">` (vs the v0.48.1 `<name> + Singapore` form which was prone to hitting wrong matches).
     - `annotateNames(centres, names)` — bulk version for diagnostic / debug.
     - All failures non-fatal — sandbox + first-call cold start return `{ok: false, centres: []}` and callers fall back to v0.48.x behaviour.

  2. **MODIFIED `nea-scrape.js#enrichClosureRows`** — third arg `vaultCentres` (optional). When supplied:
     - Each row's name is matched via `findByName` at score ≥ 0.85.
     - On confident match: row's `name` is normalised to vault spelling; `mapsUrl` swapped to address-anchored form; `vaultMatched: true` flag added.
     - On no match: row keeps its scraped name + the v0.48.1 `<name> + Singapore` Maps URL (back-compat preserved).

  3. **MODIFIED `nea-scrape.js#getStructuredClosures`** — opportunistically pulls vault on every call. Vault unavailable → continues without (logs a warning). Returns `vaultUsed`, `vaultMatchedCount` for diagnostics.

  4. **NEW dependency: `pdf-parse@^1.1.4`** (~10 KB packed). Already battle-tested PDF text extractor. Pure JS, no native deps.

- **[REUSED]**
  - `axios` for the PDF fetch — already a top-level dep.
  - Redis client for caching — same pattern as `nea-scrape.js` cache.
  - `getStructuredClosures` integration — vault is opt-in; existing v0.48.1 callers (which pass no vaultCentres) still work.

- **[DELTA]**
  - **NEW** `hawker-vault.js` — ~180 lines, 9 exports.
  - **NEW** `__tests__/hawker-vault.test.js` — 22 unit tests (parser, normaliseName, editDistance, findByName, mapsUrlForCentre, annotateNames).
  - **MODIFIED** `nea-scrape.js`: `enrichClosureRows` gained vaultCentres param + match logic (~15 lines); `getStructuredClosures` gained vault load + diag fields (~12 lines).
  - **MODIFIED** `package.json` + 3× TMA: 0.48.2 → 0.49.0; +`pdf-parse` dep.
  - **NO CHANGES** to `index.js` — the vault wires through `getStructuredClosures` transparently.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ node --check hawker-vault.js nea-scrape.js
  → OK
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  11 passed (11)
       Tests  167 passed (167)        # was 145; +22 vault tests
  ```
  Cannot validate the live PDF parse from sandbox (NEA blocked at egress). Production verification required.

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.49.0`.
  2. `/hawker` → "🧹 Cleaning closures" → first call fetches the PDF (~2-5s). Verify Railway logs show: `[HawkerVault]` cache miss, then cache write. Subsequent calls hit cache and respond in <500 ms.
  3. Closure block names match NEA's official spelling (e.g. "Bukit Timah Market & Food Centre" not "Bukit Timah Hawker Centre" if that's what the scrape returned).
  4. Tap 📍 Maps URL on a vault-matched closure → Google Maps app opens directly on the correct hawker centre pin (was previously prone to wrong matches when name was generic, e.g. "Block 79" matched random HDB blocks).
  5. Vault TTL: clear via `redis-cli DEL nea:hawker-vault:v1` to force refresh.

- **[OUTCOME CLAIMS — falsifiable]**
  - **C1 — Vault parses ≥120 of the 125 NEA centres on first fetch.** *Test:* Railway logs show `centresParsed: ≥120` in `[HawkerVault]` diagnostic.
  - **C2 — Closure-list name normalisation matches ≥80% of scraped rows.** *Test:* `getStructuredClosures` returns `vaultMatchedCount` ≥ 0.8 × `all.length`.
  - **C3 — Vault-matched rows use address-anchored Maps URLs.** *Test:* tap a 📍 link on a matched row; Google Maps shows the exact address+postal in the search field, not just "<name> Singapore".
  - **C4 — Vault failure does not break /hawker.** *Test:* set Redis offline; /hawker still serves closures via the v0.48.1 unanchored path. No 500 error.
  - **C5 — All 167 unit tests still pass.** *Test:* CI badge green.
  - **C6 — pdf-parse dep adds <50 KB to packed bundle.** *Test:* `du -sh node_modules/pdf-parse`.

- **[KNOWN GAPS / SCOPE CUTS]**
  - **Sandbox can't validate live PDF parse.** Parser tested only against synthetic fixtures matching the expected NEA layout. If NEA's PDF format differs (e.g. multi-column layout, embedded images for names, OCR-only PDF), the parser returns 0 records and the code falls back to v0.48.1 unanchored behaviour. Acceptable — fallback is automatic.
  - **PDF version is hardcoded** (`list-of-hcs_-25-july-2025.pdf`). NEA updates this quarterly with a new dated filename. When that happens, the URL needs a manual bump — there's no auto-discovery (NEA doesn't publish a stable "latest" alias). Mitigation: cache TTL 30d so a missed filename change shows up within a month rather than going stale silently.
  - **No /p hawker-vault diag command** — would let Human Lead inspect the parsed list inline. Defer until parser proves reliable in production.
  - **Vault loads on every getStructuredClosures call (cache-checked).** Redis hit is sub-ms but the JSON.parse of 125 records is ~1ms. Acceptable.
  - **Fuzzy match threshold is 0.85 (substring) / 0.75 (edit distance).** Tunable. If too lenient, scraped "X Hawker Centre" might match the wrong vault entry. If too strict, common abbreviations are lost. The current settings prefer false-negative (no match → falls back to unanchored URL) over false-positive (wrong match → wrong URL).
  - **No vault-side telemetry** — Pino sweep deferred to a future version.

journal.title: [HDR] #96 | 20:15:00 SGT 03-05-26 | v0.48.2 | n/a kb | n/a lines
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Fix three Human-Lead-reported bugs that surfaced once v0.48.1 deployed:
  1. The "📍 Google Maps" button on `/surprise` (and every other pick card) opens Google Maps showing the literal text `place_id:ChIJ...` in the search field, not the place pin.
  2. `/surprise` "View all picks" button uses Google Maps directions URL — renders as a **route** between picks, not as **5 markers on one map**.
  3. `/cuisine` TMA's "🗺 View all 5 picks on map" footer link sends the user to an external browser tab whose URL is `https://gia4lunch-production.up.railway.app/app/map#venues=<base64>` — Google Maps can't parse it; the user sees the long base64 URL instead of pins.

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **`googleMapsUrl(place)` in `maps-url.js`** — switch from the broken `/maps/place/?q=place_id:<id>` form to the documented Google Maps URLs API:
     ```
     https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<NAME>&query_place_id=<PLACE_ID>
     ```
     Per Google docs (developers.google.com/maps/documentation/urls/get-started), `query_place_id` pins the place; `query` supplies the search-field text so the user sees the venue name, not the raw id. Reads `place.name` or `place.displayName.text` (Places New shape). Falls back to name-only search when no id, then to existing `place.url` / cid / coords.

  2. **`deliverPicks` in `index.js`** — replace `sendGoogleMapsContainer` (Google Maps directions URL, route mode) with a Telegram `web_app` button pointing at the TMA `/app/map` view. Uses `buildMapHashUrl(picks, { webhookDomain })` from `maps-url.js` to produce an absolute URL with all picks' lat/lng/name/placeId encoded in the hash. The TMA's leaflet renderer pins each pick as a marker on a single map.
     - Falls back to the legacy directions URL only when `webhookDomain` is unset (sandbox / local dev) — production always has `RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN` set.

  3. **`web/cuisine/src/components/ResultsGrid.jsx`** — drop `target="_blank"` and `rel="noreferrer"` on the footer "View all on map" `<a>` tag. The TMA WebView was opening `/app/map` in an external browser tab (gia4lunch domain), but `/app/map` is meant to render INSIDE the TMA. Removing target="_blank" keeps the navigation in the same WebView so the leaflet map renders directly.

  4. **`/surprise` pre-flight message** — changed "Hunting up to 12 hidden gems" → "Hunting up to 5 hidden gems" to match the v0.48.1 `SURPRISE_TARGET_COUNT = 5` change.

  5. **NEA fallback button URL fix** — `runHawkerClosureLive`'s web_search-fallback path still hardcoded the old `/list-of-hawker-centres-closure-and-cleaning-schedules` URL on its "📅 NEA hawker mgmt" button row. Now reuses the same `buttonRow` (pointing at `/overview`) as the scrape-success path. Single source of truth.

  6. **Strengthened LLM prompt for `/hawker` web_search fallback** — when the scrape returns 0 rows AND we fall back to Anthropic web_search, the prompt now:
     - Explicitly references the NEA `/overview` source URL as PRIMARY.
     - Tells Claude to search for town-council reposts / news aggregators if the page itself isn't fetchable.
     - Demands ALL 6 fields per closure (was: 5 fields, durationDays optional).
     - Requires the EXACT output template (numbered blocks, summary header, citation footer, plain-text + emoji, no markdown tables).
     - Sets a floor: "aim to return at least 5 entries" (the NEA quarterly list typically has 20–60 active closures); "If you find ZERO closures, say so explicitly" — no silent empty replies.
     - Maps URL format pinned to `?api=1&query=<encoded name + ' Singapore'>`.

- **[REUSED]**
  - `buildMapHashUrl` from `maps-url.js` (v0.45.0) — already used by `prompt-query.js` `/p m`. Same encoding format the cuisine TMA uses internally.
  - The TMA `/app/map` route (`index.js#3083`) — already serving the leaflet multi-marker view since v0.32.0.
  - `webhookDomain` env var (`process.env.WEBHOOK_DOMAIN || RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN`) — already in use for every other TMA web_app button.

- **[DELTA]**
  - **MODIFIED** `maps-url.js`: `googleMapsUrl` rewritten to use documented `?api=1&query=<name>&query_place_id=<id>` form. ~25 lines changed.
  - **MODIFIED** `__tests__/maps-url.test.js`: 11 tests updated/added (the v0.45.1 tests asserted the broken format; replaced with v0.48.2 documented-form assertions). Test count 23 → 25.
  - **MODIFIED** `index.js`: `deliverPicks` replaced inline `sendGoogleMapsContainer` call with a `web_app: { url: buildMapHashUrl(...) }` inline-keyboard button (~15 lines); `runSurpriseCommand` pre-flight message 12 → 5.
  - **MODIFIED** `web/cuisine/src/components/ResultsGrid.jsx`: dropped `target="_blank"` + `rel="noreferrer"` on the footer link.
  - **VERSION** `package.json` + 3× TMA `package.json` 0.48.1 → 0.48.2.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ node --check maps-url.js index.js
  → OK
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  10 passed (10)
       Tests  145 passed (145)        # was 143; +2 new maps-url cases
  ```

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.48.2`.
  2. Tap "📍 Google Maps" on any pick card → Google Maps app opens with the **place pin** displayed, **venue name** in the search field. NOT the literal `place_id:CHIJ...` text.
  3. `/surprise` returns ≤5 picks (v0.48.1) and pre-flight reads "Hunting up to 5 hidden gems".
  4. `/surprise` shows a "🗺 View all 5 on map" button → tapping opens the TMA leaflet map with **5 pins on one map**, NOT a Google Maps route between them.
  5. `/cuisine` TMA → tap "🗺 View all 5 picks on map" → TMA navigates to `/app/map` in the same WebView, leaflet shows 5 pins. NOT an external browser tab with the base64 URL.
  6. Same map button on `/eat`, `/drink`, `/groceries` (all share `deliverPicks`) → 5-marker map view.

- **[OUTCOME CLAIMS — falsifiable]**
  - **C1 — "📍 Google Maps" button shows place pin, not literal id text.** *Test:* tap the button on iOS; the search field reads the venue name and a pin is centred on it. Pre-v0.48.2: search field reads `place_id:ChIJ...`.
  - **C2 — "View all on map" shows N markers on one map.** *Test:* tap the button on `/surprise`; leaflet renders with N distinct pin markers. Pre-v0.48.2: Google Maps app shows a directions route between sequential stops.
  - **C3 — `/cuisine` TMA footer "View all on map" stays inside Telegram.** *Test:* tap inside the cuisine TMA; the leaflet map renders inside the same TMA WebView. Pre-v0.48.2: external browser tab opens with `https://gia4lunch.../app/map#venues=<base64>` URL visible.
  - **C4 — All 145 unit tests still pass.** *Test:* CI badge green.

- **[KNOWN GAPS / SCOPE CUTS]**
  - **The legacy `sendGoogleMapsContainer` directions URL is preserved as a fallback** for the no-webhookDomain case. In production this branch never fires.
  - **TMA `/app/map` URL length** — base64-encoded venue blob can grow with N venues. `buildMapHashUrl` already enforces a 4096-char Telegram URL ceiling. For 5 picks the URL is ~3000 chars, well within budget.
  - **No new tests for `deliverPicks` map button** — would require mocking `bot.sendMessage` and `webhookDomain`. The existing `buildMapHashUrl` tests in `maps-url.test.js` cover the URL construction; the inline-keyboard wiring is exercised in production by every `/eat` / `/drink` / `/cuisine` / `/surprise` request.
  - **The `place_id:X` literal-text bug existed since v0.45.1** — every pick card surfaced the wrong URL for ~7 versions before Human Lead caught it. The v0.45.1 unit test asserted the broken format as if it were correct. Tests are necessary but not sufficient — they only verify what we believed was right.

journal.title: [HDR] #95 | 15:00:00 SGT 03-05-26 | v0.48.1 | n/a kb | n/a lines
journal.body:
- **[INTENT]** Fix the broken NEA hawker closure scrape from v0.48.0. Human Lead's screenshot of `nea.gov.sg/our-services/hawker-management/overview` shows the canonical closure table renders on `/overview`, NOT on `/announcements` (the URL the v0.48.0 scrape pointed at). Plus reduce `/surprise` target count from 12 to 5, and fix the buddy share-link rendering (currently shown as backtick code block, not a clickable hyperlink).
- Three-bug ship: NEA URL fix + helper enrichment + share-link hyperlink + /surprise count.

- **[DESIGN]**

  1. **NEA scrape URL → `/overview`**
     - `OVERVIEW_URL = 'https://www.nea.gov.sg/our-services/hawker-management/overview'`
     - `ANNOUNCEMENTS_URL` kept as alias for back-compat references.
     - Scrape cache key bumped `v1` → `v2` so prior cached HTML from the wrong URL is never served.

  2. **Enrichment helpers (NEW in `nea-scrape.js`)** — exported so callers can structure rather than render-as-text:
     - `parseDayMonthYear('30 Mar 2026')` → `Date(UTC)`
     - `parseClosureDateRange('30 Mar 2026 to 28 Jun 2026')` → `{start, end, raw}` — handles "to", en-dash, em-dash, hyphen, and single-day ranges.
     - `classifyClosureStatus(start, end, today)` → `'ongoing' | 'upcoming' | 'recently-ended' | 'historical' | 'unknown'`. Ongoing when today ∈ [start, end]; recently-ended when end is within last 30d; historical otherwise.
     - `googleMapsSearchUrl(name)` → `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<urlencode(name + ' Singapore')>`. The `query=` form (not `cid=`) renders consistently inside Google Maps and works on iOS Universal Links without redirecting to Apple Maps.
     - `enrichClosureRows(rows, today)` → array of `{name, closureType, startDate, endDate, durationDays, status, mapsUrl, raw}`. Maps Reason+Remarks to `closureType ∈ {Cleaning, R&R, Upgrading, Other}`. Drops nameless rows.
     - `sortClosuresByProximity(enriched)` → ongoing (by nearest end) → upcoming (by nearest start) → recently-ended (most recent end first). Historical dropped.
     - `formatClosureBlocks(enriched)` → numbered labeled blocks with 🔴/🟡/⚪ status emoji + `📍 <Maps URL>` per row.
     - `getStructuredClosures(redis)` — convenience wrapper: `getCachedOrFetch` → enrich → sort → return `{ok, all, ongoing, upcoming, recentlyEnded, summary, fetchedAt, cached}`.

  3. **`runHawkerClosureLive` dispatch (`index.js`)** — scrape-first:
     - Try `nea-scrape.getStructuredClosures(redis)` first (fast, free, deterministic).
     - On non-empty result, render via `formatClosureBlocks` with header summary + cache-age stamp + canonical NEA portal button.
     - On empty/error, fall back to the v0.48.0 Claude+web_search path (preserves the safety net for any future NEA layout change).
     - `runHawkerClosureLiveRefresh` now clears BOTH caches: `hawker:closures-live` (web_search fallback) AND `hawker:nea-scrape:v2` (scrape).

  4. **`/surprise` target count 12 → 5** (`pipeline-task.js#SURPRISE_TARGET_COUNT`). Human Lead's directive: "reduce the /surprise to 5 places". 5 matches the visual density of `/eat` and `/drink` cards.

  5. **Buddy share-link hyperlink** (`index.js#share:` callback handler):
     - Was: `` `<link>` `` (Markdown code block — tap-to-copy, NOT clickable as hyperlink).
     - Now: `[<link>](<link>)` (Markdown inline link — renders as a clickable hyperlink).
     - Still uses `disable_web_page_preview: true` so the chat doesn't bloom a preview card.

- **[REUSED]**
  - `cheerio`, `axios` already in deps. No new packages.
  - `getCachedOrFetch` in `nea-scrape.js` (the v0.48.0 shell) — same signature, just bumped cache key.
  - `safeSend`, `redis`, `console.warn/error` in `index.js`.

- **[DELTA]**
  - **MODIFIED** `nea-scrape.js`: URL fix `/announcements` → `/overview`; cache key v1→v2; +7 enrichment helpers (~120 lines); module.exports gained 8 names.
  - **MODIFIED** `index.js`: `runHawkerClosureLive` scrape-first dispatch (~25 lines); `runHawkerClosureLiveRefresh` clears both caches; share-link callback rewritten 1 line; NEA portal button URL updated.
  - **MODIFIED** `pipeline-task.js`: `SURPRISE_TARGET_COUNT` 12 → 5 (1-line constant change).
  - **NEW** `__tests__/nea-scrape-helpers.test.js`: 15 unit tests (parseClosureDateRange, classifyClosureStatus, enrichClosureRows, sortClosuresByProximity, formatClosureBlocks).
  - **VERSION** `package.json` + 3× TMA `package.json` 0.48.0 → 0.48.1.

- **[VERIFICATION (sandbox)]**
  ```
  $ node --check nea-scrape.js index.js pipeline-task.js
  → OK
  $ npm test
  ✓ Test Files  10 passed (10)
       Tests  143 passed (143)        # was 128; +15 new helper tests
  ```

- **[POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION]**
  1. `/ver` shows `soleat v0.48.1`.
  2. `/hawker` → tap "🧹 Cleaning closures" → response renders within ~2s (scrape, not 10–20s web_search). Each closure block has 🔴/🟡/⚪ emoji, Type, Dates, and `📍 https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=...` URL — tapping it opens Google Maps app on iOS, not Apple Maps.
  3. Header reads "🧹 N closures found · M ongoing · K upcoming · J recently ended · just fetched" on first call; "cached Xh ago" on subsequent calls within 12h.
  4. `/surprise` returns exactly 5 venue cards (was 12 in v0.48.0).
  5. Tap any pick's "👋 Share with buddy" button — the share link renders as a blue hyperlink, tap-able to open Telegram's universal-link UI directly.
  6. "🔄 Force refresh" button now invalidates BOTH caches (scrape + web_search fallback) — verify by hitting it then immediately tapping "🧹 Cleaning closures" again and confirming the "just fetched" stamp.

- **[OUTCOME CLAIMS — falsifiable]**
  - **C1 — `/hawker` cleaning list returns ≥1 row** (the scrape parses the actual `/overview` table). *Test:* manual run; expect ≥10 rows on any given day given SG hawker centre count + cleaning frequency.
  - **C2 — Status classification is correct relative to today** (today=2026-05-03 SGT). *Test:* every "🔴 ongoing" row has start ≤ today ≤ end; every "🟡 upcoming" has start > today; every "⚪ recently-ended" has end < today and end ≥ today−30d.
  - **C3 — Maps URLs use `query=` form, not `cid=`.** *Test:* every URL matches `/^https:\/\/www\.google\.com\/maps\/search\/\?api=1&query=/` — verified in `nea-scrape-helpers.test.js`.
  - **C4 — `/surprise` returns ≤5 cards.** *Test:* count cards in the response.
